title: Full-Time Video Editor — Scaling DTC Supplement Brand (AI Video Production)
description:
About Us



We're a direct-to-consumer supplement brand selling into the UK, Australia and North America, scaling profitably on Meta with performance creative. Every ad we run is built from a written brief and judged on the numbers. We're small, we move fast, and creative volume is our single biggest lever — which is why we're hiring.



This is not a brand-video job. We make direct response ads that have to stop a thumb and sell.



The Role



You'll take a written brief — the idea, a locked shot list, the customer it's aimed at — and turn it into a finished ad. The concepts come from us. Your job is to execute them well, fast, and consistently.



A big part of our production is AI-generated: you'll generate the footage yourself using AI video tools rather than filming or sourcing stock. If you've never touched those tools that's fine — you'll be trained. What we can't train is taste, pace, and following a brief exactly.



Long-term, remote, full-time. Starting rate $5/hour, rising once your hit rate is on target, plus performance bonuses from month two.



What You'll Do



Turn a written brief and shot list into a finished 9:16 ad (20s–3min)

Generate clips with AI video tools (Seedance, image models, AI voice) from the shot list you're given

Cut for pace and hook — the first 3 seconds d
 whether the ad works

Burn in captions, and get them frame-accurate to the spoken word

Build market variants of a winning ad (UK / AU / US versions of the same cut)

Quality-check your own work before it ships: broken frames, drifting captions, wrong offer claims

Deliver roughly 10 finished videos a week once you're up to speed

Re-cut when something comes back, without taking it personally



You Need



Real experience editing short-form direct response ads — UGC, testimonial, or VSL style

A portfolio of ads, not showreels. We want to see work that was made to sell something

The discipline to follow a brief precisely. We'll tell you what the shots are; we need them made, not reinterpreted

Comfort working in a browser and a dashboard — you'll be generating footage, not just editing it

Enough English to read a detailed brief and ask a good question when something's unclear

Reliability. A fixed weekly output matters more to us than an occasional brilliant edit



Nice To Have



You've used AI video generation before (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Runway, HeyGen — any of them)

You understand hook rate, hold rate and CVR and have edited against them

You've worked in supplements, health or beauty



What You'll Get



$5/hour to start, rising with performance

Bonuses paid on how your ads actually perform. We track every ad individually, so we know exactly which ones are yours and how they did. When an ad you cut becomes a winner and we scale it, you get paid for that — on top of your hourly rate. This starts from month two, once you know the pipeline

Fully remote, long-term, full-time

You work directly with the founder — no layers, fast decisions, quick feedback

Every brief you get is written out properly: the idea, the shot list, the customer, and exactly what would get it sent back. You will never be guessing what we want

Training on the AI production pipeline we've built



How to Apply



Put COMPASS at the top of your application so we know you read this.



Then send:



Two or three short-form direct response ads you personally edited — links, not attachments. Tell us which part was yours.

One sentence on the hook in your best one, and why you cut it that way.

Have you used any AI video generation tool? Which one, and what did you make with it? "No" is an acceptable answer.

Your weekly availability, in hours.



Applications without a portfolio link won't be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates get a short paid test brief — a real one, paid at the hourly rate.

title: Small Business Superstar
description:
Small Business Superstar

Employment Type: Full-Time



Work Setup: Remote

Schedule: U.S. Business Hours



About the Role

We are looking for a Small Business Superstar to become a dependable part of a growing service-based business.

This is an all-around role for someone who is smart, adaptable, organized, and comfortable wearing different hats. You will help with customer communication, scheduling, administrative work, day-to-day operations, and whatever else is needed to keep the business running smoothly.



Some days you may be speaking with customers and scheduling services. Other days you may be updating records, coordinating with the team, following up on open items, or figuring out how to solve an unexpected problem.



We are not looking for someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every situation. We want someone who can understand the goal, use good judgment, find solutions, and take ownership of getting things done.

Previous leadership, supervisory, or team lead experience is strongly preferred.



What You'll Be Doing

Customer Communication

Answer customer calls and inquiries professionally

Ask the right questions to understand what customers need

Provide clear and helpful information about services

Follow up with prospective and existing customers

Help customers determine the appropriate next steps

Handle routine concerns and problems independently

Maintain friendly and professional communication throughout the customer experience

Scheduling & Coordination

Schedule and confirm customer appointments

Coordinate appointments based on service availability and service areas

Reschedule appointments when needed

Communicate schedule changes with customers and team members

Maintain an accurate and organized service calendar

Identify scheduling conflicts and help find solutions

Administrative Support

Maintain accurate customer and business records

Update appointments, customer information, and internal notes

Organize documents and information

Complete follow-up tasks

Assist with research and data entry

Keep systems and records accurate and up to date

Handle other administrative responsibilities as needed

Day-to-Day Business Operations

Help keep daily operations organized

Coordinate with team members when information or action is needed

Follow up on outstanding tasks

Identify problems before they become bigger issues

Help improve processes and workflows

Handle changing priorities as the needs of the business evolve

Take ownership of tasks and see them through to completion



Systems Used

Experience with the following is a plus:

GoHighLevel

Jobber



Experience with other CRM, scheduling, customer management, or field-service systems is also valuable.

You do not need to know every system from day one, but you should be comfortable learning new technology quickly.



What We're Looking For



You may be our next Small Business Superstar if you:

Have experience working with customers

Are confident and comfortable communicating over the phone

Have clear, easy-to-understand spoken English

Are organized and pay close attention to details

Can manage multiple responsibilities without losing track of things

Know how to prioritize when several things need attention

Can solve problems without immediately needing someone else to tell you what to do

Are comfortable making reasonable decisions within established processes

Take ownership of your work and follow through

Are proactive rather than waiting for someone to assign every task

Can adapt when priorities or situations change

Are comfortable working with schedules, customer information, and business systems

Learn new tools and processes quickly

Are dependable, resourceful, and accountable

Previous leadership, supervisory, or team lead experience is strongly preferred.



The Kind of Person We're Looking For

We're looking for the person who naturally asks:

“What needs to get done, and how can I help make it happen?”

You don't need to have done every task before. What matters is your ability to think, communicate, adapt, and figure things out.

If a customer has a question, you know how to listen and find the answer.

If there's a scheduling problem, you look for a solution.

If something isn't getting done, you follow up.

If you notice a better way of doing something, you speak up.

And when you're given responsibility for something, you own it through completion.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety and wants to become an important part of a small business rather than being limited to one narrow set of responsibilities.



To Apply



Please submit your resume and a self-video introduction of up to 2 minutes.

In your video, please briefly introduce yourself and tell us about:

Your experience working with customers

Your experience handling administrative or operational responsibilities

A time you solved a problem without being given step-by-step instructions

Any leadership, supervisory, or team coordination experience

Your experience with GoHighLevel, Jobber, or similar business systems

Why you think you would be a great Small Business Superstar

Please speak naturally and do not read from a script.



We're looking for someone who can become a trusted part of the business, take ownership of their responsibilities, and help make life easier for both our customers and our team.

title: Legal Operations, AI & Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Legal Operations, AI & Digital Marketing Assistant



T McKee Law PLLC** — Nashville, TN



About the Firm



T McKee Law PLLC is a solo employment, nonprofit and general business law firm.



Because the firm is small, the work is real. There is no layer of associates and paralegals between this role and the actual practice. The person in this seat will see how cases are built and will own the systems that let the firm operate at a scale that normally requires a larger staff.



The role



This is a hybrid operations role combining three areas:



1. **AI and workflow automation** — building and maintaining the tooling that handles repetitive practice work.

2. **Search and AI visibility (SEO / GEO)** — making sure prospective clients searching for an employment lawyer, and AI assistants answering their questions, find this firm.

3. **General administrative and intake support** — the day-to-day that keeps a calendar from slipping.



You do not need to be a lawyer, a developer, or a marketing agency veteran. You do need to be genuinely curious about tools, careful with detail, and comfortable being the person who figures something out and then documents it so it works the same way next time.



What You'll Do



1. AI and workflow automation



- Build and maintain practical automations for recurring firm tasks: document intake and organization, deadline tracking, exhibit and production naming conventions, client status updates, timekeeping and billing prep.

- Develop and refine reusable prompts and templates for drafting support, document summarization, deposition and transcript review, and record review — always with attorney review before anything goes out the door.

- Evaluate AI and legal-tech tools against the firm's confidentiality obligations, and maintain a written record of what tool is approved for what kind of data.

- Keep the Google Workspace environment organized and functional: shared drives, matter folder structure, labels and filters, calendars, forms, and any connected apps or scripts.

- Write and maintain plain-English documentation for every process you build. If you leave for two weeks, the firm should still run.



2. SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization)



- Own the firm's website (
): page structure, technical health, load speed, mobile experience, and conversion path from visitor to consultation request.

- Run keyword and intent research for employment and civil rights practice areas in Middle Tennessee, and build a content calendar from it.

- Draft and publish practice-area pages, FAQs, and articles that answer the questions prospective clients actually ask. Every piece is reviewed by the attorney before publication.

- Manage local search presence: Google Business Profile, directory and bar association listings, citation consistency, and review generation within advertising-rule limits.

- Build and track the firm's visibility in AI-generated answers — how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and AI search summaries describe the firm and whether they surface it for relevant queries. Structure content and schema markup so it is easy for these systems to cite accurately.

- Report monthly on traffic, rankings, AI citations, inquiry volume, and consultation conversion, with a recommendation attached to each number.



3. Administrative and intake support



- Handle first-touch intake: respond to inquiries, gather preliminary information on a structured form, run conflicts checks, and schedule consultations.

- Maintain the calendar and deadline docket, and flag upcoming dates well before they are urgent.

- Organize files and correspondence.

- Support billing and expense tracking.



Requirements



- Two or more years in an administrative, operations, marketing, or coordinator role — legal experience welcome but not required.

- Demonstrated hands-on use of AI tools for real work, not just experimentation. Be prepared to describe something you actually built or automated.

- Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals: on-page optimization, technical basics, content strategy, local search.

- Strong writing. Clear, plain, correct. This role produces public-facing content and client-facing communication.

- Comfort with Google Workspace and general software fluency — you can learn a new tool from its documentation without hand-holding.

- Meticulous attention to detail. 

- Absolute discretion. You will handle confidential client information, including sensitive employment and medical records, and you will be bound by the same confidentiality obligations that apply to the attorney.



Preferred



- Experience in a law firm

- Familiarity with legal practice management

- Experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Make, Apps Script) or light scripting.

- Content management experience with the firm's platform, and familiarity with structured data and schema markup.

description:
We are a Swedish corporate housing company. We place project teams and relocating staff from European companies in furnished homes, from one month to several years. Requests come in daily from construction, energy, engineering and consulting companies. We source the homes ourselves, direct from landlords and operators, across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, Germany and Spain.



We are hiring one experienced person to own the deal from start to finish: find the unit, verify it against our compliance policy, negotiate with the landlord, close the client. This is not a coordinator role and not for beginners.



You must have at least three years in this industry: serviced apartments, corporate housing, relocation, extended stay or furnished property management. For example at Oakwood, Ascott, SilverDoor, Santa Fe, Crown, Homelike, Blueground, Spotahome, a corporate housing broker, or a Booking or Airbnb partner account. 

You have negotiated with landlords, you know what a viewing, a deposit against keys and an ownership check are, and you can tell a real landlord from a fake one in two
s.



Your day: work live cases in our CRM from day one. Source units by phone and
, verify every property before money moves, negotiate rent and terms, present offers with a margin, close. 

Ten to twenty landlord contacts a day is normal. Everything is logged in the CRM.



Pay: 400 USD per month base plus 8 percent of the profit margin on every deal you close, paid monthly for the full length of the stay. With two or three active deals the realistic total is 900 to 1,200 USD per month. 

One closed group deal alone has paid over 600 USD per month in commission. This role pays on results.



Setup: full-time, remote, 09:00 to 17:00 Central European Time. Live pipeline from day one, CRM, AI drafting tools, phone line, company
, small team that moves fast. Independent contractor agreement, 30-day trial, pay review at 60 days.



To apply, write three short paragraphs:

- Which company and role gave you your corporate housing experience, and for how long.

- The last landlord negotiation you handled, the sticking point, and how it ended.

- Your monthly rate.



No templates, no AI-written applications, we check every claim against your profile. 

Shortlisted candidates get a one-hour live task in our CRM, then a call.

s, dates contacted, follow-ups, responses, and status.

An excellent English writer and communicator.

Familiar with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and entertainment culture.

title: PART-TIME ADMINISTRATIVE & OPERATIONS ASSISTANT
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I am looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Administrative & Operations Assistant to support several small businesses and projects.



This is not a content creation or social media role.



The primary purpose of this position is to take recurring administrative and operational work off my plate, keep important tasks from falling through the cracks, and help turn processes that currently live in my head into organized, repeatable systems.



I am looking for someone who can eventually take ownership of routine workflows rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions every time.



This is a part-time, long-term opportunity for the right person.



HOURS AND COMPENSATION



Starting rate: $4-$5 USD/hour depending on experience.



This position is part-time. Weekly hours will be agreed upon and capped.



Hours may not be exceeded without advance approval.



There may be opportunities for additional responsibility, hours, and compensation over time as trust and familiarity with the businesses grow.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



1.
 AND INBOX MANAGEMENT



I operate multiple businesses/entities with separate
 inboxes.



Responsibilities may include:



* Reviewing and organizing designated inboxes

* Identifying messages requiring action

* Drafting routine responses

* Responding independently to approved categories of
s

* Following up when someone has not responded

* Flagging messages that require my personal attention

* Maintaining inbox organization

* Making sure important requests do not get lost



The goal is not simply to sort
. I want someone who can gradually learn what they can handle independently and what needs to be escalated to me.



2. PROGRAM AND CLIENT ADMINISTRATION



Support administrative workflows for educational programs, memberships, clients, events, and other business activities.



Examples may include:



* Sending onboarding information

* Tracking required forms or documents

* Following up on incomplete items

* Updating participant information

* Preparing routine templates

* Organizing program materials

* Sending reminders

* Maintaining participant trackers

* Coordinating administrative steps before and after programs or events



3. TEMPLATE AND DOCUMENT PREPARATION



Prepare routine documents using approved templates and information I provide.



Examples may include:



* Payment-plan documents

* Intake forms

* Travel-related forms

* Standard letters

* Checklists

* Participant documents

* Internal tracking documents

* Other recurring administrative paperwork



Some of my businesses involve legal, lending, real estate, financial, and professional-services matters.



You will not be expected to provide professional advice, interpret legal documents, or make legal or financial decisions.



Your role will be administrative preparation using approved processes and templates.



4. FOLLOW-UP AND TASK MANAGEMENT



Help make sure recurring and delegated tasks actually get completed.



Responsibilities may include:



* Maintaining task lists

* Tracking deadlines

* Following up with contractors, vendors, clients, participants, or other contacts

* Identifying overdue items

* Flagging blocked tasks

* Keeping me informed of items requiring decisions

* Maintaining recurring operational checklists



I value someone who notices that something is unfinished and follows through rather than waiting to be reminded.



5. CONTRACTOR, VENDOR AND PROPERTY COMMUNICATIONS



Handle routine administrative communications with third parties when appropriate.



Examples may include:



* Contractors

* Vendors

* Property managers

* Service providers

* Program participants

* Other routine business contacts



This may include requesting updates, confirming completion, gathering documents, coordinating routine logistics, or following up on outstanding items.



Sensitive, unusual, disputed, financial, legal, or high-stakes matters should be escalated rather than handled independently.



6. SOP AND PROCESS DOCUMENTATION



This is an important part of the role.



As you learn recurring processes, I want you to help document them.



Responsibilities may include:



* Writing simple step-by-step SOPs

* Creating checklists

* Documenting recurring workflows

* Updating procedures when processes change

* Identifying steps that are unclear or inefficient

* Helping organize business knowledge so it does not live only in my head



You do not need to be an expert SOP writer when you start, but you should be comfortable documenting what you learn clearly.



7. OPERATIONS ORGANIZATION



Over time, responsibilities may also include:



* Maintaining recurring task calendars

* Updating operational trackers

* Organizing shared business files

* Preparing weekly status summaries

* Identifying overdue, blocked, or attention-needed work

* Helping maintain simple operating systems across multiple businesses

* Keeping GoHighLevel records, tags, fields, or workflows organized as assigned



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate:



* Speaks and writes English clearly

* Is highly organized

* Pays close attention to detail

* Communicates professionally

* Follows instructions carefully

* Can explain their thinking clearly

* Is comfortable asking questions when something is genuinely unclear

* Can work independently after being trained

* Has good judgment about when to act and when to escalate

* Is comfortable working across several businesses without mixing information between them

* Can maintain confidentiality

* Is comfortable working with Google Workspace

* Can learn new software quickly

* Can create and follow checklists and SOPs

* Is reliable with deadlines and follow-up

* Does not need to be reminded repeatedly about assigned tasks

* Looks for solutions instead of only pointing out problems



Previous experience supporting an entrepreneur, small business owner, operations team, online education business, real estate business, or professional-services company is a plus.



TOOLS



Experience with some of the following is helpful, but you do not need to know every platform:



* Gmail

* Google Drive

* Google Docs

* Google Sheets

* Google Calendar

* GoHighLevel

* Zoom

* Online forms

* Project/task management software

* ChatGPT or other AI-assisted productivity tools

* Canva



I can provide access, when appropriate, to:



* GoHighLevel

* A seat in my ChatGPT Business workspace

* Canva Premium

* Relevant Google Workspace files and systems

* Other business tools required for assigned workflows



Ability to learn new tools quickly is more important than already knowing every system.



CONFIDENTIALITY AND AI USE



This role may involve access to confidential business, client, financial, real estate, or personal information.



Discretion and confidentiality are essential.



AI tools may be used for approved business purposes such as drafting, summarizing, organizing information, documenting SOPs, or improving workflows.



Confidential business information should not be entered into personal AI accounts or unauthorized third-party AI systems.



When AI use is appropriate, approved company-provided systems should be used.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Within the first few months, I should be able to:



* Assign routine administrative work without explaining the entire process every time

* Trust that follow-ups will happen

* Trust that deadlines will be tracked

* Open my inbox and see fewer items requiring my attention

* Receive concise summaries of what needs my decision

* See recurring workflows becoming documented SOPs

* Spend less time on routine administrative execution

* Focus more of my time on strategy, clients, teaching, relationships, content, and decisions that actually require me



This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys creating order, improving systems, following through, and becoming the person who knows how things get done.



APPLICATION PROCESS – VIDEO REQUIRED



Please do NOT answer the screening questions below in writing.



For your initial application, simply send me a short message letting me know:



1. You are interested in the role.

2. You have reviewed the job description.

3. You will prepare the requested video and send me a Google Drive link.



Then record a short video introducing yourself and answering the questions below.



Please upload your video to Google Drive and send me a viewing link. Make sure the sharing settings allow me to access the video.



Your video does not need professional editing. I am much more interested in your ability to communicate clearly, explain your experience, and think through situations.



Please answer:



1. Tell me briefly about yourself and your experience with administrative or operations support.



2. Tell me about a role where you managed multiple recurring responsibilities without constant supervision. How did you keep everything organized?



3. What experience do you have managing business
 or drafting/responding to
s on someone else's behalf?



4. Tell me about a process, SOP, checklist, tracker, or other system you created or improved. What problem did it solve?



5. What Google Workspace tools do you use regularly? Please also mention any experience you have with GoHighLevel, CRMs, project-management tools, or AI productivity tools.



6. Imagine you notice that an important task assigned to someone else is three days overdue. What would you do?



7. Imagine you receive an
 and you are not sure whether you have authority to respond. What would you do?



8. Tell me about a time you caught a mistake, missing detail, or potential problem before it became a bigger issue.



9. What is your requested hourly rate in USD?



10. How many hours per week are you currently available, and what other clients or employment do you currently have?



11. Why does this particular role interest you?



ATTENTION TO DETAIL:



At the very end of your video, please tell me your favorite way to stay organized.



There is no need to repeat your answers in writing.



I am especially interested in candidates who communicate clearly, exercise good judgment, stay organized, follow through, and can eventually take ownership of recurring work.

title: ENGINEERING ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT
description:
Role Overview



We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Part-Time Engineering Administrative Assistant to support a U.S.-based engineering services company.



This role is ideal for someone with engineering industry experience who can confidently handle customer communication, scheduling, administrative coordination, billing support, and project documentation. The successful candidate should understand the general U.S. construction environment and be comfortable communicating with homeowners, contractors, vendors, and other customers.



This is an administrative support role and does not involve performing engineering analysis, structural diagnosis, or professional engineering determinations.



Key Responsibilities



Customer Communication & Scheduling

Monitor and review incoming project inquiries and customer information.

Classify projects based on type, urgency, and scheduling requirements.

Contact customers via text and phone to gather and confirm project details.

Schedule and coordinate appointments based on customer needs and engineer availability.

Send appointment confirmations, reminders, scheduling updates, and payment reminders.

Communicate schedule changes and provide customers with timely updates.

Use good judgment in determining when a customer requires a phone call versus text communication.

Accurately collect and verify customer names, addresses, phone numbers,
 addresses, and project information.



Administrative & Billing Support

Maintain accurate project and customer information in Google Sheets and other company systems.

Assist with invoicing and payment tracking through QuickBooks Online.

Send payment links and follow up on outstanding payments as directed.

Coordinate payment status with scheduled appointments.

Maintain and update calendars, spreadsheets, and other administrative records.



Project Documentation & Report Preparation

Organize project photos and documentation from Google Drive, iCloud, or other sources.

Prepare photos and supporting information for engineering reports.

Assist with repetitive report preparation tasks, including dates, project information, formatting, and document organization.

Ensure reports and project documentation are organized and ready for the engineer's review.



General Administrative Support

Coordinate with engineers, customers, contractors, and other project stakeholders.

Track appointments, follow-ups, and outstanding items.

Learn company-specific processes, terminology, and customer requirements quickly.

Use AI and other technology tools to improve administrative efficiency and accuracy.

Maintain accurate and timely work records using Hubstaff or other company-designated time-tracking and productivity tools.

Properly record working hours and ensure Hubstaff is active and accurately reflecting scheduled work time while performing assigned duties.

Notify the appropriate supervisor promptly of any Hubstaff or time-tracking issues that may affect the accuracy of recorded hours.



Qualifications

Previous experience in construction, engineering, property services, or a related industry preferred.

Strong understanding of general U.S. construction processes and terminology.

Familiarity with construction permits, contractors, subcontractors, or trades such as electrical, plumbing, or general construction is a strong advantage.

Experience with scheduling and customer coordination.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Comfortable making professional phone calls to customers, contractors, vendors, and other contacts.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling customer and project information.

Ability to manage multiple appointments, follow-ups, and administrative tasks.

Comfortable learning new software and company processes quickly.

Experience with QuickBooks Online, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Calendar is preferred.

Comfortable using time-tracking and remote-work tools such as Hubstaff.

Ability to work independently and exercise sound administrative judgment.



Scope of the Role



The Engineering Administrative Assistant will support the administrative and customer-facing side of engineering projects. The role will not be responsible for engineering calculations, structural diagnosis, technical engineering decisions, or other professional engineering determinations.



Remote Work & Time Tracking



This is a part-time remote position. The successful candidate is expected to maintain reliable availability during agreed working hours and accurately track work time using Hubstaff.



Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and verification of scheduled working hours. The employee is expected to keep the application active during working time and ensure that recorded hours accurately reflect time spent performing assigned work.



The role requires professionalism, responsiveness, accountability, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.



To apply:



Complete the application form.

Upload your updated CV.

Submit your short introduction video.

Answer the application question about the most recent federal solicitation or GC bid package you personally worked on.



Apply Here –

title: AI Creative Editor (Image Editing) — Dropshipping Ads
description:
About Us:

We run multiple fast-growing health & beauty e-commerce stores. Our marketing runs on Meta Ads, and creative quality is central to our growth. We're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Creative Editor who understands why ads need to be localized — not just how to edit or create them.



The Role:

This is not a general AI-art or graphic design role. We source high-performing competitor ad images from other markets and adapt them for our own brands and audiences. You'll also create new variants of our winning ads to keep campaigns fresh and combat ad fatigue. You'll be using AI tools to edit backgrounds, elements, text, and visual details — but the real skill is understanding what needs to change and why so the ad resonates with a new market, audience, and regulatory environment, while keeping the elements that make it convert.



What You'll Do:

- Edit and localize competitor ad images for our own campaigns across three markets

- Adapt visual elements (models, settings, text, cultural references, packaging, etc.) so ads feel native to each target market — not just visually different, but market-appropriate

- Create new variants of our own winning ad creatives (different backgrounds, angles, elements) to refresh campaigns and reduce ad fatigue

- Use AI tools to modify backgrounds, elements, and details in images

- Write and refine prompts to get precise, high-quality AI-generated edits

- Understand and preserve the core conversion elements of a winning ad while adapting or varying it

- Collaborate closely with our swipe research and media buying team

- Maintain consistency and quality across a high volume of image edits



Requirements:

- Experience in e-commerce / dropshipping marketing is required — you must understand how paid ad creatives work and why localization matters for conversion, not just aesthetics

- Proven experience with AI image editing tools (e.g., Higgsfield, Gemini or similar)

- Strong prompt-writing skills — you know how to get AI tools to produce the exact result you want

- Sharp eye for detail — small inconsistencies should jump out at you

- Available minimum 15 hours/week

- Reliable internet connection and own equipment

- Good written English (business communication is in English)



Important:

We regularly receive applications from candidates who are strong with AI tools but have no e-commerce or dropshipping background. Please note: AI skills alone are not enough for this role. If you don't have experience working with paid ad creatives / e-commerce marketing, please don't apply — you won't be a fit.



What We Offer:

- Paid hourly

- Long-term, ongoing position (not a one-off project)

- Growth opportunities within the team as we scale

- Direct feedback loop with the marketing team to sharpen your skills



How to Apply

Please apply with:

- A short intro about your e-commerce/dropshipping experience and your availability

- Examples of before/after AI-edited images, including any variants you've created of an existing ad (portfolio or samples)

- A short answer (2-3 sentences): how and why would you change an ad image when adapting it for a different market?

- Your hourly rate expectation

title: Talent Acquisition & Growth Coordinator
description:

Position Type: Part-Time with Opportunity to Grow

Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 4 hours per day

Time Zone: Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Pay: $4 per hour + performance bonuses



About the Role



AERO Financial is a growing independent life insurance agency looking for an organized, proactive, and confident Talent Acquisition & Growth Coordinator.



Your primary responsibility will be helping us recruit, organize, and follow up with new life insurance agents and sales professionals who may be interested in joining our organization.



You will help build a consistent recruiting pipeline by sourcing candidates, posting opportunities, communicating with applicants, scheduling interviews, and following candidates through the recruiting and onboarding process.



This is not a traditional corporate HR position. This is a growth-focused role where your performance will be measured by your ability to help us bring qualified, productive agents into the business.



Responsibilities



Recruiting & Talent Acquisition



* Post agent opportunities on job boards and recruiting platforms

* Search for potential candidates through LinkedIn,
 groups, job boards, social media, and other recruiting channels

* Create and post recruiting flyers and advertisements

* Respond to interested applicants

* Conduct basic candidate pre-screening

* Schedule qualified candidates for interviews

* Follow up with applicants who have not completed the next step

* Maintain an organized recruiting pipeline

* Track candidate status from initial contact through onboarding

* Help coordinate contracting and onboarding

* Make sure new agents complete required training

* Follow up with new agents until they begin actively working

* Maintain records of active and inactive agents



Growth & Outreach



* Post recruiting 
 in relevant
 groups and online communities

* Identify new places where we can advertise agent opportunities

* Help post opportunities on job boards

* Assist with basic social media recruiting content

* Monitor responses from recruiting campaigns

* Test different recruiting messages, posts, and channels

* Help generate new candidate leads consistently



Reporting



Maintain a weekly recruiting report showing:



* Candidates contacted

* Applications received

* Interviews scheduled

* Interviews completed

* Candidates accepted

* Agents contracted

* Agents completing onboarding

* Agents completing training

* Agents writing their first policy

* Active producing agents



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Highly organized

* Proactive and self-motivated

* Comfortable communicating with people

* Fluent or highly proficient in written and spoken English

* Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based candidates

* Experienced with recruiting, HR, virtual assistance, appointment setting, or sales

* Comfortable using job boards and social media

* Familiar with Google Sheets, Google Drive,
, calendars, and CRM systems

* Able to follow up consistently without needing constant supervision

* Comfortable working with performance goals and KPIs



Previous recruiting experience is strongly preferred.



Experience recruiting salespeople, insurance agents, real estate agents, financial professionals, or commission-based salespeople is a major advantage.



Performance Expectations



This position is not measured simply by how many people apply.



The goal is to help AERO Financial consistently bring in agents who become active and productive.



Performance will be tracked through the recruiting funnel:



Candidate → Interview → Contracted → Onboarded → Training Completed → Active Agent → First Policy → Producing Agent



Compensation



Base Pay: $4 USD/hour depending on experience.



Additional performance bonuses may be available for milestones such as:



* Successful agent onboarding

* Agent completing training

* Agent writing their first issued/paid policy

* Agent reaching production milestones



There is an opportunity for increased hours, responsibility, compensation, and advancement as AERO Financial grows.

This role may eventually grow into a full-time position overseeing Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, Agent Success, and People Operations for the agency.

 and Instagram).



This is not YouTube editing or cinematic content.

This role is strictly about performance: building ads that hold attention, maintain retention, and convert.



You will be editing Meta ads ranging from 30 seconds to 90 seconds, and occasionally longer VSLs of 2–3 minutes.

UGC-style videos



Authority / expert talking-head videos



Testimonials



Mechanism explainers

We are looking for someone who understands that the first 3 seconds determine everything.



You must know how to:



Pace a direct-response VSL for Meta



Use pattern interrupts



Maintain viewer retention



Control visual rhythm



Reinforce scripts with text overlays



Keep talking-head footage watchable



Retention matters more than aesthetics.

You should be comfortable with:



CapCut



Fast cuts



Punch-ins



Zooms



High-contrast subtitles



Mixing stock footage with UGC



Editing around direct-response psychology

AI video generation and augmentation

Sync footage naturally to AI voiceovers



Clean up AI artifacts



Ensure accurate mouth movement and speech alignment



Combine AI footage, stock footage, and real footage seamlessly

Health



Skincare

Direct-response products

title: Construction Estimator / Bid Coordinator (US-based client)
description:
We are hiring an experienced Construction Estimator / Bid Coordinator to support a growing U.S.-based construction and facilities services company.



This is a hands-on construction role covering two major workstreams:



1. Government / Prime Contractor Bids

Supporting federal, state, and municipal solicitations as a prime contractor.



2. General Contractor / Subcontractor Bids

Preparing bids for self-performed construction and facility services for national and regional general contractors.



This is not a general administrative or data-entry position. You will work directly with construction documents, specifications, subcontractors, general contractors, pricing, bid requirements, and multiple active opportunities simultaneously.



The client typically has 6–10 active pursuits running in parallel, across multiple U.S. states, each with its own scope, documentation, subcontractors, and deadlines.



We are looking for someone with genuine construction estimating experience who can take ownership of the bid process with minimal supervision.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Government / Prime Contractor Bids

Monitor 
 and other U.S. procurement portals for relevant solicitations.

Track amendments, Q&A deadlines, site visits, and bid submission deadlines.

Review PWS, SOWs, specifications, drawings, and solicitation documents.

Extract scope requirements, forms, certifications, submittals, deadlines, and compliance requirements.

Identify required trades and subcontractors.

Research and source qualified subcontractors in the project geography, including unfamiliar markets.

Contact subcontractors by phone and
 to discuss scope and obtain pricing.

Communicate scope requirements, site requirements, payment terms, personnel requirements, and quote deadlines.

Collect, organize, compare, and evaluate subcontractor proposals.

Identify exclusions, scope gaps, pricing inconsistencies, and items requiring clarification.

Follow up persistently with subcontractors to obtain quotes before internal deadlines.

Prepare bid schedules, unit-price tables, and required government forms accurately and on time.



Phone outreach is a significant part of this position. You must be comfortable speaking directly with U.S. subcontractors and contractors.



General Contractor / GC Bids



The client also bids self-performed work directly to national and regional general contractors, including:



Post-construction cleaning

Rough and final cleaning

Interior and exterior glass

Pressure washing

Division 9 and Division 10 scopes

Related facility and finishing services



You will:



Monitor invitations to bid through
 and GC bid platforms.

Review ITBs, plans, specifications, and project schedules.

Identify the complete scope of work, including requirements located in other specification sections.

Complete GC bid forms accurately, including alternates, unit prices, allowances, sales tax treatment, bond and insurance requirements, union status, parking requirements, and project-specific exhibits.

Prepare and submit proposals to GC estimating and preconstruction contacts.

Confirm receipt of submitted bids.

Follow up consistently with GCs until the opportunity is awarded or closed.

Track bid-date changes, competitiveness, expected award timing, and feedback.

Maintain a live log of outstanding GC quotes, including project, GC, contact, value, submission date, last contact, next follow-up date, and status.

Support scope clarification and change-order documentation on awarded projects.



ESTIMATING & BID COORDINATION



Across both workstreams, you will:



Review lengthy construction documents and quickly identify critical requirements.

Extract and organize information from complex project documents.

Build and maintain multi-tab Excel pricing workbooks.

Use linked formulas properly rather than hardcoding values where formulas belong.

Verify that inputs flow correctly through dependent tabs before submission.

Maintain accurate estimating, bid, subcontractor, and quote records.

Manage multiple active bids and competing deadlines simultaneously.

Communicate professionally with subcontractors, vendors, GCs, contracting officers, and other stakeholders.

Use AI and other technology tools to improve document review, research, sourcing, and estimating workflows.



CONFIDENTIALITY & DOCUMENT CONTROL



Confidentiality is a non-negotiable requirement of this role.



You will be expected to:



Properly redact solicitation numbers, agency/end-client identities, and project-identifying information from documents before subcontractor outreach when required.

Ensure unredacted project details are released only when authorized.

Clearly identify documents as internal or external before sending them outside the company.

Ensure client-facing documents contain only approved billing information.

Never disclose internal cost data, margins, payroll information, or other confidential information to clients, GCs, or subcontractors.

Properly communicate and enforce non-circumvention requirements in subcontractor correspondence.



REMOTE WORK & HUBSTAFF



This is a fully remote position supporting a U.S.-based construction client.



Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work activity monitoring.



You must be comfortable working independently in a structured remote environment and maintaining consistent productivity during scheduled U.S. business hours.



You are expected to:



Accurately track working hours through Hubstaff.

Remain available during agreed working hours.

Maintain reliable communication with the client and team.

Respond promptly to time-sensitive bid and subcontractor matters.

Meet deadlines without constant follow-up.

Take ownership of assigned bids from start to finish.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



5+ years of experience in construction estimating, bid coordination, construction procurement, or a closely related role.

Demonstrated experience reading and interpreting PWS, SOWs, specifications, plans, or other construction documents.

Hands-on experience sourcing subcontractors and discussing scope and pricing by phone.

Strong Excel skills, particularly multi-tab workbooks with linked formulas.

Strong spoken and written English.

Professional and confident phone presence.

Experience managing multiple bids, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Strong organization and follow-through.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Availability during U.S. business hours across multiple time zones.

Ability to make and receive calls through a U.S.-reachable phone number.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



The following are a strong advantage:



Experience with federal procurement and 
.

Familiarity with CLIN structures, set-asides, bid schedules, and wage determinations.

Knowledge of Service Contract Act (SCA) and Davis-Bacon requirements.

Experience with GC bid invitation platforms.

Experience with post-construction cleaning, Division 9/10 trades, or facility services.

Experience performing quantity takeoffs from drawings.

Familiarity with Bluebeam or construction estimating software.

Experience using AI tools for document review, research, sourcing, or estimating.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for a construction professional who can hit the ground running.



You should be someone who:



Understands construction documents rather than simply processing them.

Can identify scope gaps and potential issues.

Is comfortable speaking directly with U.S. contractors and subcontractors.

Can source subcontractors in unfamiliar markets.

Can evaluate and normalize competing quotes.

Can manage several active bids without losing track of deadlines.

Follows up proactively instead of waiting for responses.

Takes ownership and keeps the bid pipeline moving.

Knows when to make a recommendation and when to escalate a decision.



If your experience is primarily administrative or data-entry based, this is not the right role.



If you have genuine construction estimating experience and enjoy the challenge of getting bids across the finish line, we want to hear from you.



SCOPE OF AUTHORITY



You will own the estimating and bid coordination process, but you will not have final authority over pricing or contractual commitments.



You will prepare, organize, analyze, and recommend, but you will not:



Set final pricing or margins.

Make final bid/no-bid decisions.

Sign or commit the company to a subcontractor, general contractor, or government agency.



The expectation is ownership of the process, not authority over the final number.



READY TO TAKE OWNERSHIP OF THE BID PROCESS?



If you have real construction estimating experience, strong construction document skills, confidence communicating with U.S. contractors, and the ability to manage multiple bids independently, we'd like to hear from you.



To apply:



Complete the application form.

Upload your updated CV.

Submit your short introduction video.

Answer the application question about the most recent federal solicitation or GC bid package you personally worked on.



Please be specific about your hands-on experience. We are looking for someone who has actually worked on construction bids—not someone who has only provided general administrative support.

title: Technical Engineering Coordinator | US-Based Client
description:
One seat. Technical judgment. Full accountability.



This is not a “hold the calendar and smile” support role.



We’re looking for a Technical Engineering Coordinator who can move comfortably between engineering calculations, technical correspondence, project coordination, and executive-level administrative support.



You should be able to look at a structural or mechanical calculation sheet, understand what you’re looking at, identify potential discrepancies, communicate clearly with a client, and keep the project moving — without everything being divided across three different people.



If you’re an engineer who is organized, commercially minded, technically sharp, and comfortable owning a moving workload, this could be a very strong fit.



What You’ll Do



* Own the inbox, don’t babysit it. Monitor and triage incoming
s based on urgency and complexity. Handle routine matters independently, route appropriately when needed, and respond directly to technical inquiries when you have the knowledge and judgment to do so.

* Review and validate engineering calculations. Check calculations for accuracy, consistency, and potential discrepancies before they become project or client issues.

* Keep engineering projects moving. Track timelines, deliverables, dependencies, follow-ups, and outstanding items across multiple active projects.

* Review and mark up technical documents. Use Bluebeam or equivalent redlining/markup software to review plan sets, submittals, drawings, and technical documentation.

* Provide high-level administrative and executive support. Handle scheduling, correspondence, coordination, documentation, follow-ups, and the many operational details that keep an engineering practice running smoothly.

* Communicate with clients professionally. Draft clear, concise, technically appropriate responses where required and ensure communication does not get lost in translation.

* Use technology intelligently. Leverage Microsoft Office and AI tools to improve drafting, research, documentation, organization, and workflow efficiency.

* Take ownership. Identify what needs to happen next and make it happen rather than waiting for someone to assign every step.



Non-Negotiable Requirements



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering**

* 5+ years of executive assistant, administrative, coordination, or comparable professional experience**, ideally supporting engineering or technical leadership

* Demonstrated project management experience with the ability to manage timelines, deliverables, priorities, and follow-ups

* Strong Microsoft Office proficiency, particularly Excel

* Familiarity with Bluebeam or comparable document markup/redlining software

* Strong spoken and written English

* Ability to understand and communicate technical information clearly

* Comfortable using AI tools for drafting, research, organization, and document-related tasks

* Strong technology skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly

* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

* Excellent judgment, organization, attention to detail, and follow-through



We’ll Evaluate You On



Relevant Work Experience



Your previous roles, scope of responsibilities, engineering/technical exposure, project coordination experience, and ability to operate at a high level.



Software & Technical Proficiency



Your working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Excel, Bluebeam or equivalent markup tools, project management platforms, communication tools, and AI-enabled productivity tools.



Remote Work Experience & Adaptability



Your ability to stay productive, organized, responsive, and accountable without someone physically supervising your work.



English Proficiency — Spoken & Written



You must be able to communicate confidently and professionally with US-based clients and engineering professionals.



Professionalism & Attitude



We value ownership, maturity, good judgment, respect, and a solution-oriented mindset. We’re looking for someone who brings solutions, not just problems.



Response Time & Clarity



In engineering, delays and vague communication can become expensive very quickly. You should be responsive, concise, and clear — especially when something requires immediate attention.



Internet & Work Setup



You must have a reliable internet connection, dependable computer/workstation, and professional remote-work environment suitable for full-time client-facing work.



Commitment to Role & Availability



This is a role that requires consistent attention and accountability. We’re looking for someone who can commit to the position and maintain reliable availability during agreed working hours.



Time Management & Dependability



You should be capable of managing competing priorities, meeting deadlines, following through on commitments, and keeping stakeholders informed without constant reminders.



Problem-Solving Skills



We want someone who can assess a situation, investigate, make reasonable decisions, and move things forward — not someone who stops at “there’s a problem.”



Willingness to Learn & Adapt



Engineering workflows, software, and client requirements evolve. You should be comfortable learning new tools and processes quickly and applying what you learn.



Hubstaff & Remote Accountability



This is a remote position, and Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work accountability.



You should be comfortable using Hubstaff appropriately and maintaining accurate work activity during scheduled hours. Remote work requires trust — and trust works both ways when expectations and accountability are clear.



Nice to Have



* Previous experience in an engineering firm, consultancy, construction company, or other technical environment

* Experience supporting engineering leadership or technical executives

* Exposure to construction documentation, plan review, submittals, or project workflows

* Formal project management certification

* Experience communicating directly with US-based clients

* Strong familiarity with Bluebeam

* A healthy sense of humor for those moments when the “urgent”
 turns out to be a font complaint



Why This Role Matters



You won’t be sitting on the sidelines waiting for instructions.



You’ll be part of the workflow that connects engineering, clients, documentation, administration, and project execution.



The right person will become someone the team can trust to say:



“I’ve reviewed it. Here’s the issue. Here’s what I recommend. And here’s what I’m doing next.”



If that sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you.

title: SEO Lead
description:
About Jumper Media



Jumper Media helps local businesses dominate their markets through Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and AI-driven search strategies. We're growing quickly and are looking for an experienced SEO Team Lead to help us deliver exceptional results while continuing to improve how we operate.



This is not a traditional SEO role. If your experience is primarily in ecommerce, SaaS, or enterprise SEO, this probably isn't the right fit. We're looking for someone who is passionate about Local SEO and excited about where AI is taking search.



About the Role



As an SEO Team Lead, you'll own a portfolio of local SEO clients from strategy through execution. You'll work directly with clients, collaborate with teammates, and continuously improve the processes that help our clients rank across Google Maps, organic search, and AI-powered search experiences.



If you're someone who enjoys testing new ideas, using AI to work smarter, and helping clients grow, we'd love to meet you.



What You'll Do:



- Develop and execute Local SEO strategies for a portfolio of clients.

- Optimize Google Business Profiles, websites, citations, and local link building campaigns.

- Improve client visibility across Google Maps, Search, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

- Analyze campaign performance and turn data into actionable recommendations.

- Meet with clients to explain strategy, review results, and build strong relationships.

- Manage multiple client projects while maintaining a high level of quality and organization.

- Use AI tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and campaign execution.

- Share ideas, test new strategies, and help improve internal SEO processes.



What Success Looks Like:



- Clients improve rankings across Google Maps, Search, and AI search experiences.

- Clients trust your recommendations and enjoy working with you.

- You successfully manage multiple client accounts while delivering projects on time.

- You help improve internal SEO processes through testing, documentation, and collaboration.

- You continue growing your Local SEO expertise and help raise the level of the team.



What We're Looking For



Required Experience:



- Intermediate to advanced experience with Local SEO.

- Strong knowledge of Google Business Profile optimization.

- Experience with local citations and local link building.

- Understanding of AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).

- Strong analytical skills and confidence working with SEO data and reporting.

- Experience managing multiple client accounts.

- Comfortable leading client meetings and communicating SEO strategy.

- Experience integrating AI into daily workflows to improve efficiency.



Soft Skills:



- Self starter who takes initiative.

- Confident decision maker who doesn't need constant direction.

- Takes ownership and treats the business like it's their own.

- Collaborative and open to constructive feedback.

- Strong communicator with teammates and clients.

- Curious and committed to continuous learning.



Preferred Qualifications:



- Experience with Digital PR for local businesses.

- Multi-location or franchise SEO experience.

- Experience recovering suspended Google Business Profiles.

- Experience recovering websites from algorithm penalties or significant ranking losses.



Tools You'll Use:



- Google Workspace

- Ahrefs

- Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

- Google Tag Manager (GTM)

- Google Search Console (GSC)

- Jumper Local

- Experience with platforms such as BrightLocal or Local Falcon is a plus.



Why Join Jumper Media?



We're building a team that moves fast, embraces AI, and is obsessed with continuous improvement. We look for people who take ownership, challenge the status quo, and are excited to help shape the future of Local SEO.



If you're passionate about Local SEO, excited about AI, and want to help build something special, we'd love to hear from you.

 Only selected candidates will be contacted via

description:

## About the Role



I’m looking for an experienced **Short-Form Video Editor** to work with me on an ongoing basis for my dropshipping business.



The main focus will be creating **high-converting short-form videos** for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels and
.



This is NOT just a basic video editing role.



I need someone who understands how short-form content works and can take successful/reference creatives, understand why they work, and **recreate/adapt them for my target market**.



You will be working closely with me on a regular basis, so I’m looking for someone reliable, fast, creative and interested in a long-term working relationship.



## What You’ll Be Doing



* Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Reels and

* Recreate/adapt successful competitor and reference videos

* Turn existing winning creatives into new variations

* Create and edit **AI UGC-style videos**

* Work with AI-generated actors/avatars, voices and visuals when needed

* Add captions, hooks, transitions, sound effects and other elements that improve retention

* Translate and localize videos for my target market

* Adapt on-screen text so it sounds **natural and native**, not like a literal translation

* Adapt voice-overs into natural-sounding speech for the target language/market

* Replace text and voice-overs while keeping the original structure and pacing of the creative

UK electrical, fire or compliance businesses

title: Revenue Cycle & Revenue Growth Manager
description:
Revenue Cycle & Revenue Growth Manager



Full-Time | Dermatology Practice



We are seeking an experienced, analytical, and results-driven Revenue Cycle & Revenue Growth Manager to oversee and optimize the financial performance of our dermatology practice.



This is not simply a traditional revenue cycle management position. We are looking for someone who can analyze our financial and operational data, identify trends, understand the reasons behind changes in revenue, and turn those findings into actionable strategies that help our providers and practice increase revenue.



The ideal candidate will be highly analytical, comfortable working with data from Modernizing Medicine (ModMed) and Sage Intact, and able to translate financial information into clear recommendations for physicians and practice leadership.



This individual will be a key partner in identifying revenue opportunities, reducing revenue leakage, improving provider performance, and maximizing the profitability of both our medical and cosmetic services.



Key Responsibilities

Revenue Analysis & Business Intelligence

Analyze revenue trends using data from Modernizing Medicine and Sage Intact.

Monitor monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue performance.

Analyze revenue by provider, location, payer, procedure, service line, and other relevant metrics.

Identify significant increases or decreases in revenue and determine the underlying causes.

Reconcile operational revenue data from ModMed with financial data in Sage Intacct.

Develop and maintain meaningful revenue reports and dashboards for leadership.

Compare current performance against historical trends, budgets, forecasts, and established goals.

Identify patterns that may impact future revenue.

Provide leadership with clear explanations of why revenue is up or down and what actions should be taken as a result.

Proactively identify revenue leakage, missed opportunities, and areas of financial inefficiency.

Provider Revenue Optimization

Analyze individual provider performance and revenue trends.

Develop provider-specific reporting showing revenue, collections, procedure volume, service mix, and other relevant KPIs.

Identify opportunities for providers to increase appropriate revenue through improved procedure utilization, scheduling, documentation, coding, and service mix.

Analyze provider procedure patterns and identify opportunities to expand or improve utilization of profitable services.

Work directly with providers to communicate performance trends and revenue opportunities.

Develop actionable recommendations rather than simply providing reports.

Assist leadership in establishing provider revenue and productivity goals.

Track progress toward goals and identify areas requiring additional attention or support.

Help providers understand the financial impact of changes in procedure volume, payer mix, reimbursement, and scheduling.

Medical Revenue Cycle Management

Oversee and monitor the full revenue cycle, including charge capture, coding, billing, claims, denials, accounts receivable, and collections.

Monitor A/R aging, denial rates, collection rates, reimbursement trends, and outstanding claims.

Identify recurring billing, coding, documentation, and reimbursement issues.

Partner with billing and coding teams to improve revenue capture and reduce preventable revenue loss.

Monitor payer performance and reimbursement trends.

Identify opportunities to improve charge capture and reimbursement.

Use ModMed reporting to identify operational issues that may be impacting financial performance.

Ensure revenue cycle issues are identified early and addressed proactively.

Cosmetic Revenue Analytics & Growth



A significant component of this role will be partnering with our cosmetic department to understand and grow cosmetic revenue.



Develop detailed reporting of cosmetic revenue by individual service/procedure.

Track cosmetic revenue by provider, location, service, and time period.

Monitor procedure volume, revenue, average revenue per patient, and service mix.

Identify the highest-performing and underperforming cosmetic services.

Analyze trends in cosmetic services and identify areas of growth or decline.

Identify opportunities to increase utilization of existing cosmetic services.

Evaluate the financial opportunity associated with new cosmetic services, devices, and treatment offerings.

Track revenue generated from new services and initiatives.

Analyze promotional campaigns and other efforts designed to increase cosmetic revenue.

Partner with cosmetic providers and leadership to develop strategies to increase treatment volume and revenue.

Help establish measurable revenue goals for the cosmetic department and individual providers.

Provide regular reporting that clearly identifies what is driving cosmetic revenue and where additional opportunities exist.

Strategic Revenue Growth

Take a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to increase practice revenue and profitability.

Use data to develop recommendations for leadership and providers.

Develop short- and long-term revenue forecasts.

Identify opportunities to improve provider productivity and revenue.

Evaluate the financial impact of operational changes before and after implementation.

Track the results of revenue-growth initiatives and determine whether they are producing the desired results.

Identify successful strategies and recommend ways to replicate them across the practice.

Work collaboratively with physicians, cosmetic leadership, practice management, billing, coding, and administrative teams.

Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) that provide leadership with a clear understanding of practice performance.

Systems & Reporting



The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with:



Modernizing Medicine (ModMed) EHR — operational, provider, procedure, charge, and revenue-cycle reporting.

Sage Intact, financial reporting, general ledger, revenue reporting, budgeting, and financial analysis.

Microsoft Excel and/or other business intelligence and reporting tools.



Experience building dashboards, automated reports, data analysis tools, and financial models is highly desirable.



Key Performance Indicators



This position will be responsible for developing and monitoring meaningful KPIs, which may include:



Revenue by provider

Revenue by location

Revenue by procedure/service

Collections and collection rate

Charges vs. payments

Net revenue

A/R aging

Days in A/R

Denial rate

Payer reimbursement trends

Provider productivity

Revenue per visit

Revenue per procedure

Procedure/service mix

Cosmetic revenue by service

Cosmetic revenue by provider

Cosmetic treatment volume

Average cosmetic revenue per patient

Year-over-year and month-over-month revenue trends

Revenue compared with budget and forecast

title: Recruiting and Onboarding Specialist
description:
Remote | Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM-5:00 PM Eastern Time



About the Role

Paybility is seeking a highly organized, energetic, and results-driven Recruiting & Onboarding Specialist to manage our recruiting and new-hire onboarding process from start to finish.

This is not a passive administrative recruiting role. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of hiring needs, actively source candidates, manage multiple recruiting pipelines, conduct initial interviews, coordinate final interviews, and guide new hires through onboarding and training.



One of the primary responsibilities of this position will be maintaining a consistent pipeline of qualified candidates for our commission-only Solutions Consultant sales positions, with an expected goal of successfully moving approximately 2-3 qualified Solutions Consultant candidates per week through the recruiting process, in addition to supporting other positions as hiring needs arise.



The ideal candidate has previous recruiting experience, is comfortable working independently, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and understands that successful recruiting requires proactive sourcing rather than simply waiting for applications to arrive.





Full-Cycle Recruiting

Own assigned job openings from initial posting through final interview coordination.

Responsibilities include:

• Create, publish, update, and manage job postings across platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn, Zoho Recruit, social media, job boards, recruiting communities, and other sourcing channels.

• Proactively search for and identify potential candidates rather than relying exclusively on inbound applicants.

• Develop sourcing strategies for difficult-to-fill positions.

• Maintain an active candidate pipeline for commission-only Solutions Consultant opportunities.

• Review resumes and applications daily.

• Conduct candidate screening calls and preliminary interviews.

• Assess candidates for experience, communication ability, motivation, culture fit, availability, and role-specific qualifications.

• Clearly explain commission-based opportunities to candidates so expectations are understood before advancing them.

• Identify candidates most likely to succeed in independent, performance-driven sales environments.

• Schedule qualified candidates for final interviews with company leadership.

• Follow up consistently with candidates throughout the interview process.

• Maintain professional communication with candidates, including those who are not selected.

• Reduce candidate drop-off through timely communication and follow-up.

• Maintain accurate candidate records, interview notes, statuses, and documentation within Zoho Recruit.

• Build and maintain talent pipelines for future positions.



Recruiting Production Expectations

This position will be measured by results, consistency, organization, and candidate quality.

Primary expectations include:

• Maintain a continuous pipeline of Solutions Consultant candidates.

• Work toward delivering approximately 2-3 qualified Solutions Consultant candidates through the recruiting process each week.

• Support recruiting for additional Paybility positions as needed.

• Consistently maintain enough sourcing activity to prevent recruiting pipelines from becoming empty.

• Provide leadership with regular recruiting pipeline updates.

• Identify recruiting bottlenecks and recommend improvements.

• Track recruiting activity and hiring metrics.

• Networking and talent communities

• Additional sourcing tools identified by the company



You should be comfortable experimenting with messaging, job titles, posting strategies, and sourcing methods to determine what produces the strongest candidates.

Interview notes and recommendations should be clearly documented so leadership can quickly understand why a candidate is being recommended.



Onboarding & New-Hire Management

Your responsibility does not end when a candidate accepts an offer.

You will own the administrative and coordination portions of the onboarding process through completion of the company's new-hire onboarding and training period.



Recruiting Operations

You will also help maintain and improve the recruiting system itself.

Responsibilities may include:

• Maintain recruiting workflows inside Zoho Recruit.

• Keep candidate statuses current.

• Create recruiting templates and
 sequences.

• Maintain interview scheduling processes.

• Organize candidate documentation.

• Maintain recruiting dashboards and reports.

• Track recruiting metrics.

• Identify ineffective job postings or sourcing channels.

• Recommend process improvements.

• Maintain recruiting calendars.

• Maintain onboarding checklists and workflows.

• Develop candidate pipelines for future hiring needs.



Required Experience

Candidates should have:

• Previous professional recruiting, talent acquisition, staffing, or HR recruiting experience.

• Experience screening and interviewing candidates.

• Experience managing multiple open positions simultaneously.

• Experience sourcing candidates through online recruiting platforms.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Excellent organizational skills.

• Strong attention to detail.

• Professional communication skills.

• Confidence speaking with candidates by phone or video.

• Ability to manage deadlines without constant supervision.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong follow-up habits.

• Comfort learning new software and recruiting tools.



Experience using Zoho Recruit, Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter, applicant tracking systems, CRM platforms, or similar recruiting technology is strongly preferred.



Work Schedule

This position works a consistent U.S. Eastern Time schedule:

Monday-Friday

8:30 AM-5:00 PM Eastern Time

Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours in the Philippines to maintain this schedule.  Reliable attendance during these hours is an essential requirement of the position.  Occasional schedule flexibility may be requested based on interviews, onboarding needs, or company activities.



Confidentiality & Data Protection

This position will have access to candidate resumes, contact information, employment information, compensation information, internal company information, and other confidential records.

The individual selected must demonstrate excellent judgment regarding confidential information and comply with company policies regarding data privacy, system access, password security, candidate information, and company records.



To Apply

Please submit:

1. Your resume.

2. A brief description of your previous recruiting experience.

3. The recruiting platforms and applicant tracking systems you have used.

4. Approximately how many positions or candidates you managed simultaneously in your previous recruiting roles.

5. Your experience conducting candidate screening interviews.

6. Any experience recruiting salespeople, independent contractors, commission-based positions, or difficult-to-fill roles.

7. Confirmation that you can consistently work Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM-5:00 PM Eastern Time.

8. Details regarding your internet connection and backup internet/power arrangements.
