title: Seasonal Etsy Operations Assistant – Personalized Ornament Shop
description:
Part-time | Starting 3–5 hours/week during training | Hours expected to increase during the holiday season depending on order volume | $6 USD/hour



Hi! I’m Nina, the owner of Beautiful Bella Belle, a U.S.-based Etsy shop specializing in personalized porcelain Christmas ornaments.

I’m looking for a smart, dependable, detail-oriented person to help me with day-to-day shop operations during our busy holiday season.

The position will begin with a small number of hours while we train together, with hours expected to increase during the busiest part of the season, primarily from late October through mid-December, depending on order volume.

I’m not looking for someone who already knows everything. I’m looking for someone who is careful, reliable, willing to learn, communicates well, and is comfortable asking questions when something doesn’t look right.

If we work well together, there may also be an opportunity for continued work after the holiday season.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Your first and most important responsibility will be learning how to accurately process personalized ornament orders.

This may include:

* Reviewing customer personalization 

* Identifying the correct design 

* Making simple text and personalization changes 

* Carefully checking names, dates, spelling, and wording 

* Checking spacing, alignment, font size, and overall appearance 

* Preparing production files 

* Helping submit orders to our fulfillment provider 

* Monitoring orders for problems or exceptions 



Accuracy is extremely important in this job.

Personalized products sometimes require a human eye. A name may technically fit but still need different spacing, sizing, or positioning to look right. I need someone who notices those things rather than simply clicking through the steps.



As you become comfortable with the shop, the role may grow to include:

* Routine customer service 

* Monitoring fulfillment issues 

* Creating mockups using existing templates 

* Preparing Etsy listings 

* Organizing design files 

* Other routine shop and administrative tasks 



I create the original designs and make the creative decisions, so this is not primarily a graphic-design position.

There is one rule I care about very much:

If something doesn’t look right or you aren’t sure what to do, ask. Never guess with a customer’s order.



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



You may be a great fit if you are:

* Extremely detail-oriented 

* Reliable and consistent 

* Organized 

* Patient 

* Comfortable following detailed instructions 

* Able to learn new systems and solve problems 

* Willing to ask questions when something is unclear 

* Honest about mistakes and willing to help fix them 

* Comfortable communicating with me as we work and train together 



Excellent spoken and written English is required.

You should be able to communicate comfortably with me in English during occasional video calls and, after training, communicate clearly and warmly with customers in writing.

You should also be comfortable using a computer and learning new online tools and software.

Canva familiarity is helpful but not required. I can teach you how I use it.

Customer service, administrative, e-commerce, or personalized-product experience is also helpful.

Prior Etsy or print-on-demand experience is NOT required. I care much more about attention to detail, judgment, reliability, communication, and willingness to learn than having a perfect résumé.



HOURS & PAY



This is a part-time seasonal position.

We will begin with approximately 3–5 hours per week during training. Based on the volume I experienced last holiday season, I expect hours to increase during the busiest period, primarily from late October through mid-December, although the exact number of hours will depend on order volume.

During the busiest weeks, I will need someone who can check in and work consistently across multiple days of the week rather than completing all work in one weekly session.

Starting pay: $6 USD/hour.

Training and any practical skills test after the initial screening will be paid.

There may be an opportunity for additional hours and continued work after the holiday season for the right person.



WHAT IT’S LIKE WORKING WITH ME



I’ve run my Etsy business for many years, but this is my first time hiring a virtual assistant.

I will provide training, examples, written instructions, and feedback. You will not be expected to know everything immediately.

I care a great deal about the quality of the products my customers receive, but I also understand that mistakes happen. What matters to me is that you communicate openly if something goes wrong so we can address it and fix it together.

Reliability, honesty, communication, attention to detail, and willingness to learn matter enormously to me.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please complete both steps:

1. Reply to this OnlineJobs.ph job post with:

    * Your résumé/CV 

    * A short introduction about yourself 

    * Your current work situation and general availability 

2. Complete this short screening questionnaire:







The questionnaire tests basic reading comprehension, attention to detail, instruction-following, and judgment. You do not need Etsy or print-on-demand experience to complete it.

Applicants who do well in the first screening will be invited to the next stage, which may include a small paid practical test followed by a short video interview.



Thank you for taking the time to apply. I’m looking forward to meeting you!



Nina

Beautiful Bella Belle

This is NOT cold calling. You will be contacting warm leads who have already responded to our advertising and expressed interest in participating in one of our portrait projects.



Your job is simple: connect with interested leads, create excitement about their portrait experience, answer questions, overcome objections, and get qualified clients booked on our calendar.



What You’ll Do



* Make high-volume outbound calls to warm leads

* Follow up with leads by phone and text

* Build excitement around our portrait projects

* Follow our proven booking script and process

* Answer common questions and confidently handle objections

* Collect the required $214 refundable booking retainer to secure appointments

* Schedule clients accurately on our calendar

* Maintain detailed notes and lead statuses in our CRM

* Follow up consistently with leads who don’t book on the first call

* Meet daily and weekly booking and activity goals



Who We’re Looking For



You should be:



* Excellent on the phone

* Warm, upbeat, confident and personable

* Persistent without being pushy

* Comfortable asking for payment and closing appointments

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls every day

* Able to follow a script while still sounding natural

* Coachable and receptive to call reviews and feedback

* Competitive and motivated by measurable goals

* Organized and reliable

* Comfortable working independently from home



Experience



Previous experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred:



* Appointment setting

* Outbound sales

* B2C phone sales

* Lead follow-up

* Call center sales

* High-volume telephone work



Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM is a plus but not required.



Technical Requirements



You must have:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* A quality headset

* A quiet, professional workspace

* Reliable computer

* Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

* Experience using Go High Level CRM



Compensation



Hourly base pay- $810 per hour / 40 hours a week + Bonuses when KPI's are exceeded



How Success Is Measured



This is a performance-driven position. We track:



* Call activity

* Contact rate

* Lead follow-up

* Appointments booked

* Booking retainers collected

* Appointment show rate

* Lead-to-booking conversion



Our goal is not simply to fill the calendar. We want qualified, excited clients who actually show up for their appointments.



IMPORTANT – How to Apply



Please do NOT send only a résumé.



Send us:



1. A brief description of your outbound calling/appointment-setting / sales experience.

2. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

3. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and telling us why you would be great at booking warm leads over the phone.

5. Your resume

6. Lastly: Do you feel comfortable having open and emotionally driven conversations?



Send ONE
 with everything to:







Thank you

title: Referral & Prior Authorization Specialist — Remote (eClinicalWorks)
description:
Maverick Medical is a solo-physician primary care practice in California. We're hiring a remote Referral & Prior Authorization Specialist to own the entire referral lifecycle — not just place referrals, but close them. This is a phone-forward role. If you like clean handoffs, persistent follow-up, and closing loops nobody else will chase, you'll do well here.



**What you'll do**



- Place and track all outgoing referrals in eClinicalWorks

- Obtain prior authorizations from Medicare Advantage, Medi-Cal, IPA, and commercial plans; track pending, appeal denials, and re-authorize before expiration

- Call specialist offices to confirm receipt, confirm the patient was actually scheduled, and chase the consult note back

- Scan and attach returned consult notes to the chart, then close the referral in eCW

- Call pharmacies on medication issues: rejections, PA requirements, refill problems, and prior auth submissions through CoverMyMeds

- Build and maintain our specialist roster — which offices accept each plan, current fax numbers, portal logins, scheduling turnaround, and who reliably returns consult notes. Flag specialists we should stop sending patients to

- Report weekly on open referrals, pending authorizations, and anything stuck



**Requirements**



- 2+ years of referrals and/or prior authorizations in a US medical practice

- Hands-on eClinicalWorks experience — tell us how long and which modules

- Working knowledge of Medicare Advantage, Medi-Cal, and IPA authorization rules

- Excellent spoken English; you will be on the phone with US offices, health plans, and pharmacies all day

- Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, headset, and a private area for HIPAA compliance

- Available during Pacific Time business hours

- Willing to sign a Business Associate Agreement



**First 30 days**



Deliver a complete specialist roster in a shared spreadsheet, and clear the existing backlog of open referrals older than 30 days.



**How to apply — required**



Applications without the video will not be reviewed.



Submit a 60–90 second unlisted video (YouTube, Loom, or Google Drive link) of yourself speaking English, covering:



1. Your name and where you're located

2. Your referral and prior authorization experience, and your eCW experience specifically

3. Walk us through this: a patient needs a cardiology referral, the plan requires prior auth, and the specialist's office hasn't responded to two faxes. What are your next steps?



Include your resume and your hourly rate expectation.

title: Earthwork 3D modeler
description:
Earthwork 3D Modeling Specialist (Remote)



Nationwide Sports Construction is a rapidly growing U.S.-based sitework and sports construction company. We perform earthwork, grading, drainage, and synthetic turf projects throughout the United States.



We are seeking a highly detail-oriented Earthwork 3D Modeling Specialist to support our estimating team by creating 3D model take offs for earthwork.



This is a long-term remote position with opportunities for growth as our company continues to expand.

title: LOCAL SEO SPECIALIST — GBP + WORDPRESS/ELEMENTOR (AI-ASSISTED)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Long-term role. Paid test project before hire.



We do local SEO for US home service businesses: HVAC, chimney, garage

door, air duct cleaning, and similar trades. The job is simple to describe

and hard to do: get our clients into the top 3 of the Google Maps pack in

their city, and keep them there.



We are hiring ONE person to own the local SEO work across our client

accounts.



We work with AI. Claude is part of our daily workflow, it builds pages,

writes drafts, and handles repetitive work. Your job is to know what good

local SEO looks like, direct the AI, and catch it when it is wrong. If you

are not already using AI in your work, this role is not for you.



You do not need to know our exact system , we record every process and we

train you. But you need to already understand local SEO. We are not

teaching it from zero on our clients' accounts.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Optimize and manage Google Business Profiles: categories, services,

  descriptions, products, photos, Q&A, posts, review responses

- Audit client websites and fix what is holding the map pack ranking back

- Build and optimize service pages in WordPress using Elementor

- On-page SEO: titles, meta, headings, internal linking, schema

- Citations and local listings (Bing, Apple Maps, Yelp, BBB, and others)

- Off-page: local link building, chamber of commerce, sponsorships,

  community and press mentions

- Use Claude to speed up research, drafts, and page builds; then review

  and fix the output before it goes live

- Track rankings with geo-grid tools and report what moved and why



This is back-end work. No sales calls and no client calls.



MUST HAVE (we will verify these)



- 1+ years hands-on local SEO: Google Business Profile optimization and

  Google Maps ranking

- At least one business you personally moved into the top 3 of the map

  pack , you will give us the business name and city so we can check it

- You already use AI (Claude or ChatGPT) in your SEO work every week, and

  you know where NOT to trust it

- WordPress: comfortable building and editing pages, no hand-holding

- Elementor: you can build a service page from scratch and match an

  existing design. Not optional ; most of our sites run on it

- Solid written English, and able to explain your own approach in your

  own words

- Reliable internet and a backup plan for outages



PREFERRED (not required, but it moves you to the top of the list)



- US home service / trades clients

- Link building and off-page SEO

- AI search optimization ; getting a business cited and recommended by

  ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity (sometimes called

  GEO or AEO). Entity building, schema, semantic triples, llms.txt

- Claude Code, Claude Projects, or MCP — anything beyond basic chat

- GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Rank Math or Yoast, schema markup, Google Search Console

- Geo-grid rank tracking tools (Local Dominator, Local Falcon, or similar)



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Recorded training on our exact process and checklists

- Ongoing lessons and feedback 

- All tools and access you need, including AI tools

- Long-term, stable work with room to grow as we add clients



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic application. Use AI to help you write if you want,

but the answers must be your own.



1. Put MAPPACK at the start of your application subject line.



2. Answer these — short and specific beats long:

   a) One Google Business Profile you ranked: business name, city,

      industry, where it started, where it ended up, how long it took,

      and what you actually did. We will look it up.

   b) A client is stuck at #7 in the map pack for their main service.

      What are the first three things you check, and why?

   c) One page you built in Elementor , send the live URL.

   d) Your experience with link building for local businesses.

   e) How you use AI in your SEO work: one task you use it for, and one

      task where you do NOT trust it and do the work yourself.

   f) Optional — if you have experience with AI search visibility

      (getting a business recommended by ChatGPT or Google AI Overviews):

      what have you actually done for a client, and how did you know it

      worked?



3. Tell us your available working hours in US Central Time.



Shortlisted applicants get two more steps: a short video walkthrough of

one case study (2-3 minutes, Loom or Google Drive, screen share is fine 

we want to hear how you think), then a paid test project before we make

an offer.



If you have not done this kind of work, please do not apply, we would

rather you spend your time on a role that fits.

title: Senior Video Editor - Freelance
description:
Location: Fully Remote

Company: Thesis



About Thesis:

The human brain is the most complex object in the universe, yet society has accepted one-size-fits all approaches to cognition. The “solutions” (think coffee, energy drinks, and even a friend’s rx) were mediocre at best and frankly, made no sense to us. So, we created Thesis, the world’s first customized nootropics company. If you’ve never heard that word before, it’s just a fancy way of saying brain supplements. In five years, most will be taking nootropics on the daily and chances are, they’ll be ours.



With an exceptional efficacy rate, the world has taken notice - we've raised over $14M in venture capital, garnered interest from leading neuroscientists and athletes, and established ourselves as an industry-leading brand. We partner with exceptional independent creative talent to help us share the gift of enhanced cognitive function with the world.



What we’re looking for:



You have 2+ years experience in video editing

You’ve worked on video ads for DTC and E-commerce brands

You’ve produced high-performing video ads such as UGC ads, podcast ads, AI ads, etc.

You’re fluent in English and are confident communicating on calls (both internally and externally)

You’re open minded and willing to learn

You’re able to take feedback and use your initiative to manage video revisions

You communicate proactively like telling a manager when you have a problem and your output will be delayed

You use Instagram/TikTok in your free time… sometimes you feel you spend a bit too much time on there - but at least you know the platform well!

You’ll be creating the video ads that help drive our growth. This is a hands-on creative role where you’ll have the opportunity to experiment, move fast, and see your work reach a massive audience.

Create high-performing video ads for paid social channels including Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, turning raw footage and ideas into content that grabs attention and drives action.

Collaborate closely with our Creative team to bring new concepts to life, iterate on winning ads, and constantly find ways to make our creative better.

Own your edits from start to finish, making sure every video is polished, on-brand, and ready to launch on time.

Stay obsessed with what’s working. Keep a pulse on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and the broader paid social landscape to spot emerging trends, formats, hooks, and creative ideas before they become stale.

Experiment constantly. Test new hooks, cuts, formats, storytelling approaches, and creative angles to uncover the next big winner.



Learn from performance. This isn’t just about making great-looking videos. You’ll see how your creative performs in the real world and use that feedback to make the next round even stronger.



How We Work Together



We’re a collaborative, high-ownership team that cares much more about the quality and impact of your work than where you’re sitting or how many hours you’re staring at your screen.

Slack: Our home base for communication, collaboration, quick feedback, and an appropriate amount of GIFs and memes.

Freedom + Accountability: No screen monitoring. No time tracking. No micromanagement. We trust talented people to do great work and hold themselves accountable.

title: Director of business operations and systems

DIRECTOR OF BUSINESS OPERATIONS AND SYSTEMS

WORK SETUP: Fully remote and full time

Position Summary



High Meadows Resorts is developing a luxury destination property in Ellicottville, New York, with 17 rentalvillas, a full-service restaurant, and an event center serving banquet, corporate gatherings, wellness retreats,celebrations, and group stays.



We are seeking a senior hospitality operator to build the commercial and operating foundation before opening and strengthen it as the business grows. This person will own business development, financial models, operating systems, software integration, workforce planning, and team adherence to agreed processes. The role works directly with the owner and must be comfortable testing assumptions, identifying risk, and recommending better options with clear financial and operational reasoning.



Key Responsibilities



Business Development and Commercial Planning

•Build and maintain pro formas for the restaurant, villas, event center, and related revenue opportunities. Modelsshould cover demand, pricing, occupancy, average daily rate, food and labor costs, fixed costs, cash flow, andbreak-even scenarios.

•Develop budgets, forecasts, pricing recommendations, and management dashboards with clear assumptions andmeasurable targets.

•Create partnership, referral, group sales, and event pipelines with defined stages, owners, follow-up standards,conversion measures, and booked revenue reporting.



Operating Systems and Guest Journey

•Map and improve the full guest journey from inquiry and booking through pre-arrival, check-in, stay, issue recovery,check-out, and post-stay follow-up.

•Create SOPs, checklists, handoffs, approval limits, quality controls, and escalation paths for reservations,housekeeping, maintenance, dining, events, and guest services.

•Establish system governance through assigned owners, version control, training records, compliance reviews,exception reporting, and regular improvement cycles.



Technology and Software Integration

•Define requirements and lead vendor evaluation for the website, booking engine, property management system,channel manager, CRM, point-of-sale, payments, accounting, guest messaging, housekeeping, workforce scheduling,and analytics tools.

•Design the integration map for data flow, permissions, ownership, reporting, handoffs, and failure contingencies.

•Coordinate configuration, testing, training, staff acceptance, and launch readiness with internal owners and externalvendors.



Workforce Planning and Operating Discipline

•Develop the organization structure, role definitions, manpower plan, housekeeping turnover model, shift schedules,coverage rules, and labor forecasts.

•Track pre-opening dependencies, decisions, risks, and deadlines across lodging, dining, events, facilities, finance,and marketing.

•Coach managers on how each system should be used, verify adherence through operating reviews, and challengeleadership respectfully when evidence or unit economics do not support a proposed approach.



Required Qualifications



•At least 10 years of progressive experience in business development, operations, systems, and protocols.

•Demonstrated financial fluency in pro formas, P&L management, budgeting, forecasting, pricing, labor modeling, andperformance reporting.

•Proven experience building SOPs, controls, workflows, and accountability systems and achieving sustained teamadoption.

•Experience in business software. Programming is not required, but the candidatemust understand requirements,data, testing, implementation, and vendor management.

•Strong written and spoken English, executive-level communication, and the ability to work independently while maintaining reliable overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



Paid Trial and Hiring Process



Shortlisted finalists will be invited to a paid trial lasting one to two weeks under a written scope before either partymakes a long-term commitment. The assignment may include a focused restaurant pro forma, guest check-inworkflow, software integration map, KPI dashboard, or short operating plan using information supplied by thecompany.

Evaluation will focus on commercial reasoning, systems design, prioritization, constructive challenge, executionquality, communication, and working fit.



How to Apply



Apply through the platform where this vacancy is posted. Include your resume, a short note explaining why the rolefits your background, and one anonymized work sample such as a pro forma, operating dashboard, SOP, systemsmap, or pre-opening plan.

•State your earliest available start date, expected U.S. Eastern Time overlap, and compensation expectations.

title: E-Commerce Operations Manager – Shopify
description:
E-Commerce Operations Manager – Shopify



Location: Remote – Philippines

Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

Schedule: Fixed U.S. Eastern Time

Compensation: ~USD $1,800/month, depending on experience



**Please read this listing in full. Applications that do not follow the instructions at the end will not be considered.



About the Role



We are an established pet supplies e-commerce company looking for a hands-on E-Commerce Operations Manager to own and grow our Shopify store.



This is not primarily a delegation or team-coordination role. You will personally manage the day-to-day store, analyze performance, improve conversion, create campaigns and content, handle customer inquiries, maintain inventory accuracy, and continuously look for ways to increase revenue and profitability.



You will report to the General Manager and work with a small remote team, including a Graphic Designer and external marketing partners.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Shopify & E-Commerce Growth

* Own the day-to-day management of our Shopify store.

* Manage products, collections, merchandising, pricing, inventory, promotions, apps, and website content.

* Monitor and improve revenue, conversion rate, AOV, engagement, and other key e-commerce metrics.

* Identify CRO opportunities and improve product pages, navigation, landing pages, offers, and onsite messaging.

* Recommend promotions and other initiatives to grow profitable sales.

* Proactively identify and fix website issues rather than waiting for them to be assigned.



2.
, Content & SEO

* Plan, write, build, and schedule
/newsletter campaigns.

* Write and improve product descriptions, landing pages, collection copy, and promotional content.

* Perform keyword research and on-page SEO.

* Create, refresh, and fact-check AI-assisted blog content.

* Develop enough product knowledge to create accurate content and confidently research information when needed.



3. Analytics & Reporting

* Analyze Shopify and GA4 performance and explain why results are changing.

* Maintain a weekly e-commerce performance scorecard.

* To confirm that you read the entire listing, include your favorite cartoon cat in the first sentence of your cover letter.

* Prepare basic profitability reports covering revenue, COGS, shipping, ad spend, discounts, and other major expenses.

* Understand Google Ads reporting well enough to evaluate paid traffic and collaborate with our advertising agency.

* Turn data into specific recommendations and actions.



4. Customer Service & Operations

* Personally handle our relatively low volume of customer inquiries.

* Process orders with dropshipping suppliers according to existing SOPs.

* Ensure orders are sent accurately and on time.

* Maintain accurate inventory availability and pricing.

* Follow through on issues until they are actually resolved.



This Is a Hands-On Role



Although this is a manager-level position, we are a small company and expect this person to be comfortable doing the work, not simply delegating it.



If a newsletter needs to be built, you should be able to build it. If an image needs a simple resize, you should be able to resize it. If product copy needs improvement, you should be able to rewrite it. If an app isn't working, you should investigate the problem and look for a solution or workaround. Routine execution is part of this role.



What We're Looking For:

* 5+ years of relevant e-commerce experience preferred, with meaningful hands-on Shopify experience.

* Demonstrated experience improving e-commerce sales or conversion - not just maintaining a website.

* Strong understanding of Shopify, CRO, merchandising, and e-commerce best practices.

* Experience with GA4 and e-commerce reporting.

* Experience with Klaviyo or similar
 marketing platforms.

* Working knowledge of Google Merchant Center and Google Ads reporting.

* Experience with SEO and tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar.

* Strong copywriting and editing skills.

* Comfortable calculating basic store profitability.

* Basic Liquid/HTML/CSS knowledge is a plus, but development expertise is not required.

* Excellent written and spoken English.



We want someone who is proactive, analytical, resourceful, trustworthy, detail-oriented, and highly accountable.



We value people who find solutions rather than simply report blockers. We also expect honesty and ownership when something goes wrong. Mistakes can happen; concealing or misrepresenting them is unacceptable.



How Success Will Be Measured:



You will have meaningful ownership of Shopify performance, including:

* Revenue growth

* Conversion rate

* AOV and website engagement

*
/promotional performance

* Inventory and order accuracy

* Profitability and reporting

* Successful execution of CRO and website improvements



You will participate in a weekly e-commerce meeting and should be able to explain what happened, why it happened, what you're doing about it, and what you recommend next.



Work Arrangement & Benefits:

* Full-time, 40+ hours/week on a fixed U.S. Eastern Time schedule.

* Remote position for candidates based in the Philippines.

* Exclusive professional commitment required; side jobs/freelancing are not permitted.

* Productivity tracking with periodic screenshots is required.

* Performance-based bonuses and 13th-month pay.

* Unlimited PTO upon regularization.



How to Apply:



Please send your resume and a short cover letter.



In your cover letter, briefly describe one specific improvement you personally made to a Shopify/e-commerce store that produced a measurable result. Tell us the problem, what you personally did, and the result.



Selected candidates will go through an interview, a short practical exercise, and professional reference checks.

Good written English

Able to take direction and iterate without ego

Reliable communication (WhatsApp/Slack, reply within 24h)



Nice to have



Knowledge of EU food labelling layout requirements

Motion / social content skills



How to apply

A link to your portfolio, with 2–3 packaging projects you personally worked on

One example of a print-ready file you prepared for a manufacturer (screenshot of the layered artwork on a dieline is fine)

Your price for the full package described above (logo + brand kit + 3 pouch designs + production files), and your rate per additional pouch design

Your available hours per week

Start your message with the word "JELLY" so we know you read the whole post

Job Description



We’re hiring a Pinterest Manager to take full ownership of our Pinterest presence and turn it into a high-performing sales channel.



This role owns both organic Pinterest growth and Pinterest Ads performance, with a strong focus on turning Pinterest into a scalable paid acquisition channel.



This is not a generic social media role—we’re looking for someone who deeply understands how the Pinterest platform works, from its search algorithm and Smart Feed to pin formats, trends, and conversion paths. Your goal: drive meaningful traffic and sales from Pinterest through smart, strategic execution.



Mission Statement: Build and scale a Pinterest strategy that doesn’t just look good—but performs. You will grow impressions, increase outbound clicks, and **drive profitable revenue through both organic content and paid Pinterest campaigns.



Primary Responsibilities





Pinterest Organic Strategy & Execution

Content Creation & Scheduling

title: Video Editor – Junior & Senior Profiles
description:
Video Editor – Junior & Senior Profiles



We’re looking for Video Editors to join us initially on a contract basis, with the potential to grow into a full-time opportunity.

We are open to two very different profiles:



1. Junior / Intermediate Video Editor — little or no professional experience, but creative, curious, and eager to learn and build a portfolio.

2. Senior Video Editor — experienced, technically strong, and able to independently deliver professional-quality work.



Profile 1: Junior / Intermediate Video Editor



You do not need professional video editing experience.

We’re looking for someone who:

* Has basic knowledge of video editing using DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, or similar

* Is creative and has a good eye for visuals

* Understands Instagram, YouTube, Reels, and social content

* Is interested in learning video editing professionally

* Is curious about AI tools and new ways of creating content

* Learns quickly and is willing to figure things out independently

* Takes feedback well

* Is reliable, punctual, and respects deadlines

* Can work independently once the task is explained



You don’t need to know advanced color grading, Fusion, audio post-production, or professional delivery settings yet.

We can teach you the technical skills. We’re looking for creativity, curiosity, and the right attitude.

This is an opportunity to build your portfolio, work on real client projects, learn, and get paid while developing your skills.

Our starting budget for the Junior / Intermediate profile is approximately $200/month, based on the initial scope and experience level.



Profile 2: Senior Video Editor



We’re also looking for someone with approximately 3–4+ years of professional video editing experience who can work independently and consistently deliver high-quality content .





Strong experience with DaVinci Resolve:



* Color correction and grading

* Color spaces and color profiles

* Fusion

* AI transcription

* Audio post-production

* Professional delivery workflows

* Export settings for Instagram and YouTube

or

Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro:

* Professional editing workflows

* MOGRT files and titles

* Project and sequence setup

* Color spaces and color profiles

* Audio

* Export and delivery settings

* Instagram and YouTube optimization



We’re looking for someone who understands the technical side inside and out, but also has a strong creative eye and understands pacing, storytelling, hooks, and what makes social content engaging.



For Senior candidates, compensation can be based on an hourly rate or another agreed arrangement based on experience and output.



Initial Scope of Work

The initial workload will be approximately:



* 3–5 videos per day

* Approximately 2–4 hours of work per day

* Primarily Instagram Reels and other short-form content

* Some longer YouTube videos, generally up to approximately 3 minutes



The client will provide the primary video content.

There may occasionally be a need to use Storyblocks or another stock-footage provider for additional footage.

The engagement will start as a contract, with an opportunity to transition into a full-time role for the right person.



For Both Profiles – Flexibility, Ownership & Trust

We offer full flexibility in your working hours. We don’t care whether you work early in the morning, late at night, or organize your day around other commitments.

What we care about is that the work gets done, deadlines are respected, and the quality is there.



You need to be able to self-manage your time and your work. We don’t have the time or desire to constantly check what you’re doing, how many hours you’re working, or whether every task has been completed correctly.

Our working relationship is based primarily on trust and ownership.

We trust you to manage your time, check your own work before delivery, communicate when there is a problem, and deliver what you committed to.



In return, you get a high level of independence and flexibility.



You will also need to:



* Attend scheduled weekly check-in meetings

* Be available through WhatsApp or another communication app when important client or delivery questions come up

* Communicate clearly if something will affect a deadline

* Take ownership of your work and quality

* Be punctual and respect other people’s time



IMPORTANT – How to Apply



Please make it very clear which profile you’re applying for.



Junior / Intermediate



Your
 subject line MUST be:



FF Junior Video Editor + [X] Years Experience + $[Expected Monthly Rate]



Example:



FF Junior Video Editor + 1 Year Experience + $250/month



No experience is completely fine:



Junior Video Editor + 0 Years Experience + $200/month



Senior



Your
 subject line MUST be:



Senior Video Editor + [X] Years Experience + $[Hourly Rate] + $[Full-Time Salary Expectation]



Example:



Senior Video Editor + 5 Years Experience + $15/hr + $2,500/month Full-Time



Please include 2–3 examples of your best video editing work.



For Junior candidates, these don’t need to be professional projects. Personal projects, school work, Instagram/TikTok/Reels, YouTube videos, or anything you’ve created is completely fine.



We’re not necessarily looking for the person with the longest résumé. We’re looking for someone creative, dependable, self-managed, and interested in growing with us.



I especially like the “we don’t care when you work; we care that the work gets done” positioning for this role. It makes the flexibility attractive while being very clear that you don’t want to manage someone day-to-day.

title: Firm Administrator (Operations + Billing) @ BBA Law
description:
Compensation: $2,000 USD/month



Time Commitment: ~40+ available hours/weekly



Working Hours: 8:00am–5:00pm EST (or longer as required to get the work done)



Engagement Type: Independent Contractor



Location: Remote (US-based hours required)



English Mastery and Working Culture Notice: Native-sounding and command-of-spoken English (and, of course, written English) is imperative in this role, as you will be working directly with U.S.-based Sales leadership and team members. Please do not apply if you do not meet this requirement. Additionally, prior experience working with U.S. companies and operating in fast-paced, high-performance environments is critical.



Are you driven to streamline operations while being the backbone of a thriving law firm?



Do you excel at catching errors before they become significant issues and thrive on accountability?



Can you transform operational chaos into well-oiled efficiency with minimal supervision?



Is your problem-solving proactive and innovative, capturing missed opportunities for improvement?



Final question: When faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?



The Firm Administrator at BBA Law is a newly created role that aims to streamline operations, allowing firm leadership to focus on growth and client advocacy. As the operational right hand, you will have a direct impact on improving efficiencies and ensuring the smooth functioning of firm operations, all while supporting the firm's mission of delivering superior legal solutions to Michigan families.





What you’ll do:

- Billing and Financial Oversight: Own key aspects of the billing cycle by reviewing time entries for accuracy, capturing billable activities and expenses, preparing invoices, and maintaining consistent accounts receivable follow-up.

- Operational Compliance: Monitor day-to-day staff activity and matter workflows, catching errors, missing information, and incomplete steps before they become larger operational issues.

- Lead and CRM Management: Ensure leads are accurately captured, properly tracked, and followed up on promptly, while maintaining clean CRM data and identifying opportunities to improve the intake process.

- Administrative Support: Serve as an operational extension of firm leadership, coordinating administrative priorities, supporting key workflows, and ensuring important follow-up does not fall through the cracks.

- Process Development: Build and maintain practical SOPs and repeatable processes that improve consistency, accountability, and efficiency across the firm.



What we’re looking for:

- US Law Firm Experience: Experience in law firm operations, billing, bookkeeping, or office management is preferred, with an understanding of legal workflows being a strong advantage.

- Technology Proficiency: Comfortable working in Clio or similar practice management software, CRM systems, spreadsheets, and reporting tools, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.

- Organizational Skills: Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to stay on top of multiple workflows, catch inconsistencies, and follow through without frequent reminders.

- Communication Skills: Clear and professional written and spoken English, with confidence communicating with staff, clients, vendors, and insurance providers.

- Proactive Problem Solver: Able to spot issues before they become larger problems, take initiative, and find solutions independently without requiring constant direction.

Remote Work Readiness & Reliability: Ability to work U.S. hours, with reliable access to necessary technology and demonstrated success working independently in a remote, structured work setting.



Why you should work here:

- Impactful Role: For someone who thrives on making things work better, this role offers the opportunity to create meaningful improvements that will be felt across the firm as it continues to grow.

- Autonomous Environment: Ideal for someone who does their best work with trust and independence, this role offers meaningful ownership and the freedom to drive results without constant oversight.

- Leadership Exposure: Work closely with firm leadership in a highly visible role, gaining firsthand exposure to the priorities, challenges, and day-to-day operations of a growing law firm.

- Growth Opportunity: As the firm continues to scale, this role offers the opportunity to expand your impact and take on broader operational responsibilities in a larger operational role.

title: Web3 Business Development Specialist
description:

We're a multi-chain DeFi protocol building LP Bonds, a new liquidity primitive that locks liquidity long-term while keeping user positions tradable. We need Business Development partners who can introduce us to crypto launchpads, DEXs, chains, and established crypto projects.



THE OPPORTUNITY:

 Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.

Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: Commission: 25% of all upgrade fees generated by your partnerships for the first 90 days after the partnership goes live, then 10% through month 12. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.



Bond Bonuses (based on total dollar value of bonds minted through your partnerships):

+$500 when $10,000 is reached

+$1,000 when $20,000 is reached

+$5,000 when $100,000 is reached, and another +$5,000 for every additional $100,000. No ceiling.

Bonuses are cumulative. Hit $100,000 minted and you've collected $6,500 in bonuses total. Every $100,000 after that adds another $5,000.



Note: A successful partnership means a project you introduced signs the LP Bonds integration agreement and goes live on our marketplace. You book the qualified call, I run the deal and close it.



YOU HAVE:

Existing connections in crypto (launchpads, DEXs, chains, established projects)

/
 relationships with project founders or marketing heads

Understanding of DeFi/crypto space

Hunger to earn based on results, not hours



YOU DON'T NEED:

To close deals (I handle that)

THE ROLE:

 Your job is booking qualified calls. You reach into your network, find decision-makers at crypto projects, and get them on a scheduled call with me. I close the deals, you collect appointment bonuses, commissions, and bond bonuses as your partnerships go live and grow.

Example: ONE solid launchpad partnership that mints $100,000 in bonds earns you $6,500 in bond bonuses, and with thousands of bondholders paying upgrade fees, your 25% commission pushes your total past $8,000.

Ready to turn your crypto connections into serious income?

Your
 handle

title: BD Manager - Crypto DeFi Partnerships (Uncapped Bonuses)
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Social Media VA: For an Online Book Launch Campaign
description:
Social Media VA Wanted: Help Us Launch a Book People Can't Stop Talking About

Pay: $425/month (~15 hrs/week, roughly $6–7/hr) Schedule: Weekdays only — no weekend posting required Start: ASAP Engagement: This is a paid trial period during our book launch/presale phase. If it's a good fit on both sides, this converts into an ongoing long-term role with increased hours and pay as scope grows.



About the Role

We're launching a new book and need a sharp, creative, reliable social media VA to run day-to-day content and community engagement during the presale and launch period.

We'll share the specific book, genre, and brand voice during the interview — for now, what matters most is that you know how to run a book launch on social media: build hype, turn reviews into content, and keep momentum going daily.

This is not a "schedule 3 generic posts and walk away" role. We want someone who thinks like a book marketer.



Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Post 2–3x/day across the platforms we assign, with content tailored to each one (not the same copy/paste everywhere)

Manage multiple social accounts — the exact platforms will be confirmed during the interview, but may include a mix of
, Instagram, X 
), TikTok, Bluesky, and an author newsletter (e.g. Substack)

Set up new accounts/platforms as needed (for example, launching a new author newsletter from scratch)

Drive presale promotion with ongoing content specifically built to convert followers into pre-orders

Repurpose reviews & UGC — when we get a media review, reader review, or influencer/creator post, turn it into multiple pieces of fresh content (quote graphics, short video, carousel posts, Stories, etc.)

Create original content — graphics, short-form video, and copy suited to each platform's style

Advise on link-in-bio strategy — help us d
 whether we need a Linktree (or similar) and what should be included, then set it up and keep it current

Administer accounts — you'll be given admin-level access to manage posting, scheduling, and basic account settings



Who We're Looking For

This role is for an experienced social media VA — please don't apply if you're just starting out. We need someone who can hit the ground running with minimal training.

2+ years managing social media accounts professionally, with a portfolio showing accounts you've grown or run — bonus points if it's for authors, books, or entertainment/media brands

A specific, measurable result you can point to (e.g. "grew an author/brand IG from 2K to 15K in 6 months" or "managed a book launch that hit X presales")

Strong eye for content — you can write engaging copy AND put together simple graphics/short video edits (Canva, CapCut, or similar)

Familiarity with BookTok / Bookstagram / book-launch marketing trends is a big plus

Comfortable working independently and proactively — you should be pitching content ideas, not just waiting for direction

Reliable weekday availability and good communication in English

Trustworthy with admin-level access to client accounts — 2 client references required



Quick Test Task (required to apply)

We get a lot of applicants, and this helps us see how you actually think about content — it should take 15–20 minutes:

Imagine we just received this reader review: "I could not put this book down. The world-building alone made me forget I had a job to go to." Show us 3 different ways you'd turn this into content across 3 different platforms (e.g. an IG Story, a TikTok concept, an X post). A few lines describing each is fine — no need for finished graphics.

How to Apply

Please include:

Your portfolio/links to social accounts you've managed, with at least one specific, measurable result

Your response to the test task above

2 client references (name + how we can reach them)

Your available hours per week and time zone

Confirmation you're available at $425/month for this trial period, with the understanding that pay and hours increase if it becomes ongoing

If you've read this closely, work your favorite color into your application somewhere — it doesn't need to be obvious. It just helps us see who reads carefully before applying.



*Note: This is a paid trial for our book launch, with strong potential to become a long-term ongoing role if it's a good fit for both of us.*

title: Social Media & Content Virtual Assistant – Chiropractic/Wellness Office
description:
We are an established chiropractic and wellness office in Michigan looking for a creative, organized Virtual Assistant to help us create, schedule, manage, and analyze our social media content.



We are not looking for someone to completely reinvent our marketing strategy. We already have an established brand, access to AI-assisted content planning, and historical
 performance data that we use to determine what types of posts perform well with our audience.



We are looking for someone who can take those recommendations and turn them into consistent, polished, engaging social media content.



Our office can provide requested photos, videos, staff information, promotions, educational topics, and other raw content as needed.



What You'll Be Doing



Your primary responsibilities will include:



Creating social media graphics in Canva

Creating and scheduling
 and Instagram posts

Following a monthly content calendar and marketing plan

Taking provided content ideas and turning them into polished social posts

Using AI-generated content recommendations and strategy as a starting point

Reviewing our
/Meta performance data to understand which types of content are performing well

Using those insights to improve future content

Identifying successful posts that could be updated, reused, or repurposed

Creating simple Reels/short-form videos using photos and video clips supplied by our office

Requesting specific photos or video clips from our team when needed

Repurposing one piece of content into multiple formats when appropriate

Maintaining consistent branding across posts

Scheduling content in advance

Keeping our monthly social media calendar organized and up to date

Helping promote office events, specials, educational topics, services, and community involvement

Providing a simple monthly summary of what performed well and what could be improved



Our content includes topics such as chiropractic care, family wellness, pediatric and pregnancy chiropractic, massage therapy, shockwave therapy, wellness services, supplements, office events, community involvement, seasonal health topics, and patient education.



A Typical Workflow



We may provide you with a monthly plan containing recommendations such as:



"Educational posts with real office photos are getting more engagement than generic graphics. This month, create more posts featuring our doctors and actual patients/office environment."



Your job would be to take that recommendation and execute it.



You might respond:



"I'd like a photo of one of the doctors adjusting an athlete and a short video showing the shockwave equipment being used."



Our office would provide the requested content.



You would then create the graphic, Reel, caption, and/or post; make sure it fits our brand; and schedule it appropriately.



We want someone who can take direction and use good judgment and creativity when executing it.



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has:



Strong Canva skills

Experience managing
 and Instagram business pages

Experience with Meta Business Suite

Strong written English

Good visual/design judgment

Experience creating social media graphics

Basic short-form video/Reel editing skills

Experience scheduling social media content

Ability to follow an established brand style

Ability to work from a content calendar

Strong organization and attention to detail

Ability to interpret basic social media analytics

Comfort working with AI-generated content and recommendations

Ability to take feedback and make revisions

Initiative to request the photos, videos, or information needed to create better content



Healthcare, chiropractic, wellness, fitness, or similar experience is a plus, but it is not required.



What We DON'T Want



We are not looking for someone who:



Posts generic motivational quotes every day

Relies entirely on stock photos

Copies and pastes AI-generated content without reviewing it

Creates overly "salesy" healthcare posts

Uses the exact same design template for every post

Posts content without understanding why we're posting it



We want our social media to feel like our actual office and community, not a generic corporate wellness page.



Schedule



Approximately 5 hours per week to start, with the possibility of additional hours as the position develops.



Most work can be completed on a flexible schedule.



Compensation



Approximately $5–$7 USD/hour, depending on experience and skill level.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position who can learn our brand and become more efficient and independent over time.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words OPTIMAL WELLNESS so we know you have read the entire posting.



Please answer the following:



How long have you worked in social media management?

Which social media accounts/platforms have you managed?

How would you rate your Canva skills?

Do you have experience with Meta Business Suite?

Do you create/edit Reels or short-form videos?

Have you worked with healthcare, chiropractic, wellness, fitness, or other local service businesses?

How do you d
 whether a social media post performed well?

How do you use previous post performance to d
 what to create next?

How do you use AI tools such as ChatGPT in your social media workflow?

How many hours per week are you available?

What is your desired hourly rate?



Please include a link to your portfolio or examples of social media pages/content you have created.



Small Application Exercise



Imagine you're managing social media for a local chiropractic and wellness office.



You are told that our
 
 show that real photos of our staff and office tend to perform better than generic stock graphics.



We want to promote a service called shockwave therapy during the coming month.



In a few sentences, tell us:



What type of post you would create

What photo or video you would request from our office

What you would do to make the post feel authentic rather than like a generic advertisement



We're more interested in your thought process than a perfect answer.



We value creativity, organization, consistency, initiative, and attention to detail. We're looking for someone who wants to learn our business and become a long-term part of our marketing team.

title: Patient Reactivation & Jane App Virtual Assistant – Chiropractic/Wellness Office

title: Sales Manager - Leadership
description:
About the Role

The Sales Manager is a key leadership role responsible for managing and scaling 123Loadboard's Philippines-based remote team, which supports the US and Canadian freight markets. This individual will oversee a distributed team of Business Development Representatives (BDRs), Carrier Sales Representatives, and Dispatchers, all working remotely from the Philippines focused entirely on acquiring and serving carriers and brokers operating across North America.

The Sales Manager's focus is on team performance, operational excellence, and ensuring the remote team operates seamlessly in alignment with US and Canadian market hours, standards, and goals. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who thrives managing remote talent, building accountability structures, and bridging the gap between Philippine-based reps and North American customers.



Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Remote Management

• Directly manage and mentor a fully remote team of BDRs, Carrier Sales Reps, and Dispatchers based in the Philippines

• Set clear performance expectations, KPIs, and accountability structures aligned with US and Canadian market goals

• Conduct regular 1:1s, team huddles, and performance reviews, coordinating schedules across time zones as needed

• Identify talent gaps and partner with HR on hiring, onboarding, and development of Philippines-based talent

• Foster a high-performance, remote-first team culture that reflects 123Loadboard's values and North American business standards

Business Development (US & Canada Market)

• Oversee BDR outreach strategy targeting carriers, shippers and freight brokers operating in the US and Canadian markets

• Partner with the VP of Sales on quota-setting, outreach cadences, and sales playbooks tailored for North American prospects

• Ensure BDRs are effectively prospecting, qualifying, and handing off leads for US and Canadian accounts

• Track and report on pipeline activity, conversion rates, and revenue contribution from the Philippines-based BDR team

Carrier Sales Operations (US & Canada)

• Ensure Carrier Sales Reps are effectively matching loads to carriers across US and Canadian lanes, maximizing coverage and minimizing empty miles

• Monitor daily North American load board activity, spot rate trends, and carrier availability

• Support the team in building and maintaining strong relationships with US and Canadian carriers

• Drive consistent adoption of 123Loadboard platform tools and best practices across the remote team

Dispatch Oversight

• Supervise the remote Dispatcher team to ensure timely, accurate load assignments and proactive communication with US and Canadian carriers

• Establish and enforce SOPs for dispatch workflows, check calls, and issue escalation with clear expectations for operating in North American time zones

• Collaborate with Carrier Sales Reps to align dispatch capacity with load volume across key US and Canadian lanes

Reporting & Operational Alignment

• Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports to the VP of Sales covering team metrics, productivity, and pipeline health

• Ensure the Philippines-based team is aligned with US and Canadian market hours, communication standards, and customer expectations

• Surface process improvements, tooling gaps, and resourcing needs proactively

• Serve as the primary liaison between Philippines-based reps and US-based leadership



Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, or operations, ideally within freight, logistics, or transportation

• 2+ years of people management experience, with a proven track record of leading remote or distributed teams

• Strong understanding of freight brokerage, carrier sales, and/or dispatch operations in North American markets

• Comfortable operating in US and/or Canadian time zones and managing a team that does the same

• Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal) — the primary language of all customer-facing and internal work

• Proven ability to drive accountability and results in a remote, metrics-driven environment

• Proficiency with CRM systems, load boards, and standard business productivity and communication tools

Preferred

• Direct experience supporting US or Canadian freight brokers or carriers in a remote capacity

• Familiarity with 123Loadboard or similar platforms (DAT, Truckstop, etc.)

• Experience managing BPO or offshore teams serving North American clients

• Background in scaling remote teams from early-stage operations



What Success Looks Like

Timeframe Milestone

30 Days Deep understanding of team structure, current KPIs, tooling, and open gaps. Relationships established with all direct reports.

60 Days Process improvements identified and implemented for BDR outreach cadence, carrier sales workflows, and dispatch SOPs.

90 Days Team hitting or trending toward baseline KPIs. Regular reporting cadence established with VP of Sales.

6 Months Demonstrable growth in active carrier accounts and load coverage. Clear development plans in place for all team members.



Why 123Loadboard

• Lead and shape a high-impact remote team serving one of the world's largest freight markets — the US and Canada

• High-visibility role working directly with US-based leadership

• Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives

• A fast-growing, technology-driven freight platform with 35,000+ active carriers

• Remote-first culture that values ownership, accountability, and results
