title: Client Care & Intern Support Coordinator
description:
Client Care & Intern Support Coordinator



Edify Counseling Group | Remote Position



Edify Counseling Group is seeking a dependable, organized, professional, and personable Client Care & Intern Support Coordinator to join our growing team.



This position supports two important areas of our practice: client care and intern coordination. The Coordinator will help ensure that new and existing clients receive timely, professional support while also helping our clinical interns stay organized, engaged, and productive within the Edify system.



We are looking for someone who communicates well, follows through, takes initiative, and understands that excellent client care begins from the very first phone call or message.



Key Responsibilities

Client Care & Onboarding

Answer incoming calls and return missed calls promptly.

Follow up with new clients who have expressed interest in counseling services.

Assist new clients throughout the onboarding process.

Help ensure clients complete necessary onboarding steps before their appointments.

Coordinate appointments, scheduling, and rescheduling.

Follow up with clients who have not completed scheduling or onboarding.

Reactivate inactive clients through appropriate outreach and follow-up.

Assist with appointment reminders and other client-care communication.

Help ensure clients feel welcomed, informed, and supported throughout their experience with Edify.

Maintain timely, professional, and compassionate communication with clients.

Escalate client concerns or situations requiring additional assistance to the appropriate team member.

Scheduling & Follow-Up

Coordinate client appointments with clinician and intern availability.

Monitor scheduling needs and follow up on outstanding appointments.

Help fill available appointment openings when appropriate.

Maintain accurate scheduling information.

Follow up on cancellations and rescheduling needs.

Help ensure new client inquiries do not go unanswered or become lost during the onboarding process.

Intern Support & Coordination

Maintain regular communication with Edify Counseling Group interns.

Assist with intern scheduling, communication, organization, and workflow coordination.

Help connect interns with appropriate intake opportunities as they build their caseloads.

Maintain organized information regarding intern availability and assignments.

Follow up with interns regarding outstanding administrative responsibilities.

Communicate important intern updates, scheduling concerns, or workflow barriers to leadership.

Help interns remain engaged and productive during their internship experience.



The Coordinator will also use Edify's Intern Task List as a guide when delegating appropriate administrative and non-direct-client-contact responsibilities to interns.



Our goal is to provide interns with meaningful responsibilities that support Edify Counseling Group while also allowing them to make productive use of their internship hours and gain exposure to the operations of a professional counseling practice.



Administrative & Team Support

Maintain organized client-care and internship workflows.

Update internal systems, task lists, and trackers as assigned.

Communicate relevant client and intern updates to appropriate team members.

Follow established procedures regarding scheduling, communication, confidentiality, and documentation.

Help maintain accountability for assigned tasks and follow-ups.

Assist leadership with client-care and internship-related administrative projects as needed.

Help maintain the structured, professional, and supportive environment Edify strives to provide for clients, interns, and clinicians.

What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



Highly organized and detail-oriented.

Dependable and consistent.

Professional, friendly, and compassionate when communicating with clients.

Comfortable answering incoming calls and making outbound calls.

Confident following up with clients who have not responded.

Comfortable coordinating multiple schedules and appointments.

Able to communicate effectively with interns, clinicians, clients, and leadership.

Able to manage multiple responsibilities and prioritize effectively.

Proactive and willing to identify what needs to be done rather than waiting for constant direction.

Strong with follow-through and accountability.

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Able to handle confidential and sensitive information professionally.

Comfortable learning new systems and workflows.



Experience in mental health, behavioral health, healthcare, medical offices, client care, customer service, scheduling, or administrative support is preferred.



SimplePractice Experience Is a Major Plus



Candidates with previous experience using SimplePractice will receive strong consideration.



We are especially interested in applicants who have experience with:



Client profiles and client management

Appointment scheduling and calendar management

Client onboarding workflows

Intake documentation and forms

Administrative notes and client records

General mental health practice administration



Experience with ClickUp or similar task/project management systems is also a plus.



Who Will Succeed in This Position?



This position is best suited for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people while also being highly organized behind the scenes.



You should be someone who notices when a client has not been contacted, an appointment still needs to be scheduled, an intern needs follow-up, or a task has not been completed—and takes action to move it forward.



We value initiative, communication, professionalism, organization, and follow-through.



About Edify Counseling Group



Edify Counseling Group is a growing mental health organization committed to providing professional, compassionate, and accessible behavioral health services.



In addition to serving our clients, we are committed to developing future mental health professionals through structured clinical internship opportunities.



This position helps connect those two areas by ensuring our clients receive attentive support while helping our interns remain organized, engaged, and productive as they grow within the Edify system.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



A brief introduction about yourself.

Your relevant experience in client care, customer service, scheduling, healthcare, mental health, or administrative support.

Your experience answering calls and making outbound client/customer calls.

Any experience working with interns, students, clinicians, therapists, or healthcare professionals.

Whether you have used SimplePractice before and what tasks you performed within the platform.

Other scheduling, EHR, CRM, or project-management systems you have used.

Your current availability and preferred working hours.

Your expected hourly rate.



Important: Please begin your application with the words “EDIFY CLIENT CARE” so we know you carefully reviewed the entire job posting.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a dependable part of the Edify team—not simply complete a list of tasks.



If you are organized, proactive, professional, comfortable communicating with people, and enjoy helping both clients and team members stay supported and on track, we would like to hear from you.

title: Facebook / Meta Asset Manager with Media Buying Experience
description:
About the Role



About the Role

This is NOT a Media Buyer position.



Your primary responsibility is making sure our Meta assets are properly organized, connected, maintained, monitored and ready for use at all times.



We work with multiple Meta assets and need someone who understands the Meta ecosystem technically and operationally.



Your Main Responsibility



You will manage our complete Meta asset infrastructure, including:



Meta Business Managers / Business Portfolios



 Ad Accounts



 Pages



Instagram Accounts



Pixels / Datasets



Domains



Users, Partners & Permissions



Payment Methods



Asset connections and assignments



You should understand exactly how these assets connect and depend on each other.



Daily Asset Management



Your daily responsibilities will include:



Checking the status and availability of our Meta assets



Maintaining an accurate overview of all active assets



Making sure assets are connected correctly



Checking permissions and access



Identifying missing or incorrectly connected assets



Keeping internal asset tracking sheets updated



Preparing required assets for upcoming operations



Maintaining clean and organized Business Manager structures



Reporting potential problems before they affect operations



Asset Replacement & Troubleshooting



When an asset becomes unavailable or develops a problem, you should be able to investigate and handle the situation independently according to our SOPs.



This includes:



Identifying which asset is causing the problem



Understanding the connections affected by that asset



Replacing assets when required



Connecting replacement assets correctly



Restoring required permissions and assignments



Verifying that the new setup works correctly



Documenting all changes



We don't expect you to immediately ask what to do every time something changes.



You should first understand the situation, identify the solution and then coordinate with us when approval is required.



Backup & Asset Inventory Management



This is one of the most important parts of the position.



You will be responsible for maintaining sufficient operational redundancy.



You will:



Maintain an overview of active and backup assets



Track the quantity and status of available assets



Identify shortages early



Prepare replacement assets before they are needed



Keep backup structures organized



Maintain documentation of asset relationships



Make sure we always understand which assets are connected where



The goal is to prevent operational downtime caused by poor asset organization or missing resources.



SOP-Based Operations



We work with structured SOPs and internal systems.



You should be comfortable:



Following processes precisely



Working with checklists



Maintaining Google Sheets



Documenting changes



Completing repetitive daily checks



Following approval processes



Taking ownership of recurring tasks



We value reliability and accuracy more than creativity.



Required Experience



This is not an entry-level Meta position.



You should already have strong hands-on experience with:



Meta Business Manager / Business Portfolio



 Pages



Ad Accounts



Pixels / Datasets



Domains



Instagram Accounts



Users, Partners & Permissions



Payment methods



Asset assignment and connections



Troubleshooting Meta infrastructure



Managing multiple Meta assets simultaneously



Experience with ecommerce or dropshipping environments is a plus, but not required.



Media buying experience is NOT required.



If you understand Meta infrastructure well, we can teach you our campaign and scaling processes later.



Who We're Looking For



You are:



Extremely organized



Detail-oriented



Reliable



Comfortable with repetitive operational work



Technically confident inside Meta



Able to troubleshoot independently



Able to manage many assets without losing overview



Proactive when something is missing or incorrect



Comfortable following SOPs



Able to communicate clearly in English



Interested in a long-term position



We especially value someone who notices a potential problem before it becomes an actual problem.



Growth Opportunity



We are currently building our operations and expect the complexity of our Meta infrastructure to increase as we expand.



For the right person, this can become a long-term role with significantly more responsibility.



You will also have the opportunity to learn our campaign testing and scaling processes over time.



Strong performance can therefore lead to broader responsibility within our Meta operations.



How to Apply



Please answer these 3 questions:



1. Meta Asset Experience



Describe the Meta infrastructure you managed in your previous role.



How many Business Managers, Ad Accounts, Pages, Pixels/Datasets and other assets were you responsible for?

Explain step by step how you would identify what is affected, replace the asset and verify that all required connections and permissions are working correctly again.



3. Organization



How would you organize 50+ active and backup Meta assets so that you always know:



What is currently active



What is available as backup



Which assets are connected



Which assets have problems



Where additional assets will soon be required

description:
About Moon Nude

Moon Nude is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand selling beautifully designed, handmade products — makeup bags, hair tool bags, duffels, backpacks and more. Our primary market is the United States, alongside a growing international presence. We're building an in-house creative team and moving off agencies, and this role turns our creative concepts into the scroll-stopping video that drives our growth.



The Role



You turn raw footage and UGC into high-performing short-form video ads that sell. Working from a creative strategist's briefs inside a creative pod, you'll produce a high volume of paid-social video — primarily for Meta, plus TikTok and other channels — and iterate fast on what's winning. This is a performance role: we care about ads that scale, not just ads that look good.





What You'll Do

• Edit ads end to end: cut UGC and raw footage into DR and brand video ads — hooks, pacing,

captions/subtitles, sound design, and light motion.

• Iterate at volume: produce many variations and fresh iterations of winning concepts, quickly.

• Repurpose: resize and adapt creative across placements and aspect ratios.

• Move fast: turn briefs around quickly and fold in feedback from strategists and performance data.

• Stay organized: keep footage, assets, and project files tidy and easy to hand off.





What We're Looking For

• Proven eCom/DTC ad editing: a portfolio of paid-social ads you've cut that actually performed.

• Fast and high-volume: you ship a lot without dropping quality.

• Hook & retention instinct: you understand what makes someone stop scrolling and buy — not just what looks nice.

• Tools: fluent in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro, plus After Effects for light motion.

• Performance mindset: comfortable being measured on results and iterating from data.

• Remote-ready: self-managing, reliable, with strong English.



Nice to Have

• Motion graphics / animation.

• Experience sourcing or directing UGC creators.

• Comfort with AI editing and production tools.





The Details

• Type: Full-time.

• Location: Fully remote. With reasonable overlap with US working hours (our primary market is the US).

• Compensation: performance-based — a base plus a bonus for every creative you produce that scales.

• Portfolio: required — please share past work, ideally ads that performed, not just a showreel.

title: Home Health Healthcare Recruiter
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Exclusive to Sterling Staffing Solutions



Sterling Staffing Solutions is looking for an experienced, motivated, and enthusiastic Healthcare Recruiter to join our team and lead full-cycle recruiting efforts.

We are looking for someone who enjoys connecting with people, finding great talent, and helping candidates discover exciting career opportunities. This role is perfect for a recruiter who is proactive, organized, confident, and knows how to build strong relationships with candidates from the first conversation through the hiring process.

If you have strong healthcare recruiting experience, direct Home health recruiting experience, and excellent communication skills, we would love to hear from you!



What You'll Do

As our Healthcare Recruiter, you will manage the recruiting process from start to finish across multiple locations. Your responsibilities will include:

Sourcing and engaging qualified candidates

Reviewing resumes and screening applicants

Conducting candidate outreach and follow-up

Coordinating interviews

Helping candidates navigate the hiring process

Maintaining active and organized candidate pipelines

Supporting successful hires and onboarding efforts

Recruiting for hospice and healthcare-related positions

Representing our organization professionally and sharing what makes our opportunities unique

We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking initiative, building relationships, and keeping candidates engaged throughout the hiring process.



What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is confident, responsive, organized, and comfortable communicating with a wide variety of people. You should enjoy sourcing talent, building connections, and helping candidates feel excited about new opportunities.

Strong communication and follow-up skills are especially important in this role. We are looking for someone who can not only identify qualified candidates but also build trust, create interest, and help guide candidates toward accepting the right opportunity.

This is a fully dedicated position, and we are looking for someone who can commit exclusively to Sterling Staffing Solutions.

Ideal Candidate

The right person is proactive, dependable, persuasive, and motivated. You know how to find and engage healthcare professionals and understand the importance of maintaining strong candidate relationships.

You are comfortable managing multiple job openings at once, staying organized, moving quickly, and communicating clearly. Experience recruiting specifically within the hospice or home health industry is highly important for success in this role.

To be considered, you must meet the following requirements:

Minimum of 1 - 2 years of healthcare recruiting experience

Strong full-cycle recruiting experience

Proven ability to source, engage, and successfully close candidates

Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written

Must be fully dedicated to Sterling Staffing Solutions (No other active jobs, clients, contracts, or other work commitments)



Why This Role Matters

This is an important role within our organization. The Healthcare Recruiter will play a direct part in helping us build strong teams across all four of our locations.

We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys helping people find meaningful opportunities, and understands the importance of hiring talented individuals who align with our mission and standards.

If you are passionate about recruiting, enjoy connecting with people, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would love to meet you!

title: Marketplace Specialist (Amazon, Faire, Shopify): Part Time, Long Term
description:
SCOOP



Read that word. You will need it. Instructions are at the bottom.



We are a fast-growing US protein ice cream brand. We sell direct to consumers on

Shopify and we are live on Amazon FBA. We are opening two wholesale channels right

now and we need someone who already knows how these platforms work, because we do

not have time to teach the basics.



That last part is the whole job description, honestly. We are not looking for

someone we have to walk through what Faire is or how Amazon Seller Central works.

We are looking for someone who reads "set up our Faire storefront" and already

knows what that means.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



- Manage our Faire wholesale storefront. Review incoming buyer order requests,

  research each buyer, and flag anyone who looks like an Amazon reseller rather

  than a real retail store. This is the single most important task and it starts

  day one.

- Help set up and maintain our RangeMe profile and other wholesale marketplace

  listings.

- Support our Amazon catalog: listing accuracy, content updates, keeping product

  information clean and consistent across channels.

- Keep product data consistent between Shopify, Amazon and our wholesale channels.

- Flag problems before we find them. If a listing is wrong, an order looks

  suspicious, or something is out of stock somewhere it should not be, we want to

  hear it from you first.



WHAT WE NEED YOU TO ALREADY KNOW



You should have hands on experience with at least three of these:

- Faire

- Amazon Seller Central

- Shopify

- Walmart Marketplace

- eBay

- TikTok Shop

- RangeMe



Tell us specifically which ones, and what you actually did on each. "Familiar with

Amazon" tells us nothing. "I managed 40 SKUs on Amazon Seller Central for a

supplement brand, handled listing creation and flat file uploads" tells us

everything.



WHAT WE ARE LIKE TO WORK FOR



- Long term. We are not looking for a one off project. Our current team members

  have been with us a long time and we treat them like real employees.

- We pay every week, on time, through Wise.

- We are small. You will talk directly to the founder and to me. There is no

  layer of managers between you and the decisions.

- We like people who come to us with their own ideas. Our best team members tell

  us what we should be doing, they do not wait to be told.

- Start part time at 20 hours a week. If you are good and the workload grows,

  the hours and the rate grow with it.



WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



- Someone who needs to be taught what these platforms are.

- Someone who disappears for two days and then explains why.

- Agencies or teams applying on behalf of someone else. We want to hire a person.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your message with the word SCOOP in all caps. If you do not, we will

   not read the rest. This is our filter and we use it every time.

2. List which marketplace platforms you have actually worked on and what you did

   on each one. Be specific.

3. Tell us one real thing about yourself that has nothing to do with work.

4. Tell us what you think the biggest mistake is that most brands make on Faire

   or Amazon. There is no right answer. We want to see how you think.



Shortlisted candidates get a small paid test project before we hire. It takes

about an hour and we pay for your time either way.

title: Experienced U.S. Trucking Fleet Manager / Dispatcher – Remote
description:
That Ford Girl Trucking — A Trucking Agency is looking for an experienced Fleet Manager/Dispatcher to join our growing U.S.-based trucking operation.



This is not a virtual assistant position and not an entry-level dispatch position. We are looking for someone who already understands U.S. trucking, freight markets, load boards, broker negotiations, driver management, HOS, trip planning, and how dispatch decisions affect truck revenue.



Your primary responsibility is simple: make good fleet and dispatch decisions, plan ahead, negotiate strong freight, and keep assigned drivers moving safely and productively.



Responsibilities

Search load boards and approved freight sources for profitable loads

Evaluate rates, mileage, deadhead, market conditions, HOS and truck positioning

Negotiate rates with U.S. freight brokers — do not simply accept the first rate offered

Book and dispatch freight

Plan reloads and backhauls before trucks become empty

Monitor driver locations, HOS, appointments and home-time needs

Communicate professionally with drivers and brokers

Handle routine load issues and know when something needs to be escalated

Track detention, layover, TONU and other accessorial situations

Keep fleet/load information updated

Help maximize truck productivity while making sound operational decisions

What We're Looking For



You should have previous hands-on experience dispatching U.S. trucks and be comfortable making decisions independently.



Strong candidates will understand RPM, deadhead, freight markets, rate negotiation, HOS, appointment scheduling and how to position a truck for its next load.



Negotiation ability and revenue awareness are extremely important to us. We want a Fleet Manager who understands that an additional $100–$200 negotiated onto a load matters and is willing to professionally negotiate for the best reasonable rate.



You should also have strong English communication skills, good judgment, organization and the confidence to manage drivers without needing approval for every routine decision.



Schedule & Support



Our general management and operational support hours are 7:30 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time (U.S.).



The Fleet Manager will eventually participate in a shared rotating after-hours coverage schedule with management for legitimate time-sensitive driver/load matters. This rotation is designed so management team members also receive protected off-time.



You will not be expected to run the entire back office yourself. Our Agency has operational and administrative support for onboarding, documentation, compliance coordination, revenue tracking, settlements and other back-office functions. Your primary focus is fleet management, freight procurement, negotiation, dispatch and keeping trucks productive.



Compensation



This position will have performance-based compensation tied directly to qualifying freight personally sourced, negotiated, booked and dispatched by the Fleet Manager.



Specific compensation will be discussed with qualified candidates during the interview process.



How to Apply



Please include:



How many years you have dispatched U.S. trucks.

What equipment types you have dispatched.

Which load boards/TMS platforms you have used.

Approximately how many trucks you have managed at one time.

An example of how you negotiate when a broker's first offer is too low.

Your experience planning reloads/backhauls and managing driver HOS.



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily general VA work with little or no hands-on U.S. truck dispatching experience.

title: Closing Coordinator – Real Estate Transactions (Remote)
description:
Job Title: Closing Coordinator – Real Estate Transactions (Remote)



Must be proactive, forward-facing, dependable, highly detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of real estate transactions.



Client Industry: US-based Real Estate Company

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday–Friday, with occasional weekends as needed

Rate: $10–$13/hour

Compensation: USD-based salary + PTO + Paid Holidays + Growth Opportunities



Job Overview:

We are looking for a proactive, forward-facing Closing Coordinator who takes ownership of real estate transactions.



This role will regularly communicate with title companies, closing attorneys, real estate agents, lenders, notaries, buyers, sellers, vendors, and internal team members to keep transactions moving.



The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. Strong written communication and exceptional attention to detail are must-haves. This position plays a direct role in ensuring smooth closings, accurate document preparation, and timely submissions that impact company performance, client satisfaction, and operational excellence.



Key Responsibilities:

Closing Coordination & Communication

• Monitor upcoming closings and proactively identify potential issues.

• Communicate directly with title companies, attorneys, agents, lenders, notaries, and other transaction participants.

• Request and follow up on missing documents, signatures, approvals, and closing requirements.

• Coordinate notary signings and closing logistics.

• Escalate issues early and help drive them toward resolution.

• Keep the Closing Director and internal team updated on transaction status and potential risks.



Transaction & Document Management

• Prepare Purchase and Sale Agreements, Extensions, Addendums, Assignments, Transfer Forms, Deeds, and other transaction documents.

• Prepare refinancing applications, term extensions, Profit Share Agreements, and electronic signatures.

• Retrieve, review, upload, and track recorded deeds and closing documents.

• Maintain accurate and organized transaction files.

• Prepare Purchase and Resale approvals and other closing-related documentation.



Performance Expectations & Success Metrics:

Success in this role means consistently taking ownership of assigned transactions, communicating clearly, maintaining accurate files, and helping prevent avoidable closing delays. Expectations include:

• Deadline Management: Complete assigned closing tasks and submissions on time, actively monitor contractual and closing deadlines, and follow up early enough to prevent avoidable delays or missed dates.

• Proactive File Management: Review active transactions consistently and identify missing items, upcoming deadlines, title issues, funding concerns, or other potential roadblocks before they become urgent problems.

• Follow-Up & Responsiveness: Respond promptly to time-sensitive communications and maintain consistent, documented follow-up on outstanding items until they are resolved or appropriately escalated.

• Transaction Accuracy: Maintain accurate transaction trackers, file data, and closing documents, with careful attention to names, dates, property information, signatures, and closing requirements. Repeated errors should be avoided through careful review and note-taking.

• File & Tracker Maintenance: Keep transaction files, CRM records, notes, and trackers current and organized so another team member can quickly understand the status of a file, what is outstanding, and what follow-up has already occurred.

title: Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistant
description:

We are seeking experienced, highly motivated Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistants to support a growing life insurance company.

We are looking for candidates who are exceptional on the phone, confident speaking with cold prospects, comfortable overcoming objections, and motivated by measurable results.



Candidates should have at least 2 years of successful outbound calling, appointment setting, or phone-based sales experience. Life insurance experience is a plus but is not required.

* Engage prospects quickly and professionally

* Build rapport and create interest over the phone

* Clearly communicate the reason for the call and value proposition

* Ask effective questions to identify interest and potential needs

* Handle common objections confidently

* Follow established scripts while communicating naturally

* Book qualified appointments for the sales team

* Follow up consistently with leads who do not initially schedule

* Maintain accurate lead notes, dispositions, and follow-up information

* Manage leads and activities within the CRM

* Consistently work toward established calling, appointment, and performance goals



Required Qualifications:

* 2+ years of demonstrated success in outbound calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, or phone-based sales

* Excellent spoken English

* Exceptional phone presence and communication skills

* Proven ability to successfully book appointments from cold leads

* Strong sales and persuasion skills

* Comfortable handling objections and rejection

* Confident, energetic, and engaging on the phone

* Strong follow-up and organizational skills

* Comfortable using a CRM and managing a sales pipeline

* Self-motivated and able to perform without constant supervision

* Results-oriented and comfortable being measured against clear performance expectations



Preferred, But Not Required

* Experience calling U.S.-based consumers

* Experience working in a commission or performance-incentive environment

* Familiarity with insurance lead generation and appointment-setting processes



Performance Expectations

This is not simply a calling or administrative position. Success will be measured by results.



The right candidate will be expected to consistently:

* Maintain strong outbound calling activity

* Connect and engage effectively with cold prospects

* Generate qualified interest

* Book appointments

* Follow up persistently

* Meet or exceed established performance targets

title: YouTube Entertainment Video Editor for Food Reaction Series
description:
We're looking for a creative YouTube editor—not just someone who can add captions and jump cuts to talking-head videos.



Pop Snax is launching Pop Snax Reacts, an entertainment-focused food reaction series featuring people trying unusual snacks from around the world.



Our editor will turn multi-camera/raw reaction footage into entertaining, polished 10–15 minute YouTube episodes, then repurpose the strongest moments into short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



The ideal editor understands comedic timing, reaction editing, pacing, storytelling, music, sound design, color grading, and visual emphasis.



What You'll Do

-Edit raw participant/interview footage into cohesive 10–15 minute YouTube episodes

-Intercut multiple people's reactions to the same snacks to create entertaining sequences

-Identify the funniest, strongest, and most emotionally engaging moments without needing every edit dictated to you

-Create strong hooks and maintain viewer retention throughout an episode

-Use punch-ins, zooms, reaction cuts, pauses, replays and other techniques intentionally for comedic/entertainment value

-Add tasteful on-screen text, graphics, captions and visual emphasis where appropriate

-Select and incorporate music that matches the energy and brand

-Use sound effects intentionally without making the edit feel cheap or over-edited

This is NOT primarily a talking-head/podcast editing position.



We're specifically looking for someone with experience editing entertainment, reaction, challenge, food, lifestyle, or personality-driven YouTube content.



If your portfolio consists primarily of podcasts with captions, talking-head jump cuts, or generic short-form reels, this role is not the best fit. If you do not have color grading & correction skills, strong pacing, experience with hooks, etc. This is not the role for you.

-Sound design

title: DTC E-commerce Recruiter
description:
Facelove Cosmetics is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer beauty brand built for women over 40, with a strong presence across the US and EU markets.



The Role



We're looking for a DTC E-commerce Recruiter to own end-to-end hiring for the roles that actually move revenue: paid media, creative strategy, retention, Shopify/CRO, and the creative talent behind our ads. You'll work directly with our HR Manager and founders to keep both contractor and full-time pipelines full of strong, vetted candidates.



This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a coordination-only role. You'll source proactively, run structured screens, and bring sharp judgment to who's actually a fit. In DTC, the gap between someone who ran an ad account and someone who sat next to one is enormous, and we need you to be able to tell the difference on a 30-minute call.



What You'll Do



Manage full-cycle recruitment across DTC e-commerce functions: paid media buying, growth, creative strategy, retention/email, Shopify and CRO, analytics, and e-commerce ops

Recruit high-volume creative contractor roles, including video editors and UGC-style creative talent, running trial-based assessment at scale

Write and refine job descriptions that attract the right candidates and filter out the wrong ones

Source proactively through LinkedIn Recruiter, OnlineJobs.ph, job boards, competitor mapping, and outbound

Screen resumes, portfolios, and ad-performance claims, run initial interviews, and produce structured, comparable candidate assessments for hiring managers

Coordinate interview scheduling across time zones with hiring managers and founders

Draft offers and manage the process through to signature

Maintain a clean, up-to-date pipeline in GoHire and LinkedIn Recruiter

Flag pipeline or spec issues early. If a role's requirements are producing no viable candidates, bring evidence and options rather than continuing to source blindly

Spot red flags before they reach final interviews: inflated spend figures, metrics that contradict each other, reused or scraped creative work, agency work presented as in-house, overlapping employment dates

What You'll Need



3+ years of recruitment experience with a track record hiring for DTC, e-commerce, or performance-marketing-driven companies

Recruitment agency or staffing firm background preferred. We want someone who has carried a req load and a placement target, not someone who has only supported an internal HR function

Working fluency in the DTC vocabulary: ROAS, CAC, MER, AOV, LTV, hook rate, creative testing. You don't need to be a marketer, but you can't be bluffed by one

Comfortable evaluating creative portfolios (video, static, UGC) alongside more traditional e-commerce and ops backgrounds

Strong sourcing skills. You don't post and pray

Excellent written communication. You can write both a sharp JD and a warm, human candidate

Ability to work core hours aligned to CET

Comfortable working independently in a fully remote, fast-moving environment

Experience with hiring or ATS tools such as GoHire and LinkedIn Recruiter is a plus

How you work



- You move fast and d
 with incomplete information

- You'd rather be corrected than be wrong for a quarter

- You are comfortable telling a founder their favourite campaign isn't working

- You want ownership, not a brief



What we offer



- Real ownership of the most important function in the business, with a direct line to the founders

- Remote-first, async-friendly, results-measured

- A brand with genuine product-market fit and room to scale

title: Enterprise Account Manager – Healthcare Compliance (B2B, Remote PH)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

We're hiring an Enterprise Account Manager to own our highest-value, highest-complexity client portfolio — enterprise and strategic accounts where you'll be the trusted executive partner, not just the point of contact. This is an individual-contributor role (not people management) focused on owning outcomes for a book of large, complex clients: retention, executive relationships, and long-term portfolio growth.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Client Partnership 



• Serve as the executive relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of strategic client accounts.  

• Develop trusted partnerships with key decision-makers and executive stakeholders.  

•  Gain a deep understanding of each client's business objectives, operational challenges, and compliance priorities.  

• Act as the client's strategic advisor by recommending solutions that improve business outcomes and strengthen the overall partnership.  

• Conduct recurring Executive Business Reviews to demonstrate value, review performance, and align future initiatives.  

• Develop and execute a Customer Council program and plan industry conferences, medical compliance forums, networking events, and educational sessions that build a strong MedPro and MP1 community, strengthen customer relationships, showcase the company's expertise and thought leadership, and position MedPro and MP1 as a trusted leader in the medical compliance industry. 



2. Client Success & Experience 



• Own the end-to-end client experience from implementation through renewal.  

• Lead onboarding validation by ensuring services, billing, contacts, and operational expectations are accurately established.  

• Monitor customer health and proactively address risks before they impact the client experience.  

• Coordinate internal resources to ensure timely resolution of client issues and escalations.  

• Drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy through proactive communication and continuous engagement.  



3. Portfolio Growth & Value Creation 



• Develop and execute strategic account plans for each assigned client.  

• Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through additional services, compliance solutions, or operational improvements that create measurable client value.  

• Lead renewal planning and contract discussions while protecting long-term client relationships.  

• Maintain an active pipeline of expansion opportunities within the assigned portfolio.  

• Achieve portfolio growth objectives while ensuring every recommendation aligns with the client's business needs and long-term success.  



4. Portfolio Health Management  



• Own the overall health and performance of an assigned client portfolio.  

• Monitor client engagement, retention risks, service utilization, and satisfaction trends.  

• Develop recovery strategies for at-risk accounts and coordinate cross-functional action plans.  

• Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, client documentation, and CRM records.  

• Utilize portfolio insights and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.  



5. Cross-Functional Leadership 



• Serve as the central point of coordination between clients and internal teams.  

• Partner closely with Operations, Customer Support, Compliance, Finance, Product, and Sales to ensure a consistent client experience.  

• Advocate for client needs while balancing operational capabilities and business objectives.  

• Share customer insights to influence product enhancements, service improvements, and organizational priorities.  

• Foster collaboration that enables MedPro and MP1 to consistently exceed client expectations. 



Required Qualifications:



• 5+ years of experience managing strategic or enterprise-level client portfolios in Account Management, Customer Success, • Client Services, Business Development, or related consultative roles.  

• Demonstrated success owning a significant book of business with accountability for retention, executive relationships, and portfolio growth.  

• Proven ability to develop trusted partnerships with executive stakeholders and influence strategic business decisions.  

• Extensive experience leading Executive Business Reviews, contract renewals, and long-term account strategies.  

Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer advocacy, operational excellence, and sustainable revenue growth.  

• Demonstrated leadership in coordinating cross-functional teams to resolve complex client challenges and deliver measurable business outcomes.  

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.  

• Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.  



Typical Portfolio:

• A focused portfolio of MedPro's and MP1 largest and most complex enterprise and strategic accounts

• Fewer accounts, higher stakes — deep relationship ownership over high account volume

• High-value, high-complexity clients requiring executive-level engagement

• Full accountability for executive relationships, portfolio strategy, long-term retention, and expansion within this book of business



Technical Skills:



•Proficiency with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar customer relationship management systems.  

•Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer performance metrics, identify trends, and develop strategic recommendations.  

•Experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, to prepare executive presentations, account reviews, and business insights. 

•Demonstrated ability to handle protected health information (PHI) and confidential client data in accordance with HIPAA and MedPro and MP1's information security policies. 

•Reliable high-speed internet, a private and secure workspace, and use of company-issued equipment and VPN for all client and system access.  



Leadership Competencies:



•The successful Strategic Account Manager demonstrates: 

•Executive Presence and Professionalism  

•Strategic Thinking  

•Customer-Centric Mindset  

•Consultative Relationship Management  

•Commercial and Business Acumen  

•Strong Negotiation and Influencing Skills  

•Excellent Verbal and Written Communication  

•Problem Solving and Critical Thinking  

•Cross-Functional Collaboration  

•Accountability and Ownership  

•Adaptability and Change Leadership  

•High Emotional Intelligence  



Nice-to-Have (Optional):

•Background in healthcare, healthcare compliance, environmental services, medical waste management, or multi-location service organizations.  

•Professional certifications in Customer Success, Account Management, Project Management, Sales, or Healthcare Compliance (e.g., CCSM, PMP, Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), CHC, CHPC, or equivalent) are an advantage.  

•Familiarity with healthcare regulatory and compliance standards (e.g., OSHA, HIPAA, DOT, EPA, or other healthcare/environmental compliance requirements) is preferred.  



Compensation & Benefits:

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

Basic Technical Requirements:

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

We're hiring a Senior Account Manager to own a portfolio of mid-market B2B healthcare clients — serving as their single point of accountability, growing the relationship, and protecting long-term retention. This isn't a transactional support role: you'll build executive-level trust, run business reviews, and drive measurable growth within your book of business.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Client Partnership



• Serve as the executive relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of strategic client accounts.

• Develop trusted partnerships with key decision-makers and executive stakeholders.

• Gain a deep understanding of each client's business objectives, operational challenges, and compliance priorities.

• Act as the client's strategic advisor by recommending solutions that improve business outcomes and strengthen the overall partnership.

• Conduct recurring Executive Business Reviews to demonstrate value, review performance, and align future initiatives.

• Develop and execute a Customer Council program and plan industry conferences, medical compliance forums, networking events, and educational sessions that build a strong MedPro and MP1 community, strengthen customer relationships, showcase the company's expertise and thought leadership, and position MedPro and MP1 as a trusted leader in the medical compliance industry.



2. Client Success & Experience



• Own the end-to-end client experience from implementation through renewal.

• Lead onboarding validation by ensuring services, billing, contacts, and operational expectations are accurately established.

• Monitor customer health and proactively address risks before they impact the client experience.

• Coordinate internal resources to ensure timely resolution of client issues and escalations.

• Drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy through proactive communication and continuous engagement.



3. Portfolio Growth & Value Creation



• Develop and execute strategic account plans for each assigned client.

• Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through additional services, compliance solutions, or operational improvements that create measurable client value.

• Lead renewal planning and contract discussions while protecting long-term client relationships.

• Maintain an active pipeline of expansion opportunities within the assigned portfolio.

• Achieve portfolio growth objectives while ensuring every recommendation aligns with the client's business needs and long-term success.



4. Portfolio Health Management



• Own the overall health and performance of an assigned client portfolio.

• Monitor client engagement, retention risks, service utilization, and satisfaction trends.

• Develop recovery strategies for at-risk accounts and coordinate cross-functional action plans.

• Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, client documentation, and CRM records.

• Utilize portfolio insights and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.



5. Cross-Functional Leadership



• Serve as the central point of coordination between clients and internal teams.

• Partner closely with Operations, Customer Support, Compliance, Finance, Product, and Sales to ensure a consistent client experience.

• Advocate for client needs while balancing operational capabilities and business objectives.

• Share customer insights to influence product enhancements, service improvements, and organizational priorities.

• Foster collaboration that enables MedPro and MP1 to consistently exceed client expectations.



Required Qualifications:



• 3–5 years of experience in Strategic Account Management, Customer Success, Client Success, Business Development, or • Account Management.  

• Proven experience managing a portfolio of B2B clients while driving client satisfaction, retention, and account growth.  

• Demonstrated success conducting business reviews, renewal discussions, and identifying expansion opportunities.  

• Strong consultative communication and relationship-building skills with multiple stakeholder levels.  

• Experience collaborating across Operations, Customer Support, Finance, Product, and Sales to deliver client outcomes.  

• Proficient in CRM systems, account planning, and customer performance analysis.  

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.

• Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.



Typical Portfolio:

• A portfolio of mid-market clients — moderate to high complexity accounts requiring active relationship management

• More accounts than the enterprise tier, with a mix of steady-state relationships and growth opportunities

• Full accountability for renewals, client health, strategic account planning, and portfolio growth within this book of business



Technical Skills:



•Proficiency with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar customer relationship management systems.

•Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer performance metrics, identify trends, and develop strategic recommendations.

•Experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, to prepare executive presentations, account reviews, and business insights.

•Demonstrated ability to handle protected health information (PHI) and confidential client data in accordance with HIPAA and MedPro and MP1's information security policies.

•Reliable high-speed internet, a private and secure workspace, and use of company-issued equipment and VPN for all client and system access.

title: We Need One Great Support Person (Shopify + Subscriptions, US Brand, Long Term)
description:
Read this part first



Most support jobs are ticket jobs. You clear the queue, you hit a response time target, nobody notices you unless something goes wrong.



This is not that.



We sell consumer health products in the US on a monthly subscription. That means every single customer conversation is worth real money over time. A customer you calm down and keep stays with us for months. A customer you lose with a lazy reply costs us their entire lifetime value. Support is not a cost center in this business, it is where retention is won or lost.



So we are hiring one person and paying them properly, instead of three people cheaply.



We keep our brand name out of the public posting for competitive reasons. You get the full picture (brand, product, revenue, how we operate) on the intro call, and we will sign an NDA if you want one.



A normal day



You open the inbox. Overnight there are 40 to 70 messages from American customers. Some are simple: where is my order, can I change my address. Some are not: a failed payment on a subscription, someone who wants to cancel because they "did not see results yet", someone whose package says delivered but is not there, someone asking whether the product is safe alongside another supplement.



You work through all of it. You handle the subscription changes yourself in Loop. You issue the refund in Shopify when it is the right call, and you find a better solution when it is not. You notice that eleven people this week asked the same confusing question, and you tell us, because that is a landing page problem, not a support problem.



By the end of your day the queue is empty and nothing has been left for tomorrow.



The tools you will live in



Shopify, Loop Subscriptions, and a helpdesk (Gorgias or similar). If you have used Recharge, Skio or Bold instead of Loop, that transfers fine. If you have never touched a subscription tool, this role will be a hard climb.



This job is for you if



Your written English is genuinely native-level. Our customers are American and they will notice the difference. We test this before anything else.

You have supported ecommerce brands before and can name them

You can be trusted with a refund decision without asking permission every time

You would rather own one brand deeply than juggle five clients

You want a job you are still doing in two years, with more responsibility and more money each year



This job is not for you if



You are looking for something part time on the side

You need to be reminded and followed up on

Your plan is to use canned replies for everything

You cannot overlap with US business hours at all



Nice to have, not required



German (we run other brands in Europe and we pay extra for it)

Health, supplement or wellness niche experience

Experience writing SOPs or macro libraries from scratch



The money



$1,000 to $1,400 per month, depending on what you bring. That is above the usual range for this role and we know it. We would rather overpay one excellent person than manage three average ones.

title: Web Project Manager (WordPress/Elementor)
description:
Web Project & Operations Manager

Remote | Philippines Preferred

Part-time (~20 hrs/week) → potential to grow into full-time



About the Role



We're a marketing agency for industrial manufacturers and B2B companies. We're looking for an organized, detail-oriented Web Project & Operations Manager to oversee WordPress projects, coordinate with our developer, do QA, and handle website-related client communication. Not a dev role — we already have a strong developer. We need someone who keeps things moving and catches details.



Important: This role is meant to grow into full-time. We need someone who can treat this as their primary job, not a side gig.



Requirements



Hands-on WordPress + Elementor experience

Prior experience as a Project Manager directly managing a developer (not just using PM tools)

Strong written and spoken English — comfortable on client/dev calls

Excellent organization, follow-through, attention to detail

Can juggle multiple tasks/timelines at once

Good eye for layout, consistency, website quality

Comfortable with ClickUp or similar tools

Able to commit fully to this role given the full-time growth path



Nice to Have: cPanel/FTP/DNS/SSL/backups, website maintenance experience, basic SEO, agency/client website experience



How to Apply



Please answer the questions below in your own words, based on real experience. These are scenario questions, not trivia — we want to know how you actually think and act, not a textbook answer. Applications that copy-paste generic answers or skip the specifics will not be considered.



1.The missed deadline: Tell us about a real time your developer missed a deadline or delivered something broken/incomplete. What exactly did you say to the client (or did you delay telling them), and what did you change afterward so it wouldn't happen again?



2.The live-site emergency: You find a broken contact form or checkout on a client's live site 20 minutes before a scheduled client call — and your developer is currently unreachable. Walk us through exactly what you do in that 20 minutes, step by step.



3.The conflicting priorities: Two clients both have "urgent" requests on the same day, but you only have one developer and limited hours. How do you d
 who goes first, and how do you communicate that decision to the client who has to wait?

The scope pushback: A client insists on a change that your developer says is a bad idea technically (e.g., will break mobile responsiveness or slow the site down). The client won't budge. What do you actually do — and what do you say to each side?



4.Your English speaking comfort: Please attach a short (1–2 minute) voice note or video introducing yourself in English, and briefly walking through your experience managing a developer share it via google drive make sure its public so we could access it.



5.DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DONT AGREE WITH THE RATE

What you own



The inbox. All of it.

Queue at zero before you log off

German (we run brands in Europe and pay a premium for it)

Supplement or wellness niche

title: We Need One Great Support Person (Shopify + Subscriptions, US Brand, Long Term)
description:
Read this part first



Most support jobs are ticket jobs. You clear the queue, you hit a response time target, nobody notices you unless something goes wrong.



This is not that.



We sell consumer health products in the US on a monthly subscription. That means every single customer conversation is worth real money over time. A customer you calm down and keep stays with us for months. A customer you lose with a lazy reply costs us their entire lifetime value. Support is not a cost center in this business, it is where retention is won or lost.



So we are hiring one person and paying them properly, instead of three people cheaply.



We keep our brand name out of the public posting for competitive reasons. You get the full picture (brand, product, revenue, how we operate) on the intro call, and we will sign an NDA if you want one.



A normal day



You open the inbox. Overnight there are 40 to 70 messages from American customers. Some are simple: where is my order, can I change my address. Some are not: a failed payment on a subscription, someone who wants to cancel because they "did not see results yet", someone whose package says delivered but is not there, someone asking whether the product is safe alongside another supplement.



You work through all of it. You handle the subscription changes yourself in Loop. You issue the refund in Shopify when it is the right call, and you find a better solution when it is not. You notice that eleven people this week asked the same confusing question, and you tell us, because that is a landing page problem, not a support problem.



By the end of your day the queue is empty and nothing has been left for tomorrow.



The tools you will live in



Shopify, Loop Subscriptions, and a helpdesk (Gorgias or similar). If you have used Recharge, Skio or Bold instead of Loop, that transfers fine. If you have never touched a subscription tool, this role will be a hard climb.



This job is for you if



Your written English is genuinely native-level. Our customers are American and they will notice the difference. We test this before anything else.

You have supported ecommerce brands before and can name them

You can be trusted with a refund decision without asking permission every time

You would rather own one brand deeply than juggle five clients

You want a job you are still doing in two years, with more responsibility and more money each year



This job is not for you if



You are looking for something part time on the side

You need to be reminded and followed up on

Your plan is to use canned replies for everything

You cannot overlap with US business hours at all



Nice to have, not required



German (we run other brands in Europe and we pay extra for it)

Health, supplement or wellness niche experience

Experience writing SOPs or macro libraries from scratch



The money



$1,000 to $1,400 per month, depending on what you bring. That is above the usual range for this role and we know it. We would rather overpay one excellent person than manage three average ones.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO THE CEO



Company: Gizmos and Gadgets Group of Companies

Department: Executive Office

Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote



POSITION SUMMARY

The Executive Assistant to the CEO is a newly established position within Gizmos and Gadgets Group of Companies, created to provide dedicated administrative, organizational, and coordination support to the Chief Executive Officer.

As this is a new role, the successful candidate will work closely with the CEO to understand his working style, priorities, communication preferences, and business needs, while gradually developing systems and routines that improve the organization and efficiency of the CEO's day-to-day activities.

The Executive Assistant will help the CEO stay focused on high-priority business matters by managing schedules, organizing information, coordinating meetings, tracking follow-ups, preparing documents, and ensuring that important commitments do not get overlooked.

This is a high-trust, relationship-driven position. The successful candidate must be comfortable learning, asking appropriate questions, exercising good judgment, and taking initiative while recognizing that the role and level of support will develop as the working relationship with the CEO grows.

The ideal candidate is not someone who simply waits for instructions. The Executive Assistant should gradually become someone who understands the CEO's priorities, anticipates routine needs, identifies administrative gaps, and helps create order around a fast-moving executive environment.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Establish and Organize the CEO's Administrative System

• Work closely with the CEO during the initial period to understand his preferred way of working, communication style, priorities, and routines

• Establish practical systems for managing the CEO's calendar, appointments, meetings, documents, reminders, and follow-ups

• Help create an organized structure for information and documents required by the CEO

• Maintain a reliable system for tracking important commitments, deadlines, and pending matters

• Continuously improve these systems based on the CEO's evolving needs

2. Calendar & Schedule Management

• Manage the CEO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and commitments

• Coordinate meetings while considering the CEO's priorities and availability

• Identify scheduling conflicts and recommend practical solutions

• Provide reminders and relevant information ahead of important appointments and meetings

• Help the CEO maintain an organized and realistic schedule

• Protect the CEO's time by appropriately organizing incoming meeting and appointment requests

3. Meeting Coordination & Follow-Up

• Coordinate internal and external meetings involving the CEO

• Prepare agendas, documents, presentations, reports, or other materials required for meetings

• Ensure the CEO receives relevant information in advance

• Take meeting notes when required

• Maintain a clear record of decisions, action items, responsibilities, and deadlines

• Follow up with responsible persons on outstanding action items

• Escalate overdue or important matters to the CEO

4. Executive Communication Support

• Organize
s, messages, correspondence, and other communications requiring the CEO's attention

• Assist in prioritizing communications based on urgency and importance

• Draft and proofread letters, memos, announcements, presentations, and other business correspondence

• Coordinate responses on behalf of the CEO when authorized

• Ensure communication from the CEO's office is professional, clear, and timely

5. CEO Task & Follow-Up Management

• Maintain a centralized list of tasks, requests, decisions, and commitments assigned by or involving the CEO

• Monitor deadlines and follow up with relevant employees or departments

• Provide the CEO with updates on outstanding matters

• Identify tasks that are delayed, unclear, or requiring additional attention

• Ensure important instructions and decisions are properly communicated to the appropriate individuals

• Keep matters moving forward without unnecessarily requiring the CEO to repeatedly follow up

6. Information Preparation & Business Support

• Gather information and reports requested by the CEO from various departments

• Organize information into concise summaries for easier review

• Assist with preparing presentations, reports, spreadsheets, and briefing materials

• Conduct basic research and fact-finding as assigned

• Help the CEO prepare for meetings by ensuring relevant information is available and organized

• Assist with special projects and business initiatives assigned by the CEO

7. Coordination Across Departments

• Serve as a coordination point between the CEO and department heads, managers, and other employees when authorized

• Follow up on requests or information needed by the CEO

• Help ensure that important CEO directives are communicated to the appropriate department

• Monitor the progress of matters delegated by the CEO and provide updates

• Maintain professional relationships while respecting departmental authority and reporting structures

Important: The Executive Assistant does not replace department managers or assume their decision-making authority. The role is responsible for coordination, follow-up, organization, and communication, while operational decisions remain with the appropriate managers and executives.

8. Document & Confidential Information Management

• Maintain organized records of CEO-related documents, correspondence, reports, and other important information

• Ensure confidential documents are securely stored and appropriately handled

• Maintain strict confidentiality regarding employee matters, financial information, business plans, management discussions, and other sensitive Company information

• Ensure important documents can be located quickly when needed by the CEO

9. Travel & Event Coordination

• Assist with planning and coordinating the CEO's business travel

• Organize itineraries, transportation, accommodation, meetings, and related arrangements

• Prepare relevant documents and schedules for business trips

• Assist with executive meetings, business functions, and Company events as required

10. Proactive Executive Support

As the Executive Assistant becomes familiar with the CEO's working style, the role is expected to progressively take greater ownership of routine executive support.

This includes:

• Anticipating routine administrative needs

• Providing timely reminders about important commitments

• Identifying scheduling conflicts or potential issues before they occur

• Preparing information the CEO is likely to need for upcoming meetings or decisions

• Suggesting improvements to the CEO's administrative workflow

• Reducing unnecessary administrative interruptions

• Ensuring agreed actions and commitments are followed through

The Executive Assistant is expected to develop this level of support gradually, based on trust, experience, and demonstrated understanding of the CEO's expectations.

• Other duties and responsibilities that may be assigned from time-to-time



FIRST 90 DAYS – INITIAL PRIORITIES

Because this is a newly established position, the first three months should focus on building the foundation of the role.

First 30 Days – Learn & Understand

• Understand the CEO's daily and weekly routines

• Learn the Company's organizational structure and key departments

• Understand the CEO's major priorities and recurring commitments

• Identify the CEO's preferred communication and scheduling methods

• Establish basic systems for calendar management, task tracking, meetings, and document organization

Days 31–60 – Organize & Support

• Take increasing responsibility for calendar and meeting coordination

• Establish a consistent follow-up system

• Begin managing routine correspondence and administrative requests

• Improve document and information organization

• Develop a reliable system for tracking CEO action items and deadlines

Days 61–90 – Anticipate & Improve

• Independently manage established administrative routines

• Proactively identify upcoming needs and deadlines

• Reduce the amount of administrative follow-up required from the CEO

• Recommend improvements to the CEO's workflow

• Establish a sustainable Executive Office support system



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, Office Administration, or a related field preferred

• 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Administrative Officer, Office Manager, or similar roles

• Previous experience supporting a senior executive is an advantage but is not mandatory if the candidate demonstrates strong organizational and professional capabilities

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

• Comfortable working with digital calendars, task management platforms, online meetings, and cloud-based document systems

• Strong ability to organize information and manage multiple priorities



KEY COMPETENCIES

Essential

• Highly organized

• Proactive and self-motivated

• Excellent communication skills

• Strong attention to detail

• Discreet and trustworthy

• Good judgment

• Strong follow-through

• Professional and composed

• Adaptable

• Resourceful

• Able to work independently

• Comfortable working with senior leadership

What We Are Looking For

The right person should be able to move from:

“What would you like me to do?”

to eventually:

“I noticed this is coming up, so I have already prepared this for you.”

That progression is an important part of success in this newly established position.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

The Executive Assistant will be successful when the CEO can rely on the role to:

• Keep his schedule organized

• Ensure he is prepared for important meetings and commitments

• Keep track of outstanding matters

• Reduce unnecessary administrative workload

• Follow up with the appropriate people without requiring repeated reminders from the CEO

• Provide organized and relevant information when needed

• Maintain confidentiality and professionalism

• Build systems that make the CEO's work more efficient

• Develop a strong understanding of the CEO's working style and business priorities



CONFIDENTIALITY

Due to the nature of this position, the Executive Assistant will have access to confidential and sensitive information. The employee is expected to exercise the highest level of discretion and maintain strict confidentiality regarding all Company, employee, financial, operational, and strategic information accessed through the role.



GENERAL STATEMENT

This job description outlines the primary responsibilities of the position but is not intended to be exhaustive. As this is a newly established position, responsibilities, processes, and systems may evolve as the working relationship between the CEO and Executive Assistant develops and as the needs of the Company change.
