title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
About Us

We are a premium smart home technology company specializing in luxury home automation, home theaters, networking, surveillance, lighting control, whole-home audio, commercial AV systems, and integrated technology solutions.



We're looking for an AI Automation Specialist who can help us develop practical AI-powered automations, workflows, and systems that improve how the business operates.



This is an opportunity to work directly with the business owner on automation projects and develop solutions based on real business needs. The role may be project-based or part-time, depending on the scope of work and what makes the most sense for both sides.



What You'll Do

Your primary responsibility will be to understand the business owner's needs and turn them into working AI automations and efficient workflows.



1. AI Automation & Workflow Development (Primary Responsibility)

You will work directly with the business owner to develop automations that reduce manual work and improve business efficiency.



Responsibilities include:

-Build AI-powered automations using platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Make, and other programs

-Develop workflows that connect different software, applications, and AI tools

-Automate repetitive business processes and tasks

-Integrate AI tools into existing business workflows

-Work with APIs, webhooks, and third-party applications

-Troubleshoot and improve existing automations

-Test workflows to ensure they work reliably

-Turn ideas and requirements from the business owner into practical working solutions

-Research and recommend tools or approaches when needed

-Document workflows and systems so they can be understood and maintained

-Continuously look for opportunities to improve efficiency through automation



Ideal Experience:

-Hands-on experience with n8n

-Hands-on experience with Zapier

-Hands-on experience with Make 

-Experience building AI-powered automations or workflows

-Experience integrating different applications and platforms

-Knowledge of APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations

-Experience working with AI tools and services

-Automation, workflow development, or systems integration experience

-Programming or scripting experience is a plus



Please submit your resume and portfolio. We would especially like to see examples of automations, AI workflows, integrations, or systems you have personally built.



2. Learn Our Business & Systems

You don't need to have previous experience in the smart home or AV industry, but you should be comfortable learning how a business operates and understanding the problems that need to be solved.



You'll learn about our business processes, systems, and workflows, including areas such as:

-Project Management

-Estimating & Proposals

-Customer Management

-Purchasing & Orders


 & Communication

-Scheduling

-Business Administration

-Smart Home & AV Operations



We're looking for someone who can understand why a process works the way it does, identify where improvements can be made, and determine whether automation can make it faster or more efficient.



3. Work Directly With the Business Owner

You will work directly with the business owner to understand requirements, discuss ideas, and develop automation solutions.



Responsibilities include:

-Listen carefully to the business owner's requirements

-Ask questions when clarification is needed

-Translate business needs into technical solutions

-Provide recommendations when there is a better way to accomplish something

-Communicate progress and potential issues clearly

-Make adjustments based on feedback

-Test and demonstrate completed automations

-Take ownership of assigned projects from start to finish



The goal is not simply to build automations because they can be built. The goal is to create systems that actually solve problems and deliver useful results.



If you're an AI automation specialist who enjoys building practical systems, solving business problems, and turning ideas into working automations, we'd love to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please submit:

-Your resume/CV

-Your portfolio

-Availability (EDT)

-Your expected rate ($/hr)

The role requires excellent attention to detail, consistency and the ability to work through a large volume of information in a structured way.



Key Responsibilities

• Manually migrate landlord, tenant, property, tenancy and other relevant CRM records into Street.

• Transfer key property, tenancy, legal documentation and contact information accurately between systems.

• Upload and correctly organise documents, notes and supporting records.

• Review migrated records against the existing CRM to check accuracy and completeness.

• Identify missing information, duplicate records or inconsistencies and flag these to the relevant UK team member.

• Carry out data cleansing to ensure information entered into the new CRM is accurate and well organised.

• Maintain migration trackers and update progress daily so the wider team has clear visibility.

• Follow agreed migration checklists, processes and priorities for each department.

• Assist with testing migrated records and CRM workflows ahead of go live.

• Provide general administrative support connected to the CRM migration project as required.



Working With Our Team

You will work closely with our UK team throughout the project. Migrated data will be checked and reviewed internally, so you must be comfortable receiving feedback, correcting records where required and following clear processes. Communication and progress updates will be an important part of the role.



What We Are Looking For

• Excellent attention to detail with a strong focus on accuracy.

• Previous administration, data entry or CRM experience.

• Confident using spreadsheets, online systems and cloud based software.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Highly organised, dependable and able to manage your own workload.

• Comfortable handling confidential customer and business information.

• Previous experience within UK property, lettings or CRM migration would be an advantage but is not essential.



Hours

Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm UK time. You must be available and responsive during these hours as you will be working directly alongside our UK based team.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist (AI-First)
description:
About Us:



HeroForge.AI teaches professionals how to work with AI, from foundations through to building full AI staff. We run bootcamps, masterminds and private coaching. Our clients are physicians, business owners and professionals adopting AI in their practices.



About This Role:



We are looking for a digital marketer who wants to do the job with AI rather than around it. You will own marketing for our courses and programs, covering campaigns, funnels, content,
 and social.



The most important requirement is not your current marketing background. It is whether you are genuinely curious about AI and want to build every workflow you own around it. We are an AI education company, so you will be learning the same material we teach and you will have direct support to get good at it.



If your instinct when facing a repetitive task is that there has to be a way to automate it, you will do well here.



What You Will Do:



- Plan and run marketing campaigns for our courses and programs.

- Build and maintain funnels, landing pages and
 sequences in GoHighLevel.

- Write and schedule content across
 and social channels.

- Track campaign performance and report on what is working.

- Build AI-assisted workflows for the recurring parts of the role.

- Work with the team on launches and enrollment pushes.



What We Are Looking For:



- Real interest in AI and a desire to learn it properly. This is the one requirement we will not compromise on.

- Some digital marketing experience across campaigns,
, social or funnels.

- Clear written English.

- Self-directed. You can take a goal and work out the steps yourself.

- Comfortable being taught, and comfortable teaching yourself.

- Able to work Eastern Time hours.



Useful but not required:



- GoHighLevel experience.

- Experience using AI tools in a work context.

- Copywriting.

- Design or video editing.



What We Offer:



- Training in AI at the level we teach paying clients.

- A team that uses AI in everything, so you learn by doing.

- Direct mentorship.

- Room to grow as the company grows.



How to Apply:



Send your resume plus a Loom video or multimedia presentation covering:



- A campaign or project you are proud of, and why.

- How you currently use AI in your work, or how you would want to.

- Something you built, automated or figured out for yourself that nobody asked you to build. Link it if it exists.

- You almost certainly used AI to help write this application. Good. Tell us exactly how: which tool, what you asked it, what you changed in its output. We would rather see your process than pretend it did not happen.

- Your expected monthly salary in USD.



Applications without a video or multimedia presentation will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid test task.

title: Short-Form Video Editor + Social Content Manager
description:
I’m looking for a strong short-form video editor and content operator to help manage content across my personal brand and two businesses.



Most of my content is short-form video.



I create content around chronic illness, ostomy life, health, sport, lifestyle, and entrepreneurship. I’m also building Flexara Health and Ostowear.



The goal of this role is simple:



I want to be able to record a video, upload the raw file to Google Drive, and have someone take ownership from there.



That means editing, captions, covers, platform formatting, scheduling, publishing, and keeping the content pipeline organized.



What You’ll Do



Your main responsibility will be short-form video.



You’ll:



Edit Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and
 short-form video

Turn raw direct-to-camera videos into tight, engaging finished clips

Remove pauses, repetition, rambling, weak sections, and unnecessary setup

Improve hooks and pacing without making the content feel overedited

Add clean on-screen captions

Add B-roll, text, zooms, screenshots, or graphics when they genuinely improve the video

Format content correctly for each platform

Create Reel covers and preview images

Draft contextual captions for each platform

Upload and schedule approved content

Maintain the publishing calendar

Keep Google Drive and the content pipeline organized

Track what is raw, editing, waiting for approval, approved, scheduled, and published

Repurpose strong existing content

Track basic content performance

Identify which hooks, subjects, and formats are working

Long-Form Content



Long-form editing will be part of the role, but it will be a smaller percentage of the workload.



Occasionally I record:



interviews

podcast conversations

YouTube videos

longer discussions



You should be able to edit these into a strong finished video and then identify short-form clips, quotes, carousel ideas, and other content from the transcript.



A single long-form recording may become several Reels or Shorts.



The Workflow I Want



Most days, the workflow should look like this:



I record → upload to Google Drive → you edit → I review → you finalize and schedule



I do not want to spend time managing every edit.



You should be comfortable making decisions about:



what to cut

where the strongest hook is

what should move faster

where captions or graphics help

where they don’t

which parts of a longer video could become short-form clips



Brands You’ll Work On:



Rob Nunnery

Personal content around chronic illness, ostomy life, health, relationships, sport, lifestyle, and entrepreneurship.



Flexara Health

A consumer health brand focused on hydration and sensitive digestion.



Ostowear

An ostomy-focused brand that is currently selling hat inventory. 



Each account has its own audience and style. You should be able to keep those separate while maintaining consistent output.



What I’m Looking For



The most important skill is judgment.



You should be able to watch a raw 60-second video and recognize which 25 to 40 seconds actually belong in the finished Reel.



You should understand:

strong hooks

retention

pacing

clean captions

social-native editing

when a video feels slow

when a cut feels too aggressive

when graphics help

when graphics distract

how to make direct-to-camera content feel polished without making it look fake



The editing style should feel clean, modern, natural, and human.



Must-Have Skills:

Strong short-form video editing

Experience editing Instagram Reels

Experience editing TikTok

Experience editing YouTube Shorts

Excellent English comprehension

Strong understanding of conversational pacing

Good sense of storytelling

Ability to create captions and subtitles

Basic thumbnail and Canva skills

Comfortable with Google Drive

Strong organization

Dependable communication

Ability to work independently

Comfortable receiving direct feedback

Able to make revisions quickly



Experience with Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Descript, or similar tools is fine.



I care more about your taste, speed, and judgment than which software you use.



Social Media Responsibilities

You’ll also help operate the publishing side of the brands.



That includes (using Publer):

maintaining the content calendar

scheduling posts

preparing captions

creating covers

making sure content goes live

organizing the backlog

repurposing older content

tracking basic performance

helping maintain consistent posting



I will stay involved in strategy, messaging, positioning, and final approval.



What Success Looks Like:

Within a few months, I should spend very little time editing.



My ideal workflow is:

Record → Upload → Review → Approve



You should handle most of the process between recording and publishing.



Flexara and Ostowear should also be posting consistently without me having to remember every edit, caption, thumbnail, upload, or publishing date.



Compensation



PHP 50,000 to 70,000 per month depending on experience and ability



Full-time role.



There is room for compensation to increase as responsibilities and ownership grow.



How to Apply



Please follow these instructions carefully.



Start your application with:



RECORD TO PUBLISH



Then send:



Links to your three best short-form videos

At least one example of a direct-to-camera Reel or TikTok you edited

One example showing strong use of captions and pacing

One long-form example if you have one

The editing software you use

Your current availability

Your expected monthly salary

Whether you have experience scheduling content on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and



Also answer this question:



If I send you a raw 90-second talking-head video that is repetitive and slow, how would you d
 what to cut and what to keep?



Please keep your application concise.



I care much more about your work and how you think than a long cover letter.



Paid Test



Final candidates will complete a paid editing test.



You will receive several raw short-form videos and be asked to create finished Reels from them.



The test will focus on:



hook selection

pacing

cutting unnecessary material

captions

visual judgment

restraint

overall watchability



The strongest editor will be the person who can make good decisions without needing every decision explained first.

title: REAL ESTATE LAND LEAD RESEARCHER / DATA RESEARCH VA
description:
Part-Time → Potential Full-Time



We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in buying and wholesaling vacant land nationwide.



We are looking for a highly motivated, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant in the Philippines to help us find and research vacant-land opportunities across the United States.



IMPORTANT: This is primarily a RESEARCH position. You will NOT be required to cold call sellers.



Your job is to find potential land opportunities, verify the property information, research ownership and distress indicators, and organize qualified leads for our acquisitions team.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



* Research county government websites

* Find tax-delinquent property lists

* Find tax-sale and tax-foreclosure lists

* Research probate/estate records

* Research vacant-property and code-violation records

* Research abandoned/blighted property records

* Use county GIS websites

* Verify parcel information

* Identify vacant land

* Research property ownership

* Research owner mailing addresses

* Research acreage and zoning

* Check road/access information

* Identify potential development characteristics

* Organize leads in Google Sheets/CRM

* Research comparable properties when requested

* Skip trace leads when instructed

* Maintain accurate lead records

* Follow our exact land-buying criteria



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You should:



* Have excellent written English

* Be extremely detail-oriented

* Be comfortable researching government websites

* Be comfortable using Google Maps

* Be comfortable using county GIS systems

* Understand basic U.S. real estate terminology

* Have experience with real estate lead generation

* Have experience with land research/property research

* Be able to follow detailed instructions

* Be able to work independently

* Be comfortable working with spreadsheets



Real estate wholesaling, land investing, skip tracing, GIS, or property research experience is a major plus.



YOU MUST BE ABLE TO RESEARCH



* County assessor websites

* County tax collector websites

* County recorder websites

* County clerk websites

* County GIS systems

* Probate court records

* Code-enforcement records

* Tax-sale records

* Public property records



DAILY GOAL



Our goal is to produce a consistent number of HIGH-QUALITY, VERIFIED land leads every day.



Quality is more important than simply producing a large spreadsheet.



Every lead must meet our specific land-buying criteria before being submitted.



SAMPLE LEAD INFORMATION



Each lead may include:



* Owner name

* Property address

* Mailing address

* County

* State

* APN/Parcel ID

* Acreage

* Zoning

* Tax status

* Tax delinquency amount

* Years delinquent

* Last sale date

* Last sale price

* Ownership length

* Vacant/occupied status

* Road access

* Flood-zone information

* Distress indicators

* GIS/property-record link

* Source link

* Lead motivation score

* Notes explaining why the property qualifies



IMPORTANT



Do NOT simply copy information from a list.



You must verify the property and make sure it meets the criteria.



I would rather receive 25 excellent leads than 200 bad leads.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



To apply, please answer these questions:



1. How many years have you worked as a VA?

2. Do you have U.S. real estate research experience?

3. Have you worked with real estate investors or wholesalers?

4. Have you researched vacant land before?

5. Have you used county GIS systems?

6. Have you researched tax-delinquent properties?

7. Have you researched probate records?

8. What real estate databases and software have you used?

9. Are you comfortable researching multiple U.S. counties?

10. Please provide an example of a real estate lead list you have created before. You may remove confidential information.

11. What hours are you available to work?

12. What hourly rate are you requesting?

13. Please record a 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this position.



PAID/UNPAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants will complete a small research test using a specified county and land-buying criteria.



The test will evaluate:



* Research ability

* Accuracy

* Attention to detail

* Ability to use government websites

* Ability to use GIS

* Ability to follow instructions

* Quality of the final lead list

title: Performance Marketing & Customer Acquisition Strategist

 with the exact subject:

?

title: All-Rounder Virtual Assistant – Admin, HubSpot, Canva (Excellent English, Reliability Essential)
description:
We run an events business in Ireland and the UK and we're hiring one dependable, well-organised Virtual Assistant to be the admin backbone of the operation. You'll manage the bookings inbox, keep our CRM and bookings sheet accurate, create customer designs in Canva, and make sure every booking is fully prepared well before the event date.



This is a long-term role with fixed hours and clear processes. The work itself isn't complicated. What matters is that it gets done, every day, on time, without being chased. If you need a lot of reminders or your availability changes week to week, this isn't the role for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage the bookings inbox in Gmail: reply to enquiries and customers using our templates, send follow-ups, keep the inbox organised and under control (max 20 unread at any time)

- Update HubSpot: contact records, notes, lifecycle/deal stages, lists, and basic
 sends

- Keep the Bookings Sheet (Google Sheets) accurate and up to date as the single source of truth for every confirmed booking

- Create customer designs in Canva from our templates (names, dates, logos, simple layouts), send proofs to clients, and chase approvals until every design is signed off

- Send "final details"
s to clients on a fixed weekly schedule (confirmed design, delivery time, balance owed, how to pay)

- Create and send invoices from our templates, track incoming payments, and update booking status

- Send a short weekly status report on anything that's behind schedule

- General admin support as needed



DEADLINES YOU'LL OWN

These are the three targets the role is measured on:

1. All designs 100% approved by the client a minimum of 4 weeks before the event

2. Final details
 sent to every client a minimum of 2 weeks before the event

3. Bookings inbox never above 20 unread
s



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Excellent written English. This is the number one requirement. You'll be writing to Irish, UK and US customers every day and your
s need to read naturally and professionally

- Reliability. Fixed hours, Monday to Friday. Start-of-shift and end-of-shift check-in messages every working day. If you can't work, you tell us before your shift, not after

- Strong organisation. You can track 30+ live bookings at different stages without letting any of them slip

- Confident in Canva. Not just template edits: you can lay out a clean design from a client's logo and brief, and you have an eye for what looks right

- HubSpot experience. You've used it to manage contacts, update records, build lists and send
s. Please state clearly in your application how you've used it

- Comfortable with Gmail, Google Sheets, invoice templates and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini)

- Able to follow written processes exactly and consistently, and to ask when something is unclear rather than guess



NICE TO HAVE

- Previous VA or admin experience with international clients (events, hospitality or weddings a bonus)



HOURS AND SCHEDULE

- 30 hours per week, Monday to Friday, fixed schedule agreed at hiring

- Must overlap with Ireland/UK working hours (GMT/IST) for at least 4 hours a day

- Long-term role with consistent hours. We want someone who'll be with us for years, not months



LONG-TERM ROLE AND PROGRESSION

This is not a short-term contract. We're a growing business and we want one person to grow with it. Prove yourself on the basics in the first few months (deadlines hit, check-ins done, inbox under control) and there's real scope for pay increases and a step up into a more senior role coordinating the wider admin team. We'd much rather promote someone who has shown they're reliable than hire in over them.



PAY AND INCENTIVE

- Paid monthly, on the 30th

- Completion bonus: $250 paid after successfully completing your first 90 days

- The first 90 days are a trial period. Hitting the three deadlines above and keeping the daily check-ins is what passes it

- Pay reviewed after the trial period based on performance



HOW TO APPLY (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY)

Applications that don't follow these steps won't be read.

1. Start your application with the word "PINT" so we know you read this far

2. Tell us, in 3 to 5 sentences, about the last role where you used HubSpot and what you did in it

3. Tell us what your fixed working hours would be (in Irish time)

4. Attach or link one Canva design you've made yourself (any subject)

5. Reply to this short scenario in your own words, as if writing to the customer: A client's event is in 12 days, they haven't approved their design yet, and they haven't replied to your last two
s. Write the
 you would send them.

title: Content Editor
description:
I’m looking for a creative Content Editor to join my team and work with me long term on my online fitness coaching brand.



I need someone who can do MORE than simply edit videos I send them.



A big part of this role will be researching social media, finding viral and high-performing content within the fitness, fat loss and women’s health space, and then helping me recreate those concepts for my own audience.



You will be responsible for approximately 3 pieces of finished content per week.



THE ROLE:



• Research viral and high-performing Instagram/Reels content

• Identify strong hooks, concepts and trends that would suit my audience

• Take inspiration from successful content and rewrite/recreate scripts in my own tone of voice

• Edit short-form videos/Reels from footage I provide

• Add strong hooks, captions, on-screen text and engaging edits

• Create/edit occasional static posts and carousels

• Help turn ideas into finished, ready-to-post content



My audience is predominantly women aged 30–50, with my content focused around fat loss, strength training, health, confidence and creating realistic routines around a busy life.



I don’t want someone who needs every piece of content mapped out for them. I want someone who can research, bring ideas to me and understand what makes content perform.



THREE NON-NEGOTIABLES:



• Excellent written English – this is VERY important as you will be helping adapt and rewrite scripts

• Super reliable and able to meet deadlines consistently

• Looking for a long-term role – once you’re in, you’re part of my team!



EXPERIENCE:



You should have experience editing short-form social media content using CapCut or similar software.



Experience working with fitness, health, coaching or personal brands is a bonus, but understanding social media and what makes people stop scrolling is more important.



TO APPLY:



Please include:



1. Examples of Reels/short-form content you have edited

2. An example of a social media account or Reel you think is currently creating great content, and WHY

3. A short explanation of why you would be perfect for this role

4. Your current rate for this type of work

5. The editing software you currently use



Please start your application with the words PINK EDITOR so I know you have read the full job description.



I’m looking for somebody who wants to become part of the brand rather than simply complete three edits and disappear. If that sounds like you, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Head Chef & Production Captain
description:
The Head Chef & Production Captain is the primary team leader responsible for theday-to-day execution of TGS production operations.



The role is responsible for leading the production team, executing approved production plans, maintaining product consistency, enforcing production standards, training production personnel, coordinating with the Sanitation Officer and Quality Control Officer, and ensuring that all production activities are completed safely, efficiently, accurately, and according to TGS standards.



The Head Chef & Production Captain serves as the hands-on leader of the production floor and acts as the bridge between management and the production stewards. The position is expected to lead by example, maintain discipline and accountability within the production team, identify operational issues, and promptly escalate concerns to the Management.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



These are some of the tasks but are not limited to:



1. Production Leadership & Daily Operations

Lead and supervise the production team during daily operations.

Execute the approved daily and weekly production plan.

Assign tasks and responsibilities to production team members based on production

requirements and manpower availability.

Monitor progress throughout the production cycle.

Ensure production targets are achieved within the required timeline.

Ensure all production activities follow approved recipes, specifications, and SOPs

Monitor workflow and identify bottlenecks, delays, or manpower issues.

Take immediate corrective action within the scope of authority and escalate major concerns to the Management.

Ensure the production area remains organized and operational throughout the shift.

Lead by example in work ethic, discipline, cleanliness, and adherence to company standards.



2. Production Team Leadership

Serve as the immediate team leader of the Production Team.

Conduct daily task delegation and production briefings.

Train new production personnel on approved production procedures.

Coach team members on proper techniques, productivity, quality, and workplace discipline.

Monitor attendance, punctuality, productivity, and work performance of production personnel.

Identify training needs and recommend additional training or corrective action when necessary.

Promote teamwork, accountability, respect, and professionalism within the production team.

Report significant performance or disciplinary concerns to the Management.



3. Production Standards & Recipe Compliance

Ensure all products are prepared according to approved TGS recipes and specifications.

Ensure proper measurement and handling of ingredients.

Maintain consistency in product weight, appearance, texture, taste, and overall

quality.

Prevent unauthorized changes to recipes, formulations, or production methods.

Immediately report any proposed recipe or process changes to the Management for proper approval.

Ensure only the latest approved recipes and production instructions are used by the production team.



4. Quality Control Coordination

The Head Chef is responsible for production-level quality monitoring, while the Quality Control

Officer maintains the designated quality control function.



The Head Chef shall:

Conduct routine checks throughout production to identify obvious quality issues.

Ensure production personnel follow approved product specifications.

Coordinate with the Quality Control Officer during inspections and QA



5. Sanitation & Food Safety Coordination



6. Training & Development



7. Research & Development (R&D)



8. Inventory & Material Coordination



9. Production & Inventory Assistant Supervision



10. Incentive Report & Production Documentation



11. Production Reporting



12. Equipment & Production Area



13. Confidentiality & Recipe Protection



QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s Degree in Culinary Arts, Food Technology, Hospitality Management, Food Science, or a related field is preferred.

A Culinary Arts diploma/certificate with substantial relevant industry experience may be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.

At least 3–5 years of hands-on experience in professional kitchen, bakery, pastry, commissary, central kitchen, or food production operations.

At least 1–2 years of experience in a supervisory or team-lead capacity, preferably managing a production or kitchen team.

Strong hands-on knowledge of food preparation, production processes, recipes, portion control, food costing, and product consistency.

Demonstrated experience in production planning, task delegation, workflow management, and meeting daily/weekly production targets.

Knowledge of food safety, sanitation, HACCP principles, GMP, and proper food handling procedures.

Experience coordinating with Quality Control, Sanitation, Inventory, and other production support functions.

Ability to train, coach, and supervise production personnel effectively.

Strong understanding of recipe compliance, standard operating procedures (SOPs), batch production, measurements, and quality standards.

Experience with inventory and raw-material coordination, including monitoring usage, availability, and wastage.

Experience in product development/R&D, recipe testing, product improvement, or production trials is an advantage.

Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment and manage multiple priorities.

Willingness to be hands-on in production activities and lead the team by example.

Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with Management and cross-functional teams.

Proficiency in basic Microsoft Office/Google Workspace or other tools used for production reporting and documentation.

Nice to Have: cPanel/FTP/DNS/SSL/backups, website maintenance experience, basic SEO, agency/client website experience



How to Apply



Please answer the questions below in your own words, based on real experience. These are scenario questions, not trivia — we want to know how you actually think and act, not a textbook answer. Applications that copy-paste generic answers or skip the specifics will not be considered.



1.The missed deadline: Tell us about a real time your developer missed a deadline or delivered something broken/incomplete. What exactly did you say to the client (or did you delay telling them), and what did you change afterward so it wouldn't happen again?



2.The live-site emergency: You find a broken contact form or checkout on a client's live site 20 minutes before a scheduled client call — and your developer is currently unreachable. Walk us through exactly what you do in that 20 minutes, step by step.



3.The conflicting priorities: Two clients both have "urgent" requests on the same day, but you only have one developer and limited hours. How do you d
 who goes first, and how do you communicate that decision to the client who has to wait?

The scope pushback: A client insists on a change that your developer says is a bad idea technically (e.g., will break mobile responsiveness or slow the site down). The client won't budge. What do you actually do — and what do you say to each side?



4.Your English speaking comfort: Please attach a short (1–2 minute) voice note or video introducing yourself in English, and briefly walking through your experience managing a developer share it via google drive make sure its public so we could access it. (Auto reject if you dont attach this)



5.DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DONT AGREE WITH THE RATE

title: ONLINE NURSING INSTRUCTOR
description:
JOB POST FOR THE ONLINE NURSING INSTRUCTOR



At Heritage Career Institute, we are dedicated to advancing healthcare education and preparing the next generation of nursing professionals. Our commitment to academic excellence, innovative teaching methods, and hands-on learning experiences sets the foundation for our students to excel in their nursing careers. 



Kindly message us on our social media pages at Heritage Career Institute



The ONLINE NURSING INSTRUCTOR for the Practical Nursing Course plays an essential role in delivering structured, high-quality online instruction to PN students. The instructor ensures that students gain the foundational knowledge required for nursing practice while maintaining academic standards and compliance with state and institutional requirements. The instructor will utilize FA Davis, Elsevier, and Populi LMS to deliver lessons, assessments, and student support.



This is a part-time position that requires up to 10 hours per week, depending on the management approval and teaching load. Your permanent Shift will be during the Eastern Standard Time.







Send a copy of your resume to our socmed pages.



Position Summary:



Position:  Online Nursing Instructor

Initial Employment Status: Probationary, Part-Time

Reporting To: Program Director (PN)

Start Date: 1 week after signing the Offer Letter

Work Schedule: Eastern Standard Time (EST) 

Rendering Hours: up to 10 hours per week (depending on the management approval)

Compensation: 175 to 250 pesos per hour (Estimated)



Responsibilities of Online Nursing Instructor

The Online Nursing Instructor for the Practical Nursing Program at Heritage Career Institute plays an essential role in delivering high-quality online education using FA Davis, Elsevier, and LMS Populi. This role is responsible for teaching PN coursework in a fully virtual environment, facilitating student learning through structured online modules, and ensuring that all instructional content aligns with curriculum and accreditation standards. The Instructor manages online lectures, coursework, assessments, grading timelines, and student academic support while maintaining accurate records within Populi. This includes guiding students through digital resources, monitoring participation, identifying at-risk learners, and providing timely feedback to promote academic success. The Instructor also collaborates with the Program Director to maintain course consistency, improve instructional materials, and support audit and compliance requirements through proper documentation. 



This Job Description will be outlined in detail for you to further understand your role.





ONLINE NURSING INSTRUCTOR

Reports to: Program Director

Collaborates with: Operations, Admissions and Registrar

Primary Focus: Online Delivery of Instruction, Academic Part ONLY

Key Responsibilities:

Online Instruction & Course Management: 

Teach Practical Nursing (PN) subjects through fully online instruction using FA Davis, Elsevier, and LMS Populi Facilitate virtual lectures, discussions, and interactive learning activities aligned with PN curriculum standards 

Upload, organize course materials follow institutional and accreditation guidelines

Provide clear, constructive, and timely feedback to support student learning and progression Maintain active online engagement and consistent communication with students throughout the course 

Student Support & Engagement: 

Assist PN students in understanding course concepts and navigating online resources 

Respond promptly to student inquiries via

 Monitor academic progress, attendance, and participation to identify at-risk students 



Compliance & Documentation: 

Maintain complete and updated gradebooks, attendance logs, and academic records in LMS Populi Ensure instructional activities meet state, institutional, and accreditation requirements

 Submit syllabi, lesson plans, and assessment documentation for audits and program review 

Adhere to FERPA guidelines and maintain confidentiality of all student information

Participate in mandatory virtual meetings, orientation sessions, and required training 

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: 

Coordinate with the Program Director to update teaching materials, curriculum alignment, and lesson plans 

Support curriculum enhancement and assist in integrating improved instructional approaches 

Participate in faculty development, evaluations, and continuing education 

Provide input to improve online teaching delivery, student experience, and overall program quality



Qualifications:

Must be a Registered Nurse (RN) with an active, unencumbered Florida RN license (passed the NCLEX-FL)

Minimum of 2 years clinical experience in nursing

Prior teaching or preceptorship experience is highly preferred

Familiarity with FA Davis, Elsevier, and LMS Populi or similar learning platforms

Strong knowledge of Practical Nursing curriculum and current nursing practices

Excellent communication skills with the ability to teach, and support students in an online setting

Strong technical proficiency in managing virtual classrooms, and navigating digital content

Ability to provide timely feedback, manage deadlines, and maintain accurate academic records

Detail-oriented, and able to work independently in a remote teaching environment

Must demonstrate professionalism, accountability, and adherence to academic standards

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and general administrative tools. 

Ability to work with minimal supervision and maintain confidentiality.

Ability to work during AM EST hours without any conflicting schedule 

Must NOT engage in any other employment, consulting, or business activity (whether full-time or part-time) that may create a conflict of interest with the Institution. 

Knowledge about Monday.com or Click-up Application is a plus!

title: Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:

 the company directly. Any candidate who contacts the company outside of the OnlineJobs system will be disqualified from consideration.



Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant



$6–$8 USD/hour | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Every day, dozens of cleaning appointments depend on someone noticing small scheduling problems before they become big ones.



We are looking for that person.



Maid In America Cleaning Services is hiring a highly organized Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant to coordinate mobile cleaning teams, maintain accurate operational data, and communicate with customers when schedules change.



This is not a general administrative assistant role. This role is best suited for someone with experience coordinating schedules, customers, and day-to-day operations in a fast-paced service environment.



What You’ll Do



Your primary responsibility will be helping keep our field operations organized and running on schedule.



You will:

-Prepare and adjust cleaning schedules in Jobber

-Coordinate changes caused by call-outs, delays, and customer rescheduling requests

-Identify overlaps, drive-time issues, staffing conflicts, and other schedule problems

-Reassign or resequence jobs within established guidelines

-Answer inbound customer calls related to scheduling and basic support

-Make outbound calls to communicate delays and schedule changes

-Maintain accurate customer, job, and service information

-Update operational trackers and reports

-Complete invoicing, payroll-support, and cost-of-service tasks

-Escalate decisions that require management approval



You will follow established processes while also using judgment when a situation does not perfectly match the written procedure.



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Notice small details and inconsistencies others miss

-Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

-Enjoy solving scheduling and logistics problems

-Follow SOPs, checklists, and operating rules consistently

-Can investigate and solve routine problems independently

-Know when to stop and escalate a decision

-Communicate confidently and professionally with customers

-Stay calm when priorities change

-Learn new software quickly

-Take ownership of mistakes and correct them promptly



Experience



Previous experience in scheduling, dispatching, operations coordination, or managing appointments in a fast-paced service environment is preferred.



Direct experience scheduling or dispatching employees who travel to customer locations is strongly preferred, but candidates with strong general scheduling, customer service, administrative coordination, or operations experience may also be considered.



Relevant backgrounds may include:

-Residential cleaning

-HVAC

-Plumbing

-Electrical

-Landscaping

-Pest control

-Home health

-Delivery

-Property maintenance

-Appointment scheduling

-Customer service

-Administrative or operations coordination

-Managing changing schedules, CRM updates, multiple priorities, and operational processes



Strongly Preferred

-Direct Jobber experience

-Experience with other field-service platforms

-Customer phone support experience

-Dispatch or logistics experience

-Google Workspace

-Slack

-Spreadsheet and reporting experience



Work Requirements

-Full-time availability

-Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time

-Fluent spoken and written English

-Reliable computer and dedicated workspace

-Reliable internet connection with a backup option

-Backup power solution

-No work for another employer or client during scheduled working hours



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience.



Candidates with direct Jobber experience, mobile-team scheduling experience, and strong customer phone skills will receive priority consideration.



Our Core Values

-Communication

-Connection

-Quality

-Service

-Teamwork



How to Apply



Complete our Culture Index survey:


/p/8Y0GG4Nyz4

- A brief summary of your scheduling, dispatch, or operations experience

title: Finance Assistant/Bookholder
description:
The Finance Assistant will be responsible for the reconciliation and management of internal accounts, assist the Assistant Finance Manager with daily accounting tasks such as updating internal system information with new data, communicating important and necessary information to the team, manage and execute daily transactions. The incumbent will also assist in the annual filings, file monthly reconciliations, and maintain electronic files and folders.



Reporting Line:

Day-to-day: Bookholders ? Assistant Finance Manager

Cash Flow, Compliance, Coordination: Bookholders ? Finance Manager

Key Responsibilities:

1. Property Financial Oversight (Reports to Asst FM) 

Manage all financial operations for assigned properties on behalf of the landlord.

Maintain accurate ledgers for rent, fees, expenses, and reserves per property.

Reconcile accounts regularly and ensure completeness and accuracy.



 2. Tenant Accounts & Rent Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Monitor tenant accounts and process rent collections.

Apply payments accurately and handle late payments or delinquencies.

Serve as the first point of contact for tenant financial inquiries.

Review and approve property-related invoices for Asst FM review.

Track recurring and one-time property expenses.

Ensure timely payment of vendors and compliance with budgets.

Prepare property-specific financial statements (Income, Expenses, Cash Flow, Budget vs. Actual).

Submit reports to Asst FM for consolidation and landlord presentation.

Escalate unusual financial activity to Asst FM, who may involve the FM.

Monitor rental cash flow to ensure operating expenses and obligations are covered.

Flag any cash shortages or funding concerns to the FM.

Coordinate landlord distributions with FM approval.





6. Compliance & Documentation (Reports to FM) 

Ensure all financial activities comply with company policy, lease agreements, and regulatory requirements.

Maintain organized records for audits, inspections, and landlord review.

Report compliance concerns directly to FM.



 7. Coordination & Escalation (Reports to FM) 

Collaborate with property managers, maintenance, and other departments for smooth operations.

Escalate complex or cross-departmental financial issues directly to FM.

Support FM in ensuring timely financial decision-making across teams.

Qualifications:

1-2 years of General Accounting experience

Experience with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to understand and manipulate basic spreadsheets

Proficient Accounting and computer skills with the ability to quickly learn new programs

Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely express ideas both verbally and in writing

title: HOA Manager
description:
The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like):



Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs

Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA

Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA

High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications

Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents

Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings



Key Responsibilities:

1) Board & Governance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings.

Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required.

Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements.

2) Owner & Resident Relations

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via
, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority)

Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected

Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate

Qualifications:

3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience

Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management

Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail

Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: Video Editor (Real Estate Media)
description:
About Weston Media:







We are a real estate media company based in South Carolina, USA,  specializing in Video, but also photography, drone, 3D tours, floor plans, and agent branding, and content creation. Our team is made up of seven real estate specialists, a full-time admin team, and a growing group of virtual assistants and editors, including our team lead Joseph and his assistants Cedie and Gayle, all based in the Philippines.



We move fast, communicate clearly, and take care of our team. We offer holidays off, paid time off, and special incentives throughout the year. We are a team that genuinely works together, and we want you to feel that from day one.



What We Are Looking For:



We are hiring a video editor who wants to grow with us long-term. This is not a short contract or a one-off project. We are building our in-house video editing team, and this role is the foundation of that.



Our current video workload averages 6-12 videos per day & increasing, including real estate property videos and event recap videos for real estate events. We need someone who can handle that pace, communicate well, and eventually step into a team lead role as we bring on more editors that we hope you will be responsible in coaching.



Our current video editors have the capacity of 3 videos per day per person. We are looking for the same or better.



Requirements:



- Experience with Final Cut Pro (required)

- Good English communication skills

- Reliable internet connection (you will be required to submit a screenshot of your upload and download speed)

- Availability Monday through Saturday, with Sundays off

- Willingness to complete a test edit as part of the hiring process

- A positive attitude and team-first mindset



Software and Tools We Use:



- Final Cut Pro

- Higgsfield.AI

- Dropbox

- Slack

- 



We will provide access to video editing training courses and a subscription to Higgsfield.AI. We are also open to adding other tools along the way if they make your work better.



Equipment:



You should have your own basic equipment to get started. Once a working relationship is established and we can see that you are engaged and putting in the effort, we are happy to provide additional equipment to support you.



Compensation:



Pay will be hourly during the first 60 days and the training period. After that, we transition you into a stable salary position. There is a real opportunity to grow here. As we build the in-house video team, our goal is to pay our people more, and we want you to benefit from that growth. Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.



How to Apply:

- A screenshot of your internet upload and download speed

- Your hobbies

- Anything else you want us to know about you

We are not just looking for a skilled editor. We are looking for someone who communicates, shows up, and wants to be part of something that is genuinely growing. If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.

title: Design YouTube Thumbnails That Make People Click (And Still Look Good)
description:
Most people d
 whether to watch a YouTube video in just a few seconds.



This role is about designing thumbnails that make that decision easy: clear, interesting, and worth clicking. If you enjoy thinking about why people click and turning that into simple, strong designs, this role may be a good fit.



I run a YouTube channel called Fearless Abroad. The channel is new, and I'm building it full-time from the ground up. I handle the thumbnail strategy and concept for every video myself. What I need is someone who can take that concept and execute it well, and who can also help me level up my design eye and build a consistent visual brand as the channel grows.



How this works:

For each video, I'll give you the concept: the text I want, the image I want, and general direction. There's some flexibility on background and design details, but the core concept comes from me. Your job is to take that and turn it into one polished, high-performing thumbnail, with revisions included until it's right. I bring the strategy and direction, you bring the design execution and craft, and over time we build a visual style that's consistently recognizable as Fearless Abroad.



This role is a good fit if you:

* Have real experience designing YouTube thumbnails (not just general graphic design)

* Understand how thumbnails influence clicks and viewer behavior

* Are familiar with core thumbnail concepts such as curiosity and contrast, clear focus and visual hierarchy, emotion and attention

* Can take a concept someone else gives you and execute it cleanly, while still bringing your own design judgment to the details

* Can design and deliver a thumbnail within 2–3 days after assignment

* Are available and responsive on weekdays (I don't work weekends, so feedback and any coworking will happen Monday–Friday)

* Are comfortable working asynchronously (time zone is flexible, as long as weekday availability works)

* Can take feedback well and make focused revisions, without needing many rounds to land it



Your work will include:

* Designing one final thumbnail per video, based on the concept and direction I provide, including revisions until it's finalized

* Making revisions based on my feedback and, over time, performance data

* Helping develop a consistent, recognizable visual style for the channel as it grows

* Occasionally offering your own perspective on what would strengthen a concept, since part of this role is helping me get better at thumbnail design, not just executing what I ask for



You will receive written guidelines and direction for each video. This is a collaborative, evolving process as the channel grows. If we work well together, this can become ongoing weekly work and a long-term role.



How to Apply



Please send a short message that includes:

* One suggestion on how to improve one thumbnail on my channel: 
 (1–2 sentences is enough)

* Examples of your previous thumbnail work (links or portfolio)

* Your price per thumbnail (including revisions)

* Your time zone and general availability



Please start your message with the word SUCCESS so I know you read the full post. Applications without this word will not be reviewed.



— Leah 

Fearless Abroad

title: AI UGC Content Creator
description:
Do you love putting together ideas or concepts using AI in the most realistic way? Are you passionate about AI creating and want to ascend to the highest level? Do you feel excited and driven when you get to create new AI content? We are an AI content agency that's strongly committed to creating the AI content of the highest quality and realism to help reach new heights for our clients while creating the culture and environment that simply makes you better as an AI creator.



The ideal candidate will have already worked their way through the low-quality AI outputs with unrealistic background sounds and motions, knows how to operate and prompts in AI generation tools and is now ready for the next step in their journey.



You should be comfortable focusing mostly on yourself and love thinking deeply about how "real" looks like and how to get it out of AI models. You have already created viral AI videos and you know that a great video comes from great inputs. You know how to make any content look natural, authentic and realistic. You are a driven person who turns scripts into reality with AI generation tools, and you love to analyze your generations to see what you can improve.



You will get to work with passionate and driven creators who excel at what they do. You will be a part of a culture where everyone likes to help each other, gives honest feedback to each other and strives to be their best. You will make new friends, have fun, and be around people who are serious about what they do. You will get to learn from courses, videos, and other sources that will help you grow and improve your AI creation and how to apply it to your content the best way.



What we do



- We create and turn organic AI content ideas into videos, for social media platforms that helps brands increase their revenue

- Our agency is a team full of passionate and driven AI creators who work together side by side and like to be challenged

- We create a friendly and competitive culture where each of us can individually grow and have fun

- Education is very important to us, so we help creators on how to constantly improve in content and AI creation

- We believe in every member of our team and make it the highest priority to ensure everyone has what they need to make their content successful

- we break down content and provide honest feedback to make each of us learn, improve and grow



Who we are looking for

- Someone who loves to turn scripts and ideas into finished videos with AI on a continual basis



Your role
