- You will take part in meetings where your content will be reviewed, and you will receive direct feedback

- You will analyze your generations and your metrics in order to keep your content realistic, unique and attractive



Things that should resonate with you



- You already have a great amount of experience with creating AI content on a daily basis

- You have already generated a significant amount of views with content created by AI

- When you watch an AI video, you can instantly tell what breaks the realism and how to fix it



What we expect from you



- You have a deep understanding of AI UGC and AI realism. You know how "real" looks like, how physics behaves on camera, and you apply it directly to your generations

- Image generation is very close to you. You know how to generate authentic and realistic images with Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2.0, Seedream, or other up-to-date image models

- You have already generated AI UGC content with Omni, Kling 3.0, and Seedance 2.5. You possess high level prompting skills and understand video generation to its core

- You know that the quality of the output is d
 by the quality of the inputs, and you take your time with references, frames and prompts

- You can edit your generations into a flawless final video from start to end

- You take ownership of your work, and you are not afraid of new challenges

- You love learning new things, and you have a strong desire to prove yourself you can be even better at what you do

- You speak English fluently, and you use it and understand it at a high level



We are here to push the limits with organic AI content while helping clients reach new heights. Everyone here is serious and loves to create content with AI. We respect each other, help each other, and grow together while having fun in the process. There are no egoistic people here, only humble ones. If you are not passionate and driven about the same things, then this job is not for you.



If you feel like this deeply resonates with you and you are ready to make a long-term change in your life, please send us your resumé and a cover letter in which we want you to tell us why you should be the one for this position and your accomplishments. If you can show them to us, then that's a plus. Send us your application and we will get in touch with you and tell you what is next.

title: Part-Time GoHighLevel (GHL) Newsletter Production Assistant
marketing manager (CPG)
description:
A profitable, growing US-based specialty tea CPG brand (~15% YoY, 130K+ lifetime orders, warehouses in the US, Canada, UK, and EU) selling primarily through Shopify and TikTok Shop, built on authentic sourcing, education, and a founder-creator with millions of followers who is, today, the company's entire marketing engine. The brand ships frequent new product lines (two launches in the next four months alone) and runs a quarterly subscription program (~2,000 members) that is the growth core. The founder built the entire business on organic content and the company has never run paid ads. Marketing today is a set of good ideas with no owner:
, loyalty, referrals, collabs, community, contests. Your job is to become that owner, and to build the machine around the founder's audience instead of depending on it.

One thing to know before you apply: nothing customer-facing here is AI-generated. All creative is real and hand-made. That is the brand's identity, not a policy. See "How this company uses AI" below; it will d
 whether this role is for you.



The role

You own marketing end to end. This is a content-led brand: high-quality entertainment and infotainment IS the acquisition engine, and everything you do in paid,
, and lifecycle has to interact coherently with the organic machine, not run beside it. You understand how paid and organic feed each other and you manage brand awareness as one system.

The mandate runs in a deliberate order. First, find the leaks and build the scoreboard: subscription drop-off, paused members, one-time buyers, and the KPI system to see it all. Second, stand up paid media and get the
 and lifecycle machine performing. Third, once the fundamentals run, expand into organic collaboration: creator collabs, bigger content plays, deeper integration with the founder's production. The wrong hire walks in asking for a big ad budget. The right hire walks in asking where the money is leaking and what the data says.

You are a player-coach, weighted toward player early. You personally run media strategy and media buying (today's AI-powered buying tools make this a one-person job at this scale) until the marketing arm grows enough to justify dedicated hands, at which point you help define that hire. The
 specialist reports to you and executes
 and lifecycle operations under your direction. You'll also coordinate with the rest of the small team around marketing: a Shopify/ecommerce operations person and the founder's YouTube account manager.

On creative: you are close to a creative director who never creates. The founder is the creator. He likes performing, he WANTS to make ads, and he already has some in production. Your job is to make that enthusiasm strategic and intentional: understand the brand's edges and preferences deeply enough to direct
, paid media, and collab work cohesively without ever violating the ethos, and to tell him exactly what the data says he should make next. He will make you one great ad at a time, not fifteen mediocre ones.

This is not a strategy-deck job. You make tactical judgment calls on messaging, audiences, offers, and budget the same day they come up, and you push initiatives to done. The unofficial title is "the person who makes marketing ideas stop dying in the parking lot."



What you'll do

Find the leaks and build the scoreboard

Diagnose subscription drop-off: who leaves, when (the drop after box two and three is the known weak point), and why

Quantify how much meat is on the bone: lapsed members, paused subscriptions, one-time buyers who never subscribed,
 list segments that never converted



Think in the levers that multiply the business: LTV, AOV, CAC, churn, and net-new customers. When the data to see a lever doesn't exist, you fix the measurement system so it does

Run the win-back loop for paused and lapsed members, working with the internal AI survey systems that surface why people pause



Run paid media yourself

Launch paid ads from zero (Meta first, TikTok second) with an intro test budget, personally owning media strategy and buying with modern AI-powered tools



Approach ads from first principles: early paid is a learning instrument. Breaking even early on is a perfectly good outcome; the bar is don't bleed money while collecting the data that verifies hunches and shapes the growth plan, then refine and iterate from there



Run the full range deliberately: put cash behind organic content that's already working, test odd angles, and run boring direct-response ads. You have to be comfortable with both the weird and the boring

Build the creative testing plan around the founder's content and the ads he has in production; brief him on what to make next based on what the data says



Own holiday-season ad buying (Oct through Feb is the season)

Earn the budget: scale spend only as unit economics prove out, and be the person telling the founder when NOT to spend



Own
, lifecycle, and loyalty

Set strategy for and manage the
 specialist, who executes
 and lifecycle operations under your direction

Evolve loyalty into a VIP program and fold the referral program into its tiers

Multiply LTV and AOV: bundles, premium tiers, subscription upgrades, win-backs

Expand the organic machine (stage two, after the fundamentals run)



Lead creator collab strategy, including YouTube collaborations: you set the strategy and direct it, with outreach and legwork resources added as the workload materializes

Surface-manage the content production workflow (the founder has a YouTube account manager) enough to keep it moving and connected to the rest of marketing

Deepen the paid-organic loop as both sides mature



Run the machine

Build the marketing calendar and own cross-channel coordination across Shopify and TikTok Shop: a constant new-product launch cadence (next two launches already scheduled for mid-September and November) and the holiday season

Direct the founder's creative production: batched, specific asks with clear briefs, on his rhythm

Run the AI marketing stack for analytics and orchestration, and teach: make sure the whole team understands what the numbers say and why



Be our eyes and ears on the marketing org: as channels prove out, you define the next roles the team needs and help us scope them



Who survives here

The founder runs this company as a creator and an artist. He will not work 70-hour weeks, he will not sit in frequent syncs, and he does not want to be managed hard. There are standing weekly team calls and brand-alignment checks; beyond that, you get batched, well-prepared asks and a lot of autonomy.

The person who thrives: a first-principles thinker who asks "what are the alternatives" and comes at problems from angles, cares deeply about brand ethos and being genuine, and is flexible and adaptable when the picture changes. Low ego, systems-builder, gets energy from ownership rather than access, treats the founder as a scarce production resource and designs the work around that constraint. A sense of humor is close to required: the brand runs on it. The person who fails: needs frequent alignment meetings, wants to "workshop the vision" repeatedly, bulldozes the founder's constraints in the name of growth, or is too proud to run boring ads.



How this company uses AI

The company runs a deliberate split: aggressive AI adoption in operations, a hard wall around anything creative or customer-facing. This role sits exactly on that line and has to hold it.



The wall (creative side)

- Nothing customer-facing is AI-generated. No AI images ever, no AI-written copy shipped as-is. This is brand identity, not a preference: the entire premise of the brand is that everything is real. Real sourcing trips, real photos, real people.

- The standard is cultural, not just a rule. Real example: product photos came back with dust on them right before a launch, the founder was unreachable, and the team spent hours manually retouching the dust out rather than AI-recreating the images, because they knew that is what he would want. That instinct is the hiring bar.

- AI-assisted drafting is tolerated only when the shipped output is written by hand or aggressively reviewed by hand. AI passing as human is the sin. A previous team member put an obviously AI-generated image into an internal test
; it never shipped and it was still treated as a serious culture violation.



The embrace (operations side)

- The company builds internal AI agents aggressively: live inventory and logistics answers for the CS team, a demand-prediction model for new products, and a customer survey loop that maps the customer journey.

- The founder's stated goal is a middle road: full transparency with the team about how AI is used, so nobody feels they are training their replacement, and AI kept as far from the creative side as possible.



What this means for you

- You manage the AI marketing setup: agent-driven ad analytics and orchestration (think "this ad is overperforming in one region, redivert budget"), AI-powered media buying, research, segmentation, reporting, workflow. Analytics and orchestration, yes. Generating ads, images, or copy that ships, no.

- You are also the translator: part of the job is making sure everyone on the team understands what the AI spend analytics say and why, in plain language.

- The founder believes AI slop is destroying trust in faceless content and low-tier influencer marketing, and that this brand's realness becomes MORE valuable as that happens. He has watched an agency lose his business by sending an unchecked AI-generated proposal. Pitching AI-generated creator content or mass AI outreach in your interview ends the interview.





What you've done before

- 6+ years across multiple marketing channels with your own hands: paid social,
/retention, loyalty or referral programs, influencer or community marketing

- Hands-on media strategy and media buying: you have personally planned, bought, and optimized paid media, not just supervised an agency doing it

- Food and beverage CPG experience is required: you have marketed a consumable product people buy repeatedly, and you understand replenishment cycles, taste-driven loyalty, and launch cadence

- Subscription experience is required: you have managed a subscription service and its retention economics, not just one-time - - DTC

- DTC ecommerce experience; Shopify fluency expected, TikTok Shop experience a strong plus

- Startup or small-team environments: you have been the whole marketing department before, comfortable with scrappiness and wearing every hat, not corporate structure and big budgets

- You understand content-led brands: experience running or working inside media/content production is a real asset, because here the content IS the marketing

- Ran frequent product launches end to end as the project manager, not just the channel owner; this brand ships new lines constantly and the calendar never stops

- Managed at least a small team or agency relationships; comfortable being the strategy layer for an executor

- Worked directly with a founder or creative director and can tell us how you adapted to them

- Comfortable managing AI agents and tools in your workflow; clear-eyed about where AI belongs and where it does not

- You should genuinely enjoy the product. Tea, tea culture, or Chinese culture as a real personal interest is close to a requirement here: this team lives the product, and it shows in the work. Comedic sensibility is a plus, since the founder's content runs on humor

title: English teacher online
Video Editor
description:
VIDEO EDITOR (Remote, Full-Time)

- Be Part of AEF’s Pioneer Editing Team



Dear Future Team Member,



This isn’t just another editing job.



This is your chance to be part of something special: a heart-driven team that powers cinematic wedding films and premium corporate productions for clients across Asia.



We’re AdvantEdge Films (AEF) — a Singapore-based creative studio behind the brand Memory Makers.



>> Why Memory Makers? Because our work goes beyond cutting clips. 



Every edit we deliver isn’t just a video — 

It's a memory made to last a lifetime.



• A couple relives the laughter, the tears, the vows.



• A business owner sees their brand elevated on screen.



That’s the standard we hold ourselves to, and that’s the kind of impact you’ll create here.



In just under 2 years, we’ve helped 100+ couples relive their wedding stories and supported business owners with high-impact video content.



But we’re just getting started — and we want you to be part of shaping what’s next.



As we grow, we’re opening 1–2 seats for talented editors to join our pioneer team.



>> Get in early. Grow into leadership. Help redefine storytelling.



>> See the kind of beautiful work you’ll get to be part of:




 


 



If you don’t think we’re legit, don’t read further.



But if your heart’s already beating faster — this might just be where you belong.



>> What’s In It For You 



If you’re just looking for another editing gig, where you’re treated like a headcount and your work disappears into a folder, this isn’t for you.



But if you want your edits to move people… to make couples cry happy tears… to see your work truly matter and to know you’re part of something bigger — then you’ll fit right in.



It’s about finally having the stability, recognition and growth path that so many freelancers dream about — but rarely find.



Your family will see that what you’re doing is a real career, 

not just a side hustle.



>> Here’s what you can look forward to when you join us: 



• A Clear Career Path — No more endless freelancing without direction. You’ll grow step by step: Trainee >> Junior Editor >> Senior Editor >> Lead Editor. Your hard work will actually lead somewhere.



•  Stable Monthly Salary (pegged to market rates) — Paid on time, every month. No chasing clients, no dry months. And as you grow, so does your pay.



• Pioneer Team Advantage —  Get in early and grow with us. As we expand, you’ll be first in line for leadership opportunities.



• Onboarding & Training That Sets You Up To Win —  Clear SOPs, style guides and real feedback — no guessing games, no being left alone. You’ll always know how to succeed here.



• Premium Portfolio You’ll Be Proud Of — Work on cinematic wedding films and corporate projects that showcase your craft — projects you’ll be proud to say, “I edited this.”



• Performance Bonuses & Growth Perks — Whether it’s a brand-new laptop, sponsored overseas travel (Company Retreats), or courses to sharpen your skills, we reward commitment and excellence.



>> How Life is Gonna Look Like For you



Joining AEF means stepping into a role where you can do what you love — without the chaos and uncertainty that freelancers often face.



Here’s how your day-to-day will actually look like:



Work From Anywhere (100% Remote)



- No commuting, no traffic, no wasted hours. You’ll have the freedom to work from the comfort of your home (or anywhere with a good connection).



Whether that’s your family home, a quiet café, or even during a brownout with your backup plan — you stay in control of your day.



A Stable Rhythm, Clear Expectations



- You’ll work Mon–Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM (SGT). But we’re not here to micromanage or track your every move. What matters most is that key deliverables are done on task, on time, on target, and to the required standards. Weekends are yours for family, rest, or passion projects.



Stay Connected, Never Isolated



- Even though we’re remote, you’ll never feel like you’re working alone. With quick daily stand-ups and weekly reviews (Mon, Wed, Fri), you’ll always have support, feedback, and a team that’s got your back.



A Team That Values You



- You’ll work with creatives who genuinely care about quality and storytelling — and about each other. Every edit you deliver contributes directly to making couples cry happy tears, or helping businesses shine.



Clarity + Growth Built In



- Your projects will come with clear briefs, SOPs and feedback loops. That means less confusion, fewer revisions and more space for you to focus on doing what you do best — creating edits that move people.



In short: Your days will feel structured, purposeful and supported. You’ll edit amazing stories, grow your skills, and still have time for yourself and your loved ones.



>> What You’ll Actually Do



Craft Wedding Highlight Reels



- Take the most emotional moments of a wedding day and weave them into a cinematic highlight that brings couples to happy tears and rewatch for years to come.



Bring Corporate & Event Stories to Life



- Edit impactful films that help brands connect with their audiences — from events to marketing videos.



Follow Clear SOPs, Add Your Creative Touch



- Use AEF’s editing frameworks and style guides as your foundation — while bringing in your storytelling instincts to make each video feel alive.



Grow Through Feedback Loops



- You’ll collaborate with our Singapore Team using Slack, WhatsApp and GDrive. Over time, as your cuts get sharper, you’ll need fewer revisions — a clear sign of your growth.



Master the Full Editing Flow



- From raw >> first cut >> fine cut>> final cut, you’ll manage projects end to end, sharpening not just your skills but your confidence as an editor.



>> How Your Career Growth is Gonna Look Like



This isn’t a dead-end editing gig. We want you to grow with us.



• 0 - 3 months (Probation): Trainee



Think of this as your warm-up stage. 



You’ll learn our style, workflows and editing frameworks while working on real projects. 



By the end, you’ll already have a feel for what it means to edit stories the AEF way — consistent, on-brief and emotionally powerful.



• 1-2 Years: Junior Editor



Now you can hold your own fort. 



You’ll deliver quality edits with fewer revisions, adapt confidently to our brand styles, and start building a premium portfolio of wedding highlights and corporate projects you’ll be proud to showcase.



• 3-4 Years: Senior Editor



This is where you level up. 



You’ll take on more complex projects with your own cinematic touch, handle edits with minimal supervision, and even begin guiding newer editors. Your work won’t just meet expectations — it’ll inspire.



• 5 Years & Beyond: Lead Editor (Pioneer Team Track)



As part of the founding team, this is the fast track. 



You’ll set standards, refine SOPs, mentor juniors, and lead large or high-profile projects. You’ll have a direct hand in shaping AEF’s editing division as we grow.



Join now, and you won’t just be another editor — 

You’ll be among our founding editors, with the fastest path to leadership and long-term impact.



And years from now, you’ll look back with pride knowing you weren’t just freelancing gig to gig — you were part of the original pioneer team, building a career your family can celebrate.



>> Compensation & Stability



We offer competitive pay pegged to the Philippine market rate for full-time video editors, and will assess fairly based on your portfolio and experience.



No more chasing invoices, no dry months, no waiting games.

Stable monthly income. Paid on time, every time.



No need to worry about clients ghosting you, or waiting until 3 AM for replies from a foreign timezone.



You’ll also have room to grow: as your skills sharpen and your impact increases, so will your pay.



>> In your application, simply share your expected monthly salary range so we can assess fairly.



>> How to Know You’re The Right Fit



This Role Might Not Be For You If…



• You rely only on drag-and-drop templates and avoid learning real storytelling skills.



• You’re juggling multiple clients/ freelance gigs and can’t fully commit to one team.



• You struggle to meet deadlines or need constant hand-holding to finish projects.



• You see editing as “just a job” and don’t care about the emotions or impact behind your work.



• You’re not open to feedback, or you take it personally instead of using it to grow.



This Role IS for You If…



• You don’t just want to edit videos — you want your edits to move people.



• You take ownership. Once trusted with a project, you’ll do your best to deliver, no excuses.



• You’re hungry to learn and grow — not content with being “good enough,” but aiming to be great.



• You thrive on collaboration: you value feedback, respect deadlines, and know communication builds trust.



• You don’t see this as just another gig. You’re looking for a long-term home where your work matters.



>> Must-Have Requirements



3 EXTREMELY IMPORTANT THINGS:



1) Strong Command of Adobe Premiere Pro (After Effects is a bonus!)



You don’t need to be the world’s best yet — but you must already have a solid foundation in Premiere and the drive to sharpen your craft daily. 



If you love refining timelines, syncing audio to emotion, and experimenting with cuts that bring stories alive, you’ll fit right in.



2) Great Storytelling Taste & Attention to Detail



Editing is more than just trimming clips — it’s about shaping moments into memories. 



You need an eye for pacing, music and emotional flow. 



Every detail matters — from transitions to color tones. 



If you find yourself obsessing over whether a cut feels “just right,” you’re our kind of editor.



3) Reliable Setup & Professional Commitment



This is a full-time role, so you’ll need a capable PC/ laptop built for video editing, a stable internet connection, and the discipline to work independently from home. 



Deadlines matter here, and so does communication. 



We value editors who show up, own their work, and consistently deliver on time.



>> Bonus Points If You…



- Have experience editing weddings, events, or cinematic highlights



- Are comfortable working with Google Drive, Slack and WhatsApp for collaboration



- Love experimenting with creative storytelling but can also follow brand guidelines



- Are eager to grow into leadership and mentor other editors down the road



>> I’M IN! HOW DO I BEGIN?



>> If you’ve reached this far and you’re still excited about joining AEF as a full-time Video Editor — and you can see yourself growing with us over the next few years…



Then follow the application steps below, show us your portfolio and let’s see if we’re a perfect match.



TAKE THIS SIMPLE TEST BEFORE YOU APPLY



>>  Before you apply, take this simple 4-step test to see if this role is truly right for you.



1) Check out our work



Our IG: 

Our Gallery: 



If you don’t feel inspired — or don’t have the heart to create edits that make couples cry happy tears or businesses proud to showcase their story… Then this role isn’t for you.



2) Ask yourself this:



“Am I prepared to grow from a trainee editor into a senior or even lead editor — refining my skills, taking feedback and mentoring others along the way?”

 

If the answer is no, don’t apply.



3) Reflect on your work habits.



Do you lose yourself in the craft of editing because you love it — sometimes spending hours without noticing the time?



Or do you just want a gig to clock in, clock out, and collect a paycheck?



If it’s the latter, don’t apply.



4) Think long-term.



Can you see yourself working full-time with AEF for at least the next 3 years, growing with a pioneer team and helping us redefine video storytelling in Asia?



If not, don’t apply.



IF YOU D
 THAT YOU’VE PASSED THE TEST ABOVE



>> Follow These Steps Carefully (we only want serious applicants who can follow instructions):



Step 1: Self-Intro Video (2–3 mins)



Record a short video of yourself answering these key questions:



- What are you currently doing and why are you considering changing?



- Why do you feel you’re the right fit for this role?



- What’s your past experience with video editing? (Wedding / corporate work if any!)



- What are your goals for the next 3 years?



- How do you stay motivated in a remote role?



Step 2: Application Form 



Upload your:

- Link to your best work / portfolio (if any)

- Resume

- Link to your Self-Intro Video



Step 3: Let’s Hop on a Date (Zoom Interview)



Yes, a date — because this is about chemistry too. We want to get to know you, hear your story, and see if we vibe as a team.



P.S. We’re only opening 1–2 seats for editors this year.



Once these are filled, the next intake won’t be for a while — and by then, the fast-track leadership opportunities may already be gone.



>> If you’re serious about building a long-term career in premium editing (not just freelancing from gig to gig), this is your chance.



<< Apply>>



[Click on the APPLY button now]

title: YouTube Video Editor – Long-Form & Evergreen Content
description:
We are looking for a skilled, proactive and reliable YouTube Video Editor to join our team and work on multiple long-form YouTube channels.



Our channels mainly focus on evergreen, news-based and documentary-style content, so we are not looking for someone who simply puts clips together.



We need an editor who can understand the topic, script and niche of each channel, find relevant footage and create engaging videos designed to maintain viewer attention and retention.



Responsibilities



Edit long-form YouTube videos.

Find relevant footage, B-roll, images and visual resources.

Understand the niche, topic and audience of each channel.

Create engaging edits with good pacing and storytelling.

Improve viewer retention through visual changes, transitions, footage selection and editing decisions.

Work with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar software.

Use AI tools to improve and speed up the editing workflow.

Follow reference videos and established channel styles.

Manage deadlines and deliver videos consistently.

Work independently without needing constant supervision.

Suggest ideas when you see opportunities to improve the videos, workflow or channels.



We are especially looking for someone proactive.



We don't want an editor who only waits for instructions. If you notice something that could improve retention, storytelling, editing quality or workflow, we want you to tell us and propose solutions.



We are building and scaling several YouTube channels, so our goal is to find someone who wants to become part of the team long-term, understand our channels and gradually take more responsibility.



Requirements

Previous experience editing YouTube videos.

Experience with long-form content.

Good understanding of pacing and storytelling.

Ability to find relevant footage independently.

Comfortable using AI tools.

Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar editing software.

Good communication.

Ability to meet deadlines.

Attention to detail.

Willingness to learn and improve.

Proactive attitude.

Interest in working with us long-term.

Trial Period & Payment Structure



The first 2 weeks will be a trial period.



During these first 2 weeks, payment will be made per completed video/project.



This allows both sides to make sure that the collaboration, editing style and workflow are a good fit before moving into a longer-term arrangement.



If both sides are happy after the trial period, we will move to a regular monthly agreement.



For the following 2 months, the salary will be $400/month, paid weekly in 4 equal payments of $100.



There will also be opportunities to earn additional performance-based bonuses based on results and contribution to the channels. The bonus structure will be discussed in more detail after we start working together.



As the channels and team grow, there will also be opportunities to take responsibility for more channels and grow within the team.



What We Will Evaluate



During the trial period and first months, we will mainly evaluate:



Editing quality.

Ability to understand the script and niche.

Footage selection.

Viewer-retention focused editing.

Reliability.

Communication.

Ability to meet deadlines.

Ability to work independently.

Proactivity.

Willingness to suggest improvements.

Consistency between videos.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself.

Examples of long-form YouTube videos you have edited.

Your portfolio.

Which editing software you use.

Which AI tools you currently use for editing or content creation.

How many long-form videos you can realistically edit per week.

Your current availability.



Please start your application with the word EVERGREEN so we know you have read the entire job post.



We are not looking for someone for just one project. We want to find a reliable editor who can become a long-term member of our YouTube team.

title: CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATOR & PROJECT ASSISTANT
description:
Taikoo Group is a California construction company working on residential additions, ADUs, renovations, and commercial tenant-improvement projects.



We are looking for a Construction Estimator & Project Assistant to support our growing team. The primary responsibility will be construction estimating, but the position will also include purchasing, project coordination, document organization, and general administrative support.



The workload will generally be approximately 60% estimating and 40% project and administrative support, depending on current project needs.



Responsibilities



Construction Estimating:



Review architectural and structural plans

Prepare material and quantity takeoffs

Assist with labor and material cost estimates

Prepare detailed scopes of work

Request and compare supplier and subcontractor quotations

Identify missing information or unclear details in construction plans

Prepare assumptions, exclusions, and questions for each estimate

Update estimates when plans or project requirements change

Maintain organized estimating files and spreadsheets



Project and Administrative Support:



Organize plans, proposals, invoices, receipts, and project documents

Contact suppliers and subcontractors to request pricing

Follow up on outstanding quotations and project information

Prepare price-comparison spreadsheets

Track purchases, deliveries, and project-related expenses

Update project task lists and progress records

Take meeting notes and organize follow-up items

Assist with
s, scheduling, research, and document preparation

Handle other construction-related administrative tasks as assigned



Requirements



Previous construction estimating or quantity-takeoff experience

Ability to understand U.S. construction plans

Experience with residential or commercial construction is preferred

Familiarity with Bluebeam, PlanSwift, or similar takeoff software

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

Good written and spoken English

Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable following up with people

Able to manage different assignments and ask questions when information is unclear

Reliable computer, internet connection, and availability during California working hours



This position is suitable for someone with a background in construction, civil engineering, estimating, project administration, or quantity surveying who is also willing to assist with everyday administrative work.



How to Apply



Please provide:



A short introduction

Your resume

Samples of previous estimates or quantity takeoffs, if available

The estimating software you have used

Your expected hourly rate

Your availability to start

title: ONLINEJOBS.PH — BOOKKEEPER + OFFICE TECH + EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO THE OWNER
description:
DO NOT APPLY ON THIS PAGE. Open the link at the bottom and record. A resume sent here will not be read.



We are a travel office in Israel. Small team, no bureaucracy. You work directly with the owner.



One person, three jobs. All three matter every day.



1. THE BOOKS

Match the company credit cards to the office books. Line by line.

Find every charge that is missing. Never guess. Never invent.

Read a messy transaction - a ticket, a refund, a hotel hold, an FX fee, a double charge - and say what it actually is.

Excel and Google Sheets daily. QuickBooks a plus.



2. THE OFFICE TECH

When the phone, the desk phones, Gmail, the printer or the Wi-Fi breaks, you are the one who fixes it.

You are the office's tech person.



3. THE OWNER

Sit with the owner. Take his instructions. Follow them through until done.

His messages, his files, his follow-ups, his reminders.

Become the person he trusts.



SCHEDULE

Sunday to Friday. Saturday off.

Philippine time: 5:00-7:00 PM, break, then 9:00 PM-4:00 AM.

(Israel time: 12:00-14:00, break, then 16:00-23:00.)

Daily. Not negotiable. The second block is night work in the Philippines.

Jewish holidays are paid days off.



MUST HAVE

- Excellent English, spoken and written. You are on live calls with the owner every day.

- 3+ years bookkeeping or statement reconciliation as your actual job.

- You have personally reconciled a card or bank statement against a set of books and chased the differences yourself.

- A real method for matching two exports - XLOOKUP, MATCH, a pivot. Not "I would look it up."

- You were the person people came to when the office tech broke.

- Quiet home office, backup internet, backup power, headset.

- Long-term. This is one seat, not a client you fit between other clients.



A PLUS

- QuickBooks Online or Desktop, or Xero

- Travel, airline, hotel or OTA money experience

- You have supported one owner or executive directly, every day

- You have handled a chargeback, a duplicate billing, or a refund that never posted



NOT THIS JOB

Not data entry only. Not chat support. Not a virtual-assistant gig you run between other clients.



HOW WE HIRE

We hire off a paid live test, not off a resume.

1. Apply at the link. Real questions plus two short English recordings.

2. We listen the same day.

3. Paid live test, about 60 minutes: screen share, real sheets, the owner on the phone.

4. A clean test can finish with an offer the same day.



TO APPLY

Do not send a resume here. Apply at:


 


/philippines/bookkeeper-office-ea



The form is about 25 minutes and it asks you to open a real desk file on your screen and find the missing charges out loud. If you skip a question, we skip you.

The form asks whether you can sit a paid live test today. The people who can are seen first.
salary: starting at  300 USD with growth to 1000

title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
description:
Senior Paid Media Strategist

Location: Remote, EST Hours

Type: Full-Time, Independent Contractor

Experience: 5+ years in paid media strategy, with enterprise budget ownership

Pay Range: $25-$27 per hour, based on experience

Reports to: Media Team Lead

Start Date: ASAP

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist to take full ownership of one of our largest and most complex accounts, a multi-location US home improvement brand running a seven-figure annual media program across Google Search, Performance Max, Meta, Bing and Local Services Ads, alongside a focused portfolio of established eCommerce and lead-gen clients.



This is a senior, client-facing seat, not an execution seat. You'll run the weekly client sync and the monthly performance review yourself. You'll own the numbers, the change log, and the tracking behind both. We're not looking for someone to run a plan handed to them. We're looking for the person the client trusts to say what's working, what isn't, and what we're doing about it this week.



One thing sets this role apart from most senior PPC jobs: you own measurement integrity. At this budget level, a broken conversion action or a mis-scoped tag isn't a reporting inconvenience. It silently misdirects bidding and burns real money before anyone notices. We need someone who treats GA4 and Google Tag Manager as core craft, not as someone else's job.



You'll be supported by a Media Team Lead, a Performance Marketing Specialist, dedicated creative and
 teams, and an internal AI stack we actively build on. What you won't have is someone checking your work for you. That's the level we're hiring at.

What You'll Be Doing

Account Ownership & Client Leadership

Serve as the senior day-to-day owner for your accounts, including our high-ticket lead gen clients

Lead weekly client syncs and monthly performance reviews independently: set the agenda, present the numbers, defend the recommendation

Translate business goals (cost per appointment, cost per lead, revenue targets) into media plans, and translate results back into plain language

Own budget pacing and reallocation across markets, products and platforms; flag over- and under-delivery before month-end, not after

Maintain a clean, current change log so every performance movement can be traced to a decision

Measurement & Tracking Integrity

Own GA4 and Google Tag Manager configuration for your accounts: conversion actions, event definitions, triggers, consent and cross-domain setup

Validate that platform-reported conversions reconcile with CRM and call-tracking reality, and investigate discrepancies before a client raises them

Multi-Location & Multi-Market Paid Search

Build and scale campaigns across multiple metro markets with distinct budgets, demand curves and seasonality

Manage Local Services Ads alongside Search and Performance Max, and understand how they cannibalize and complement each other

Structure geo, product and campaign naming and UTM conventions so reporting rolls up cleanly by market and product line

Cross-Channel Strategy

Plan across channels rather than platform by platform, and build a funnel view that accounts for audience differences, intent stages and creative fit

Lead campaigns across Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max), Bing, Meta, and where the client fits, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn and Reddit

Steer platform AI intentionally (Performance Max, Advantage+, Demand Gen, AI Max) using guardrails, negatives, exclusions and asset control rather than accepting defaults

AI-Assisted Execution

Use our internal AI stack (Claude, Claude Code, and connected data tools) for analysis, QA, reporting and creative ideation

Build lightweight automations that scale what you do: anomaly alerts, budget checks, feed monitoring, insight surfacing

Contribute what you learn back to the team's shared workflows and documentation

Quality Ownership

Ship work QA'd. Peer review is a check, not your safety net. Nothing leaves your hands that you haven't verified yourself

Apply our standard: don't send anything you wouldn't read yourself. That applies to reports, client
s, and change logs equally

Escalate early and specifically. Surface risk while it's still cheap to fix

Who You Are

5+ years managing paid media for US clients, with meaningful time in an agency or consulting environment

You've personally held accounts at $100K+ per month in managed spend and can speak to how that changes decision-making

Genuinely strong in GA4 and Google Tag Manager. You've built and debugged conversion tracking yourself, not briefed someone else to do it

Expert-level in Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) and confident across Meta and Bing

A confident, proactive communicator in English, written and spoken, at a C1 level or above. You can hold a room with a client, simplify complexity, and deliver bad news well. All candidates complete an English and a DISC assessment as part of our process

Comfortable owning the number and being accountable for it

Detail-obsessed in a specific way: you check your own work before anyone asks

You see problems coming. Pacing drift, a tracking gap, a rising cost per lead, a platform change that will hurt the account next month. The client hears it from you first, with a plan attached

Curious about AI and automation, and already using it in your workflow

Self-directed and reliable in a remote, globally distributed team

Bonus if You Have

High-ticket local lead-gen experience

Multi-location or franchise paid search experience

Server-side tracking, GA4 privacy configuration, or BigQuery / Looker Studio reporting

Experience with product feed management (Google Merchant Center, Meta catalogs, DataFeedWatch, Channable)

Experience with TV, direct mail or other offline media running alongside digital, and attributing across them

Built automations or scripts with Google Ads scripts, Zapier, Supermetrics or similar

Hours 

8:00 AM to 4:00 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday. We're a global team spread across five timezones and our clients are US-based, so overlapping the US day is what keeps us working as one team rather than five. There's flexibility within those hours, shaped mostly by client calls and internal meetings. We'll talk through what a typical week looks like at an interview. If working US Eastern hours doesn't fit your life, please don't apply. We'd rather both of us know now.



Why ScaledOn?

100% remote with a global team

Paid time off. Every contractor on our team gets it

Flexible, performance-driven culture

Direct access to innovative tools and early AI adoption

Performance-based bonuses tied to KPIs

Paid certifications and professional development

We hire contractors intending to keep them. Several of our team have been with us for 8+ years

About Us

ScaledOn's mission is to support the dreams, aspirations, and growth of our clients through ecommerce marketing. We do this by delivering strong work as a collaborative team and helping businesses grow profitably. We take shared risks for shared rewards, keeping us closely aligned with our clients' goals.



We are a 100% remote, work-from-home company offering location flexibility within a global, team-oriented environment.



Compensation for this role is commensurate with experience. This is an independent contractor position.



Our hiring process includes several assessments, including English and DISC assessments, followed by a paid 90 day trial period to ensure a strong mutual fit. We go into every contract expecting it to be a long-term one. As part of how we work, all tea
mbers are required to track their working time using Hubstaff. Hubstaff is used for task-level time tracking and supports transparency, accurate billing, and fair workload management across the team.

How to Apply

Please complete the online application: 
 



The application includes two short items in addition to your background, one being a voice note just a heads up so you’re prepared when you start the application. 



1. A written answer (5-10 sentences). Your largest account by monthly ad spend. Name the client or describe the business, the average monthly spend you   were responsible for, and the exact months you managed it. Example: "US home services franchise, ~$120K/month across Google and Meta, March 2024 to February 2026



2. A voice note (60-90 seconds). Recorded on your phone, no video needed. Walk us through a month where an account you owned missed its target. What happened, what you told the client, and what you changed.

title: GoHighLevel Sales Manager
description:
Remote | International Fashion Brand | Start immediately



We are an international, high-end fashion brand looking for a truly exceptional Senior GoHighLevel Sales Operations & Affiliate Manager.



You will own the daily sales operation behind our international B2B business: GoHighLevel, lead generation, callers, sales campaigns for New York and Paris, online B2B sales, and our affiliate and ambassador programmes.



This is a senior, hands-on management position. You must be able to organise people, set up systems, coach teams, solve urgent problems and take ownership from day one.



What you will manage



* Full ownership of GoHighLevel: pipelines, contacts, tagging, calendars, automations, reporting, follow-up and data quality.

* Write and continuously improve call scripts, sales scripts, objection handling, WhatsApp templates,
 sequences and follow-up procedures.

* Manage and coach the lead-research team: they must find and verify the right boutiques, decision-makers, phone numbers,
 addresses and company data.

* Make sure qualified leads are correctly entered, segmented, assigned and ready for the callers every day.

* Manage, coach and motivate callers and online salespeople; set targets, check activity, improve performance and ensure correct follow-up.

* Organise all sales tasks, lead lists and outreach campaigns for our New York, Paris and other international events.

* Build and run the online B2B sales operation: clients must be able to book appointments, receive follow-up and place orders efficiently.

* Fully manage our affiliate and ambassador programmes: recruitment, onboarding, administration, tracking, commissions, communication, coaching and activation.

* Coordinate teams working across Europe and the USA, with clear responsibilities, daily priorities and reporting.

* Step in immediately when something is urgent or blocked, and make sure it gets resolved.



What we need from you



* Proven, hands-on experience with GoHighLevel.

* Experience managing callers, lead generation, sales operations or remote teams.

* Strong sales-process and CRM knowledge.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Very organised, fast, proactive and solution-oriented.

* Comfortable working with Europe and USA time zones.

* Experience with Shopify, B2B fashion sales, affiliate programmes or ambassador programmes is a strong advantage.

* You must be available to start today or tomorrow at the latest.

title: 2D Game UI Artist / Icon Designer – Stylized Boxing Management Game
description:
We are looking for a 2D Game UI Artist / Icon Designer to help create interface artwork for The Final Bell, an indie boxing management/tycoon game.



The game has many different management screens, menus and systems, so we need an artist who can help build a consistent, reusable UI asset library that works properly inside a game engine.



The work may include:

- Buttons and button states

- Tabs and navigation elements

- Panels, frames and containers

- Separators and dividers

- Selection/highlight states

- Progress bars and status elements

- Resource and management icons

- Training, staff, fight and facility UI elements

- Menu decorations and stylized UI accents

- Reusable 9-sliced panel/button assets

- Other 2D interface assets as development progresses



We already have mockups and an established visual direction for many of the screens. You will usually be working from references, layouts and existing art direction rather than designing the entire interface from scratch.



We are looking for someone who:

- Has strong 2D UI / game interface design skills

- Understands how UI assets are actually used inside a video game

- Can create reusable interface elements rather than only static mockups

- Understands 9-slice / 9-patch scaling for buttons, panels and frames

- Can keep borders, corners and decorations consistent when elements resize

- Understands transparent PNGs, vector assets and clean game-ready exports

- Can follow an established art style and maintain consistency across many screens

- Communicates well and can work from detailed visual references

- Is comfortable providing editable/source files



Experience with Godot Engine is a strong advantage.

Experience with SVG/vector icon production is also preferred.



If you do not use Godot, experience preparing UI assets for Unity, Unreal, GameMaker or another game engine is also valuable, as long as you understand game UI production and concepts such as scalable panels, anchors/margins, multiple button states and reusable components.



This is not primarily a web/app UI/UX role. We are specifically looking for someone comfortable creating stylized visual assets for a 2D video game.



We will initially hire shortlisted artists for a small paid test asset so we can evaluate style matching, production speed and understanding of game-ready UI.



If the test goes well, there may be ongoing work for up to around 15 hours per week, depending on the current production workload.



Please include:

1. Your expected hourly rate

5. Whether you understand 9-slice / 9-patch UI assets

This isn't a ticket queue. The person we're looking for doesn't just fix what's broken and wait for the next request - they go looking. They notice a platform feature nobody's using yet, spot where AI could take over something still being done by hand, and see the pattern in three separate client problems that points to one fix. title: AI Systems Builder / Automation Engineer / Full-Stack Dev
description:
# Full-Stack AI Engineer to own the ScaleSage platform



Python, FastAPI, Next.js, Supabase. Remote. Part-time to start, with a written path to full-time and technical lead across the group.



## Who I am and what this is



I'm Jordan, a British founder based in Thailand. I run The Machine Collective (TMC): a group of ventures built on AI systems I design and my team ships. The main focus right now is ScaleSage, UK-based AI automation and client acquisition specialists for small and mid-sized businesses. Around it sit a Caribbean food brand heading into UK retail, a children's education app, a content production engine built to serve five brands, and internal research and trading systems.



I'm not a developer. I architect through conversation and Claude Code, and my team executes. My bottleneck is execution bandwidth, not ideas. I already have a strong EA in the Philippines. What I need now is her technical counterpart: the person who owns the code.



## The situation, straight



The ScaleSage platform is built and in production. The developer who built it is leaving on a planned notice period, and the handover is structured. You come in now, overlap with him while he's still here, take the platform over, finish it to a proven standard, and then build what comes next.



A lot exists. Some of it is documented better than the rest. The standard from here is simple: nothing is called done until it's demonstrated working, estimates are real and kept, and every hour is accounted for.



If that sounds like pressure, this isn't your role. If it sounds like how good engineering should work anyway, keep reading.



What I hire for, in order: finishing what you start; proving it works before you call it done; clear, precise written and spoken English, because nothing can get lost in translation here; being extremely organised; and an eye for detail, for design, and for what premium quality actually is. Our clients pay for premium and can tell the difference.



## What you'll inherit



Python/FastAPI services on Docker Compose on a Mac Mini production box behind Cloudflare Tunnels and Tailscale. Next.js front end on Vercel. Postgres on Supabase with Alembic migrations and row-level security. GitHub Actions CI gating deploys. Stripe with webhooks. Cold
 through the Instantly and Apollo APIs, plus Hunter, Google Places and Companies House. A conversational diagnostic funnel and a partner commission engine. HeyGen and ElevenLabs for generated video and voice. An e-signature flow, scheduled jobs, LLM agents with per-run cost tracking, and Slack alerting.



All of it real. All of it in production today.



## What you'll actually do



The 30-day trial starts on day one and runs alongside the outgoing developer for the rest of his notice period, so you inherit the platform safely before he's gone.



In the trial:



- Take the handover repo by repo and service by service until you can change any of it safely, documenting what you find as you go.

- Close out what's in flight with evidence: outbound
, payments, the diagnostic funnel, partner tooling.

- Prove it. For every piece you touch, a short recorded walkthrough showing it working, not a message saying it does.



A candidate who takes clean ownership of the platform and closes out the handover meets the bar. One who backs every claim with a proven demo is doing this role well. One who also spots what's inefficient or under-specified and improves the plan is exceptional.



After the trial you own the platform and its scope. Next on ScaleSage: a client platform, a content production product, and a search and AI visibility product. All scoped, all yours to build.



Beyond ScaleSage, the rest of TMC as it needs you: the Belly Full Seasonings brand site and e-commerce, Legacy Curriculum education app builds, AI video, voice and persona production, the internal content factory that serves our own brands, dashboards and tools, and client systems as ScaleSage grows. This is not a phased roadmap. You're a TMC team member shipping what the business needs. Variety is the deal.



## How we work



- A daily written end-of-day report: completed, active, blocked, next, with hours.

- Four status words for all work: architected, coded, live, proven. Only the last one counts as done.

- One live demonstration call a week, working things shown on screen, plus short recorded walkthroughs.

- Blockers raised the same day they appear.

- Time tracked through an agreed tool.

- Any other client work disclosed in writing before it starts.

- Written and async by default. You propose your fixed weekly windows and we agree them, with at least three hours a day of overlap with Bangkok and Manila working hours.



## The path



Nothing here is promised. Everything is earned. The path is written into the contract: part-time to prove the fit, expanded part-time as you deliver, full-time when the business and your delivery earn it, then technical lead across the group's ventures, hiring the people beneath you. Full-time follows delivery, not time served.



Bonuses are paid for execution: when you ship a big build, solve a complex problem, or hit a real milestone. Pay rises are earned through consistency, reliability and loyalty over time.



The money, straight: $600 a month for a fixed 20 hours a week to start, through the trial and into the part-time retainer. I'm a founder, not a corporation. I pay what I can afford now and grow it as the business grows, and the ladder above is how that happens.



I won't sell you a dream. I'll tell you the ceiling is high for the right person.



## What you get



- Real freedom in how and when you work, inside the windows we agree.

- A direct line to the founder. Decisions in hours, not weeks. No red tape.

- Claude Code and Codex provided as your daily tools.

- Ownership. No product manager sitting between you and the work.

- Variety across ventures instead of one narrow codebase.

- Paid monthly in arrears, on time, every time, by Wise or crypto (USDT or USDC on the network of your choice).

- Trips to Thailand for in-person workshops, expenses covered.

- A company that wants you to grow into leading its technology.



## Must have



- Python and FastAPI in production

- Postgres and Supabase: schema design and migrations, background jobs and schedulers, webhooks

- Next.js and React on Vercel, Tailwind, responsive layouts that look right on a phone, CSS animation and motion, and the ability to take a Figma or visual reference and build it to the pixel

- Stripe subscriptions and one-off payments, REST integration with third-party SaaS

-
 sending and deliverability

- Docker, CI pipelines, Linux, Cloudflare Tunnels, backups and restore, secrets handled properly

- LLM APIs, prompt and agent design, evaluation of outputs

- AI-native: you use Claude Code, Cursor or similar every day, and you can tell when they're wrong

- Automated tests, QA on real devices, security and data-protection basics

- Documentation good enough that someone else could take over

- Excellent written and spoken English. You'll write daily reports and speak on a weekly demo call. English is tested live on the screening call.

- Self-managing: able to take a brief and ship without hand-holding

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace



If you're strong in most of these and honest about the rest, apply.



## Nice to have



- Experience taking over an existing, under-documented codebase and making it safe to change

- Background in a client-services environment where "done" has to be provable to someone else

- Content production tooling, or SEO and AI-search-visibility work

- Working knowledge of UK GDPR and PECR as they apply to cold
: suppression, unsubscribe handling, eligibility

- AI voice agents (Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs) and AI image and video tools (Runway, Flux, HeyGen, Higgsfield)

- RAG and vector databases (pgvector or similar)

- An active GitHub with public commits in the last 90 days

- An entrepreneurial mindset: you've tried to build something yourself

- Willingness to travel to Thailand, and openness to relocating long-term if the fit is right



You don't need to know everything already. But you need to be the kind of person who can learn a new tool fast, build with it, and document what you did so the rest of the team can use it.



## How to apply



Start your message with the word PROVEN, so I know you read this properly.



Then send:



1. A recorded video, under three minutes: why this role, and how you'd approach the first week. No script needed. I want to see how you think and hear how you speak.



2. Answers to these seven questions, written directly in your application. Real examples only. Generic answers are exactly what this is screening against.

   1. Describe a system you built end to end and are proud of: the stack, what it does, what's live today, and what you'd do differently.

   2. Have you taken over someone else's system? What were you handed, what was missing, and how did you get to the point of being able to change it safely?

   3. Give an example of a deadline you missed. When did you tell the client, what did you say, and what changed afterwards?

   4. Describe something you shipped that later turned out not to work in production. How was it found, and what did you change so it wouldn't happen again?

   5. What is your current client load in hours per week, and what fixed windows could you give this role, in Bangkok time?

   6. Send a link to something you've built where the front end is yours, and tell me one thing about it you'd fix if you had an hour.

   7. You'll have Claude Code and Codex. How do you use them, and how do you know what they produce is right?



3. Your GitHub username and a link to your portfolio.



4. Confirmation you can start at the $600 retainer for 20 hours a week, or your number with the reason. Plus your full-time rate and your earliest start date.



5. One thing you'd push back on or improve in this brief. It shows me you think, not just execute.



6. One question for me about the role, the company, or me.



If your answer to question four is "that has never happened to me", this isn't the role for you. If you used AI to help write your application, say which tool. I respect AI use. I don't respect pretending. Applications missing any of the above are not read.



## Process



Written screen, then a 30-minute video call where English is tested live and you screen-share one production system you built, then a short technical test, then two client references, then a contract with a 30-day trial.



We're hiring now. The trial starts as soon as the right person is found, while the current developer is still here to hand over.



J W-Blake

Founder, The Machine Collective

title: HIRING: Full-Time Ads Designer for 7 Figures Supplement Brand (ORGIN)
description:
About Us



We're ORGIN, a fast-growing DTC brand in the health supplement space, scaling to 30K days with performance-driven creatives. Every ad we launch is backed by data and crafted to convert.



We're looking for an ads designer who not only designs but also thinks like a marketer — someone who wants to grow, push limits, and create winning ads at scale.



The Role:



We're hiring an Ads Designer who can consistently deliver high-performing ads for Meta and Google — static and video. Our products help people feel better, have more energy, and take control of their health, and your visuals will help tell that story.



You'll work closely with our Media Buyer and Creative Manager to create ad concepts that connect emotionally and convert effectively. You'll not only design  you'll also help write short ad copy and hooks to make sure the story behind each creative is clear and powerful.



This is a long-term, remote role with $4 start salary which increases if hit rate is on target. Also introducing performance bonuses in month 2.



What You'll Do



- Create 25–30 ad concepts per week for Meta & Google (static and video)

- Craft story-driven ads that make people feel and act

- Write short, catchy ad copy, headlines, and hooks aligned with each creative

- Conduct weekly competitor research and present insights and examples of trending creatives

- Study our competitor list and rebuild proven ad formats for ORGIN

- Edit UGC videos and build ads with strong hooks and structure

- Use AI-generated images and enhance them with Photoshop or Canva

- Collaborate with the Media Buyer to review results and iterate on best-performing visuals

- Analyze performance data & iterate quickly based on KPIs (CTR, CPC, ROAS)

- Keep an organized creative library in Notion or Google Drive

- Experiment with new formats, trends, and storytelling angles



You Need



- Experience creating Meta and Google ads (both static and video)

- Strong skills in Canva, Photoshop, CapCut, or Premiere Pro

- Comfortable in the Meta Ad Library — you can look at a competitor ad and explain why it converts

- Creative eye for storytelling and emotional design

- Understanding of ad metrics like CTR, CPC, and ROAS

- Ability to write short, persuasive copy (headlines, hooks, CTAs)

- Ability to deliver 25–30 ad concepts per week

- Fluent in English (written and spoken)

- Independent, organized, and deadline-driven

- Hunger to grow — willing to test, fail, and iterate fast



What You'll Get



- Base salary: $4/hour (start salary that increases if performance is on target) + performance bonuses

- Fully remote role

- A competitor list and clear briefs to work from — you're not starting blind

- Direct collaboration with high-performing editors, strategists and the Founder

- Managed under a dedicated Creative Manager who oversees designers and strategy



How to Apply



Send us:



1. A link to your portfolio of past ad work (static and video)

2. One competitor ad from the Meta Ad Library that you think converts well, and 3 sentences on why

3. One ad concept you'd create for a supplement brand based on that format

description:

Role Overview

As a Junior Web & Front-end Designer, you will support the design and development of engaging digital experiences across our platform. This is a hands-on learning opportunity ideal for someone early in their career, looking to grow their skills in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.



Key Responsibilities

- Assist in designing and iterating on web pages, landing pages, and
 layouts.

- Contribute to the UI/UX design process for web and mobile interfaces.

- Support frontend development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Help build and maintain client websites using platforms like Squarespace, including implementing updates and changes.

- Collaborate with design and marketing teams to create visual content and digital assets.

- Work alongside product and development teams to execute design-related initiatives.

- Apply brand styling and design systems across different digital touch-points with guidance.

- Assist in optimizing existing pages for responsiveness, performance, and user engagement.

- Participate in wire-framing, prototyping, and design feedback sessions.

- Stay up-to-date with design trends, tools, and best practices.



Ideal Candidate

- 0–3 years of experience in web or UI/UX design (internships or freelance work welcome).

- Eager to learn, open to feedback, and excited to grow within a startup environment.

If you’re motivated by the opportunity to learn, contribute, and develop your design skills in a growing company, we’d love to hear from you. Please share your CV, portfolio, and a short note on why you’re excited about this role.

title: Project Manager/ Contract Administrator
description:
PROJECT MANAGER / CONTRACT ADMINISTRATOR



Full-Time | Remote – Philippines | Australian Construction & Landscaping



About RYCOR



RYCOR is a Melbourne-based landscape construction company specialising in high-quality residential and commercial landscape projects.



We are looking for an experienced Project Manager / Contract Administrator based in the Philippines to join our team full-time.



This is not simply an administration role.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of projects from quote acceptance through to project completion and handover, working closely with our Australian project managers, site teams, subcontractors and suppliers.



Your objective will be simple:



Help us deliver projects on time, on budget and as profitably and efficiently as possible.



⸻



THE ROLE



You will become a key part of our construction and project management team.



Once a project has been accepted, you will assist in managing and coordinating the project through the entire construction lifecycle.



Your responsibilities will include:



Project Setup & Pre-Construction



* Review accepted quotations, plans, specifications and scopes of work.

* Prepare project files and construction documentation.

* Break projects into stages, activities and milestones.

* Develop detailed project schedules and construction programs.

* Identify long-lead-time materials and procurement requirements.

* Prepare procurement schedules.

* Identify required subcontractors and suppliers.

* Obtain and compare supplier and subcontractor quotations.

* Prepare and maintain project-specific scopes of work.

* Assist with mark-ups and amendments to construction plans.

* Ensure the construction team has the required information before works commence.



Procurement & Materials



Take ownership of procurement coordination, including:



* Material take-offs and ordering.

* Supplier quotation comparisons.

* Purchase order preparation and tracking.

* Delivery scheduling.

* Monitoring lead times.

* Confirming quantities and specifications.

* Coordinating deliveries with site teams.

* Identifying opportunities to reduce material costs.

* Preventing unnecessary freight, double handling and wasted materials.



You will be expected to continually look for opportunities to improve project margins through better procurement and planning.



Subcontractor Management



Assist with managing subcontractors throughout each project, including:



* Issuing scopes of work.

* Obtaining and comparing quotations.

* Negotiating pricing where appropriate.

* Scheduling subcontractors.

* Confirming site dates.

* Providing plans and project information.

* Tracking subcontractor progress.

* Reviewing invoices against quoted and completed works.

* Identifying variations or discrepancies.

* Following up outstanding work and documentation.



You must be comfortable communicating directly with Australian subcontractors and suppliers.



Project Scheduling



Develop and maintain detailed construction programs showing:



* Project stages.

* Activities and tasks.

* Dependencies.

* Labour requirements.

* Subcontractors.

* Procurement deadlines.

* Material delivery dates.

* Key milestones.

* Client decisions required.

* Critical-path activities.

* Target completion dates.



We currently use Microsoft Teams and intend to increasingly use Microsoft Planner for project scheduling and management.



You will be expected to help us develop and improve these systems.



Project Financial Management



A major part of this position is helping RYCOR deliver projects profitably.



Responsibilities will include:



* Maintaining project budgets.

* Tracking committed costs.

* Backcosting projects.

* Comparing estimated versus actual costs.

* Monitoring labour expenditure.

* Monitoring material expenditure.

* Monitoring subcontractor expenditure.

* Identifying potential cost overruns early.

* Tracking variations.

* Assisting with progress claims and invoicing.

* Forecasting project cost-to-complete.

* Reporting projected final project margin.

* Identifying opportunities to improve project profitability.



We don’t want someone who simply reports that a project has gone over budget.



We want someone who identifies potential problems early and helps the team prevent them from happening.



Construction Administration



You will also assist with:



* Project documentation.

* Filing and document control.

* Scope-of-work preparation.

* Plan mark-ups.

* RFIs.

* Variations.

* Purchase orders.

* Subcontractor documentation.

* Meeting notes.

* Project reports.

* Progress claims.

* Invoicing.

* Backcosting.

* Practical completion documentation.

* Defect lists.

* Project handover documentation.



⸻



SOFTWARE, SYSTEMS & AI



RYCOR is focused on using technology, systems and AI to make our projects more efficient and profitable.



Our current systems include:



* Simpro – estimating, project/job management, purchasing and financial tracking.

* Groundplan – construction take-offs, measurements and estimating.

* Microsoft Teams – internal communication and collaboration.

* Microsoft Planner – project planning, task management and scheduling.

* Microsoft Excel – project budgets, reporting, analysis and financial tracking.

* Microsoft Outlook and Word – communication and documentation.



Previous experience with Simpro and/or Groundplan would be highly regarded, particularly within an Australian construction environment.



AI Experience – Highly Regarded



RYCOR is actively looking at ways to incorporate AI and automation into our construction and project management processes.



Candidates with practical experience using AI tools will be highly regarded.



We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate how they have used AI to improve areas such as:



* Project administration.

* Construction scheduling.

* Procurement.

* Cost analysis.

* Budget tracking.

* Reporting.

* Scope-of-work preparation.

* Meeting summaries and action lists.

* Document preparation.

* Data analysis.

* Subcontractor comparison.

* Estimating and take-offs.

* Process automation.



We are not simply looking for someone who has used ChatGPT occasionally.



We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate how they have practically used AI or automation to save time, reduce administration, improve accuracy or increase project profitability.



⸻



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone with previous experience in:



Construction Project Management and/or Contract Administration.



Experience working remotely for an Australian construction company would be highly regarded.



Experience in any of the following would also be beneficial:



* Landscaping

* Residential construction

* Commercial construction

* Civil construction

* Quantity surveying

* Estimating

* Procurement

* Contract administration



You must have excellent spoken and written English.



We intend to provide you with an Australian phone line, and you will regularly communicate directly with:



* RYCOR employees

* Project managers

* Site supervisors

* Subcontractors

* Suppliers



You therefore need to be confident, professional and comfortable having construction-related conversations over the phone.



⸻



WHAT WE WANT TO SEE FROM APPLICANTS



We are particularly interested in evidence of what you have actually achieved.



Please don’t just send us a résumé telling us that you have managed construction projects.



Show us.



As part of your application, please provide examples or a portfolio demonstrating how you have previously managed construction projects.



We would particularly like to see examples of:



1. Project schedules or construction programs you have created.

2. Project budgets or cost trackers you have managed.

3. Procurement schedules you have developed.

4. Subcontractor management systems you have used.

5. Cost-to-complete or project forecasting reports.

6. Backcosting or estimated-vs-actual reporting.

7. Plan mark-ups or construction documentation you have prepared.

8. Examples where you identified a problem early and prevented a project from exceeding its budget or timeline.

9. Examples where you improved the profitability of a construction project.

10. Examples of systems or processes you introduced that made construction projects more efficient.

11. Examples of how you have used AI or automation in your previous roles.



For at least one previous project, we would like you to explain:



Original Contract Value:

What was the project worth?



Original Budget / Target Margin:

What was the expected construction cost and profit?



Your Role:

What were you personally responsible for?



Project Program:

How did you plan and track the project?



Challenges:

What problems occurred during construction?



Your Actions:

What did you personally do to resolve them?



Final Result:

Was the project delivered on time?



Financial Result:

Was it delivered on budget, and what happened to the project margin?



Lessons:

What would you do differently next time?



⸻



THE PERSON WE WANT



The successful candidate will be someone who:



* Takes ownership.

* Is highly organised.

* Communicates confidently.

* Thinks ahead rather than reacting to problems.

* Understands construction sequencing.

* Understands project financials.

* Is commercially minded.

* Is comfortable questioning costs.

* Negotiates with suppliers and subcontractors.

* Identifies risks early.

* Follows people up without needing to be asked.

* Enjoys building systems and improving processes.

* Can manage multiple projects simultaneously.

* Is confident adopting new technology.

* Looks for opportunities to use AI and automation to improve the way they work.

* Understands that project management is ultimately about time, cost, quality and communication.



Most importantly, we want someone who treats the company’s money as though it were their own.



If there is a better, faster or more profitable way to deliver something, we expect you to identify it and bring it to the team.



⸻



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



Success in this position will be measured by:



* Projects delivered to schedule.

* Projects delivered within budget.

* Gross profit maintained or improved against estimate.

* Accurate procurement and purchasing.

* Reduced project downtime.

* Materials and subcontractors organised ahead of site requirements.

* Accurate and timely project financial reporting.

* Variations identified and processed promptly.

* Accurate project documentation.

* Effective communication with site teams, suppliers and subcontractors.

* Problems identified before they affect project cost or program.

* Increased use of systems, AI and automation to reduce unnecessary administration.

* Continuous improvement of RYCOR’s project management systems.



This is an opportunity to become an important long-term member of RYCOR’s construction team and have a genuine influence over how our projects are delivered.
